using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    int id;
    
    Point() : x(0), y(0), id(-1) {}
    Point(double x, double y, int id) : x(x), y(y), id(id) {}
    
    double distanceTo(const Point& other) const {
        double dx = x - other.x;
        double dy = y - other.y;
        return sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    }
    
    double distanceSq(const Point& other) const {
        double dx = x - other.x;
        double dy = y - other.y;
        return dx*dx + dy*dy;
    }
};

// Simple timer for performance monitoring
class Timer {
private:
    chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point start_;
public:
    Timer() : start_(chrono::high_resolution_clock::now()) {}
    double elapsed() const {
        auto now = chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        return chrono::duration<double>(now - start_).count();
    }
    void reset() { start_ = chrono::high_resolution_clock::now(); }
};

// For very small N: Held-Karp DP (exact solution)
vector<int> heldKarpTSP(const vector<Point>& points) {
    int n = points.size();
    if (n <= 1) {
        vector<int> tour;
        if (n == 1) tour.push_back(0);
        return tour;
    }
    
    // dp[mask][i] = minimum cost to visit cities in mask ending at i
    // mask includes city 0 (start) and ends at i
    int fullMask = (1 << n) - 1;
    vector<vector<double>> dp(1 << n, vector<double>(n, numeric_limits<double>::infinity()));
    vector<vector<int>> parent(1 << n, vector<int>(n, -1));
    
    // Base case: starting at city 0
    dp[1][0] = 0;
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
        if (!(mask & 1)) continue; // Must include city 0
        
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
            if (!(mask & (1 << u))) continue;
            if (dp[mask][u] == numeric_limits<double>::infinity()) continue;
            
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                if (mask & (1 << v)) continue; // Already visited
                
                int newMask = mask | (1 << v);
                double cost = dp[mask][u] + points[u].distanceTo(points[v]);
                
                if (cost < dp[newMask][v]) {
                    dp[newMask][v] = cost;
                    parent[newMask][v] = u;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Find optimal tour ending back at 0
    double minCost = numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    int lastCity = -1;
    
    for (int u = 1; u < n; u++) {
        double cost = dp[fullMask][u] + points[u].distanceTo(points[0]);
        if (cost < minCost) {
            minCost = cost;
            lastCity = u;
        }
    }
    
    // Reconstruct path
    vector<int> tour;
    int mask = fullMask;
    int u = lastCity;
    
    while (u != -1) {
        tour.push_back(u);
        int prev = parent[mask][u];
        mask &= ~(1 << u);
        u = prev;
    }
    
    reverse(tour.begin(), tour.end());
    
    // Ensure we start at 0
    if (tour.empty() || tour[0] != 0) {
        // Find 0 and rotate
        auto it = find(tour.begin(), tour.end(), 0);
        if (it != tour.end()) {
            rotate(tour.begin(), it, tour.end());
        } else {
            tour.insert(tour.begin(), 0);
        }
    }
    
    return tour;
}

// Nearest Neighbor heuristic
vector<int> nearestNeighborTSP(const vector<Point>& points) {
    int n = points.size();
    if (n == 0) return {};
    if (n == 1) return {0};
    
    vector<bool> visited(n, false);
    vector<int> tour;
    tour.reserve(n);
    
    int current = 0;
    tour.push_back(current);
    visited[current] = true;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int next = -1;
        double minDist = numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
        
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (!visited[j]) {
                double dist = points[current].distanceTo(points[j]);
                if (dist < minDist) {
                    minDist = dist;
                    next = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (next == -1) break; // Should not happen
        
        tour.push_back(next);
        visited[next] = true;
        current = next;
    }
    
    return tour;
}

// 2-opt optimization
void twoOpt(vector<int>& tour, const vector<Point>& points, int maxIterations = 1000) {
    int n = tour.size();
    if (n < 3) return;
    
    bool improved;
    int iterations = 0;
    
    do {
        improved = false;
        iterations++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            for (int k = i + 2; k < n; k++) {
                // Don't consider swapping adjacent edges
                if (k == i + 1) continue;
                
                int a = tour[i];
                int b = tour[(i + 1) % n];
                int c = tour[k];
                int d = tour[(k + 1) % n];
                
                double currentDist = points[a].distanceTo(points[b]) + 
                                   points[c].distanceTo(points[d]);
                double newDist = points[a].distanceTo(points[c]) + 
                               points[b].distanceTo(points[d]);
                
                if (newDist < currentDist - 1e-9) { // Significant improvement
                    // Reverse segment [i+1, k]
                    reverse(tour.begin() + i + 1, tour.begin() + k + 1);
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
            
            // Early exit if no improvement in recent iterations
            if (!improved && iterations > 10) break;
        }
        
        if (!improved || iterations >= maxIterations) break;
    } while (improved);
}

// 3-opt optimization (simplified)
void threeOpt(vector<int>& tour, const vector<Point>& points, int maxIterations = 100) {
    int n = tour.size();
    if (n < 4) return;
    
    bool improved;
    int iterations = 0;
    
    do {
        improved = false;
        iterations++;
        
        // Try all combinations of 3 edges to remove
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 2; j < n - 1; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 2; k < n; k++) {
                    // Handle wrap-around for circular tour
                    int a = tour[i];
                    int b = tour[(i + 1) % n];
                    int c = tour[j];
                    int d = tour[(j + 1) % n];
                    int e = tour[k];
                    int f = tour[(k + 1) % n];
                    
                    double currentDist = points[a].distanceTo(points[b]) +
                                         points[c].distanceTo(points[d]) +
                                         points[e].distanceTo(points[f]);
                    
                    // Try different reconnections (7 possibilities for 3-opt)
                    // Case 1: a-c, b-e, d-f
                    double dist1 = points[a].distanceTo(points[c]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[e]) +
                                 points[d].distanceTo(points[f]);
                    
                    // Case 2: a-c, b-f, d-e
                    double dist2 = points[a].distanceTo(points[c]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[f]) +
                                 points[d].distanceTo(points[e]);
                    
                    // Case 3: a-e, b-c, d-f
                    double dist3 = points[a].distanceTo(points[e]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[c]) +
                                 points[d].distanceTo(points[f]);
                    
                    // Case 4: a-e, b-d, c-f
                    double dist4 = points[a].distanceTo(points[e]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[d]) +
                                 points[c].distanceTo(points[f]);
                    
                    // Case 5: a-f, b-c, d-e
                    double dist5 = points[a].distanceTo(points[f]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[c]) +
                                 points[d].distanceTo(points[e]);
                    
                    // Case 6: a-f, b-d, c-e
                    double dist6 = points[a].distanceTo(points[f]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[d]) +
                                 points[c].distanceTo(points[e]);
                    
                    // Case 7: a-d, b-f, c-e (original is a-b, c-d, e-f)
                    double dist7 = points[a].distanceTo(points[d]) +
                                 points[b].distanceTo(points[f]) +
                                 points[c].distanceTo(points[e]);
                    
                    double minNewDist = min({dist1, dist2, dist3, dist4, dist5, dist6, dist7});
                    
                    if (minNewDist < currentDist - 1e-9) {
                        // Apply the best improvement (simplified: just reverse middle segment)
                        // In practice, we'd need to implement the specific reconnection
                        reverse(tour.begin() + i + 1, tour.begin() + j + 1);
                        improved = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (improved) break;
            }
            if (improved) break;
        }
        
        if (!improved || iterations >= maxIterations) break;
    } while (improved);
}

// Hilbert curve for spatial sorting
// Based on Wikipedia algorithm
uint64_t hilbertOrder(int x, int y, int pow, int rotate) {
    if (pow == 0) return 0;
    int hpow = 1 << (pow-1);
    int seg = ((x < hpow) ? 
              ((y < hpow) ? 0 : 3) : 
              ((y < hpow) ? 1 : 2));
    seg = (seg + rotate) & 3;
    int rotateDelta = [](int r) { return (r == 0) ? 3 : 0; }[seg];
    int nx = x & (hpow - 1);
    int ny = y & (hpow - 1);
    int nrot = (rotate + rotateDelta) & 3;
    uint64_t subSquareSize = 1ULL << (2*pow - 2);
    uint64_t ans = seg * subSquareSize;
    uint64_t add = hilbertOrder(nx, ny, pow-1, nrot);
    ans += (seg == 1 || seg == 2) ? add : (subSquareSize - 1 - add);
    return ans;
}

uint64_t hilbertOrder(int x, int y, int pow=21) {
    return hilbertOrder(x, y, pow, 0);
}

// Space-filling curve approach (Hilbert)
vector<int> hilbertCurveTSP(vector<Point> points) {
    if (points.empty()) return {};
    
    // Find bounding box
    double minX = points[0].x, maxX = points[0].x;
    double minY = points[0].y, maxY = points[0].y;
    
    for (const auto& p : points) {
        minX = min(minX, p.x);
        maxX = max(maxX, p.x);
        minY = min(minY, p.y);
        maxY = max(maxY, p.y);
    }
    
    // Handle degenerate case
    if (maxX == minX && maxY == minY) {
        vector<int> tour;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) tour.push_back(points[i].id);
        return tour;
    }
    
    // Scale to integer coordinates for Hilbert curve
    const int SCALE = 10000; // Enough precision for most cases
    const int POW = 21; // 2^21 > 2 million, good for Hilbert
    
    vector<pair<uint64_t, int>> hilbertIndices;
    hilbertIndices.reserve(points.size());
    
    for (const auto& p : points) {
        int scaledX = static_cast<int>((p.x - minX) / (maxX - minX) * ((1LL << POW) - 1));
        int scaledY = static_cast<int>((p.y - minY) / (maxY - minY) * ((1LL << POW) - 1));
        uint64_t order = hilbertOrder(scaledX, scaledY, POW);
        hilbertIndices.emplace_back(order, p.id);
    }
    
    // Sort by Hilbert order
    sort(hilbertIndices.begin(), hilbertIndices.end());
    
    // Extract tour
    vector<int> tour;
    tour.reserve(points.size());
    for (const auto& p : hilbertIndices) {
        tour.push_back(p.second);
    }
    
    return tour;
}

// Grid-based clustering for very large N
vector<int> gridClusteringTSP(const vector<Point>& points) {
    int n = points.size();
    if (n < 100) {
        // Fall back to simpler method for small n
        vector<int> tour = nearestNeighborTSP(points);
        twoOpt(tour, points, 100);
        return tour;
    }
    
    // Determine grid size based on sqrt(n) heuristic
    int gridSize = static_cast<int>(sqrt(n)) + 1;
    if (gridSize > 1000) gridSize = 1000; // Cap grid size
    
    // Find bounding box
    double minX = points[0].x, maxX = points[0].x;
    double minY = points[0].y, maxY = points[0].y;
    
    for (const auto& p : points) {
        minX = min(minX, p.x);
        maxX = max(maxX, p.x);
        minY = min(minY, p.y);
        maxY = max(maxY, p.y);
    }
    
    double width = maxX - minX;
    double height = maxY - minY;
    
    // Handle degenerate cases
    if (width < 1e-9) width = 1.0;
    if (height < 1e-9) height = 1.0;
    
    // Create grid
    vector<vector<int>> grid(gridSize, vector<int>(gridSize));
    vector<vector<Point>> gridPoints(gridSize, vector<Point>(gridSize));
    vector<int> pointCount(gridSize * gridSize, 0);
    
    // Assign points to grid cells
    for (const auto& p : points) {
        int gx = static_cast<int>((p.x - minX) / width * (gridSize - 1));
        int gy = static_cast<int>((p.y - minY) / height * (gridSize - 1));
        gx = max(0, min(gridSize - 1, gx));
        gy = max(0, min(gridSize - 1, gy));
        
        int idx = gy * gridSize + gx;
        grid[gy][gx] = pointCount[idx]++;
        gridPoints[gy][gx].push_back(p);
    }
    
    // Sort grid cells using Hilbert curve
    vector<pair<uint64_t, pair<int, int>>> hilbertCells;
    hilbertCells.reserve(gridSize * gridSize);
    
    for (int gy = 0; gy < gridSize; gy++) {
        for (int gx = 0; gx < gridSize; gx++) {
            if (pointCount[gy * gridSize + gx] > 0) {
                uint64_t order = hilbertOrder(gx, gy, 10); // Smaller pow for grid
                hilbertCells.emplace_back(order, make_pair(gy, gx));
            }
        }
    }
    
    sort(hilbertCells.begin(), hilbertCells.end());
    
    // Build tour by visiting points in each cell
    vector<int> tour;
    tour.reserve(n);
    
    for (const auto& cell : hilbertCells) {
        int gy = cell.second.first;
        int gx = cell.second.second;
        
        // For points within cell, use nearest neighbor
        if (!gridPoints[gy][gx].empty()) {
            vector<Point>& cellPoints = gridPoints[gy][gx];
            vector<int> cellTour = nearestNeighborTSP(cellPoints);
            
            // Map back to original indices
            for (int idx : cellTour) {
                tour.push_back(cellPoints[idx].id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return tour;
}

// Approximate nearest neighbor with random sampling for huge N
vector<int> approximateTSP(const vector<Point>& points) {
    int n = points.size();
    if (n < 1000) {
        vector<int> tour = nearestNeighborTSP(points);
        twoOpt(tour, points, 50);
        return tour;
    }
    
    // For very large N, use sampling-based approach
    vector<int> tour;
    tour.reserve(n);
    
    if (n == 0) return tour;
    
    // Start with city 0
    vector<bool> visited(n, false);
    tour.push_back(0);
    visited[0] = true;
    
    // Use a sample of candidates for each step to make it O(N*sampleSize)
    const int SAMPLE_SIZE = min(100, n / 10); // Adaptive sample size
    mt19937 rng(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());
    
    int current = 0;
    for (int step = 1; step < n; step++) {
        int bestNext = -1;
        double bestDist = numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
        
        // Sample random unvisited cities
        vector<int> candidates;
        candidates.reserve(min(SAMPLE_SIZE, n - step));
        
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && count < SAMPLE_SIZE * 2; i++) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                candidates.push_back(i);
                count++;
            }
        }
        
        // If we didn't get enough samples, take all remaining
        if (candidates.size() < SAMPLE_SIZE) {
            candidates.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) candidates.push_back(i);
            }
        }
        
        // Shuffle and take SAMPLE_SIZE
        shuffle(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), rng);
        if (static_cast<int>(candidates.size()) > SAMPLE_SIZE) {
            candidates.resize(SAMPLE_SIZE);
        }
        
        // Find best among sample
        for (int candidate : candidates) {
            double dist = points[current].distanceTo(points[candidate]);
            if (dist < bestDist) {
                bestDist = dist;
                bestNext = candidate;
            }
        }
        
        // Fallback: if no candidate found (shouldn't happen), take first unvisited
        if (bestNext == -1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    bestNext = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        tour.push_back(bestNext);
        visited[bestNext] = true;
        current = bestNext;
        
        // Periodically apply local optimization to prevent getting too bad
        if (step % 10000 == 0 && step > 1000) {
            // Apply light 2-opt on recent segment
            int startIdx = max(0, step - 1000);
            if (startIdx < step - 10) {
                vector<int> segment(tour.begin() + startIdx, tour.begin() + step + 1);
                twoOpt(segment, points, 5);
                copy(segment.begin(), segment.end(), tour.begin() + startIdx);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Final light optimization
    if (n < 50000) {
        twoOpt(tour, points, 20);
    } else if (n < 500000) {
        // Apply 2-opt on chunks
        int chunkSize = 1000;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += chunkSize) {
            int end = min(i + chunkSize, n);
            if (end - i > 10) {
                vector<int> chunk(tour.begin() + i, tour.begin() + end);
                twoOpt(chunk, points, 5);
                copy(chunk.begin(), chunk.end(), tour.begin() + i);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return tour;
}

// Main adaptive TSP solver
vector<int> solveTSP(const vector<Point>& points) {
    int n = points.size();
    
    if (n == 0) return {};
    if (n == 1) return {0};
    
    // Adaptive strategy based on problem size
    if (n <= 15) {
        // Exact solution for very small instances
        return heldKarpTSP(points);
    } else if (n <= 40) {
        // Nearest neighbor with 2-opt for small instances
        vector<int> tour = nearestNeighborTSP(points);
        twoOpt(tour, points, 1000);
        return tour;
    } else if (n <= 1000) {
        // Nearest neighbor with 2-opt and 3-opt for medium instances
        vector<int> tour = nearestNeighborTSP(points);
        twoOpt(tour, points, 100);
        threeOpt(tour, points, 20);
        return tour;
    } else if (n <= 50000) {
        // Hilbert curve approach for large instances
        vector<int> tour = hilbertCurveTSP(points);
        // Light optimization
        if (n <= 5000) {
            twoOpt(tour, points, 50);
        } else {
            // Apply 2-opt in chunks to save time
            int chunkSize = 500;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += chunkSize) {
                int end = min(i + chunkSize, n);
                if (end - i > 20) {
                    vector<int> chunk(tour.begin() + i, tour.begin() + end);
                    twoOpt(chunk, points, 5);
                    copy(chunk.begin(), chunk.end(), tour.begin() + i);
                }
            }
        }
        return tour;
    } else if (n <= 500000) {
        // Grid clustering for very large instances
        return gridClusteringTSP(points);
    } else {
        // Approximate method for extreme/epic instances
        return approximateTSP(points);
    }
}

        cerr << "Error: Failed to read number of cities" << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
    if (N < 0) {
        cerr << "Error: Number of cities cannot be negative" << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
    vector<Point> points;
    points.reserve(N);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        double x, y;
        if (!(cin >> x >> y)) {
            cerr << "Error: Failed to read coordinates for city " << i << endl;
            return 1;
        }
        points.emplace_back(x, y, i);
    }
    
    // Solve TSP
    vector<int> tour = solveTSP(points);
    
    // Validate tour (in debug mode)
    #ifndef NDEBUG
    if (tour.size() != static_cast<size_t>(N)) {
        cerr << "Error: Tour size mismatch. Expected " << N << ", got " << tour.size() << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
    vector<bool> visited(N, false);
    for (int city : tour) {
        if (city < 0 || city >= N) {
            cerr << "Error: Invalid city index " << city << endl;
            return 1;
        }
        if (visited[city]) {
            cerr << "Error: Duplicate city index " << city << endl;
            return 1;
        }
        visited[city] = true;
    }
    
    if (!visited[0]) {
        cerr << "Error: Tour does not start at city 0" << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
    if (tour[0] != 0) {
        cerr << "Error: Tour does not start at city 0" << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    #endif
    
    // Output tour
    for (size_t i = 0; i < tour.size(); i++) {
        if (i > 0) cout << " ";
        cout << tour[i];
    }
    cout << endl;
    
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace ChinesePostman
{
    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var input = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            if (input.Length < 2) return;
            int n = int.Parse(input[0]);
            int m = int.Parse(input[1]);

            List<(int u, int v, long w)>[] adj = new List<(int, int, long)>[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new List<(int, int, long)>();

            long[] degree = new long[n];
            Dictionary<(int, int), long> edgeWeight = new Dictionary<(int, int), long>();

            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            {
                var parts = Console.ReadLine().Split();
                int u = int.Parse(parts[0]);
                int v = int.Parse(parts[1]);
                long w = long.Parse(parts[2]);

                adj[u].Add((v, v, w));
                adj[v].Add((u, u, w));
                degree[u]++;
                degree[v]++;

                int a = Math.Min(u, v);
                int b = Math.Max(u, v);
                var key = (a, b);
                if (edgeWeight.ContainsKey(key))
                    edgeWeight[key] = Math.Min(edgeWeight[key], w);
                else
                    edgeWeight[key] = w;
            }

            List<int> oddVertices = new List<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                if (degree[i] % 2 == 1)
                    oddVertices.Add(i);

            if (oddVertices.Count == 0)
            {
                var circuit = Hierholzer(adj, n);
                PrintCircuit(circuit);
                return;
            }

            int k = oddVertices.Count;
            long[,] dist = new long[k, k];
            bool[] reachable = new bool[k];

            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            {
                long[] d = Dijkstra(adj, n, oddVertices[i]);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++)
                {
                    dist[i, j] = d[oddVertices[j]];
                    if (d[oddVertices[j]] < long.MaxValue / 2)
                        reachable[i] = true;
                }
            }

            bool allReachable = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                if (!reachable[i]) { allReachable = false; break; }

            if (!allReachable)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("0");
                return;
            }

            List<(int, int)> matching;
            if (k <= 16)
                matching = MinWeightPerfectMatchingDP(dist, k);
            else
                matching = GreedyMatching(dist, k);

            // Augment graph with matched edges (as duplicate traversals)
            List<(int, int, long)>[] adjAug = new List<(int, int, long)>[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adjAug[i] = new List<(int, int, long)>(adj[i]);

            foreach (var pair in matching)
            {
                int u = oddVertices[pair.Item1];
                int v = oddVertices[pair.Item2];
                long w = dist[pair.Item1, pair.Item2];
                adjAug[u].Add((v, v, w));
                adjAug[v].Add((u, u, w));
            }

            var circuitAug = Hierholzer(adjAug, n);
            PrintCircuit(circuitAug);
        }

        static long[] Dijkstra(List<(int, int, long)>[] adj, int n, int start)
        {
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            bool[] visited = new bool[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dist[i] = long.MaxValue;

            var pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();
            dist[start] = 0;
            pq.Enqueue(start, 0);

            while (pq.Count > 0)
            {
                int u = pq.Dequeue();
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;

                foreach (var edge in adj[u])
                {
                    int v = edge.Item1;
                    long w = edge.Item3;
                    if (!visited[v] && dist[u] + w < dist[v])
                    {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        pq.Enqueue(v, dist[v]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist;
        }

        static List<int> Hierholzer(List<(int, int, long)>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var edgeCount = new Dictionary<(int, int), int>();
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++)
                foreach (var edge in adj[u])
                {
                    int v = edge.Item1;
                    int a = Math.Min(u, v);
                    int b = Math.Max(u, v);
                    var key = (a, b);
                    edgeCount[key] = edgeCount.GetValueOrDefault(key, 0) + 1;
                }

            var adjUsed = new List<(int, int)>[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adjUsed[i] = new List<(int, int)>();
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++)
                foreach (var edge in adj[u])
                {
                    int v = edge.Item1;
                    int a = Math.Min(u, v);
                    int b = Math.Max(u, v);
                    if (edgeCount.TryGetValue((a, b), out int cnt) && cnt > 0)
                    {
                        adjUsed[u].Add((v, a, b)); // store edge id as (min,max)
                        edgeCount[(a, b)]--;
                    }
                }

            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            var circuit = new List<int>();
            stack.Push(0);

            while (stack.Count > 0)
            {
                int u = stack.Peek();
                if (adjUsed[u].Count > 0)
                {
                    var next = adjUsed[u].Last();
                    adjUsed[u].RemoveAt(adjUsed[u].Count - 1);
                    int v = next.Item1;
                    stack.Push(v);
                }
                else
                {
                    circuit.Add(stack.Pop());
                }
            }

            circuit.Reverse();
            return circuit;
        }

        static List<(int, int)> MinWeightPerfectMatchingDP(long[,] dist, int k)
        {
            long[] dp = new long[1 << k];
            int[] parent = new int[1 << k];
            int[] pick1 = new int[1 << k];
            int[] pick2 = new int[1 << k];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << k); i++) dp[i] = long.MaxValue;

            dp[0] = 0;

            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << k); mask++)
            {
                if (dp[mask] == long.MaxValue) continue;
                int i = 0;
                while (i < k && ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) i++;
                if (i >= k) continue;
                for (int j = i + 1; j < k; j++)
                {
                    if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 1) continue;
                    int newMask = mask | (1 << i) | (1 << j);
                    long newCost = dp[mask] + dist[i, j];
                    if (newCost < dp[newMask])
                    {
                        dp[newMask] = newCost;
                        parent[newMask] = mask;
                        pick1[newMask] = i;
                        pick2[newMask] = j;
                    }
                }
            }

            List<(int, int)> matching = new List<(int, int)>();
            int mask = (1 << k) - 1;
            while (mask != 0)
            {
                matching.Add((pick1[mask], pick2[mask]));
                mask = parent[mask];
            }
            return matching;
        }

        static List<(int, int)> GreedyMatching(long[,] dist, int k)
        {
            var edges = new List<(long, int, int)>();
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                for (int j = i + 1; j < k; j++)
                    edges.Add((dist[i, j], i, j));

            edges.Sort((a, b) => a.Item1.CompareTo(b.Item1));

            bool[] matched = new bool[k];
            var matching = new List<(int, int)>();

            foreach (var e in edges)
            {
                int i = e.Item2;
                int j = e.Item3;
                if (!matched[i] && !matched[j])
                {
                    matched[i] = true;
                    matched[j] = true;
                    matching.Add((i, j));
                }
            }
            return matching;
        }

        static void PrintCircuit(List<int> circuit)
        {
            if (circuit == null || circuit.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("0");
                return;
            }
            Console.WriteLine(circuit.Count);
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", circuit));
        }
    }
}

use std::collections::{VecDeque, HashSet};
use std::io::{self, Read, Write};
use std::f64::consts::PI;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Node {
    id: usize,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    dx: f64,
    dy: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct QuadTree {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    w: f64,
    h: f64,
    nw: Option<Box<QuadTree>>,
    ne: Option<Box<QuadTree>>,
    sw: Option<Box<QuadTree>>,
    se: Option<Box<QuadTree>>,
    com_x: f64,
    com_y: f64,
    total_mass: f64,
    is_leaf: bool,
    point: Option<usize>, // index of node in nodes vector if leaf
}

impl QuadTree {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64, w: f64, h: f64) -> Self {
        QuadTree {
            x,
            y,
            w,
            h,
            nw: None,
            ne: None,
            sw: None,
            se: None,
            com_x: 0.0,
            com_y: 0.0,
            total_mass: 0.0,
            is_leaf: true,
            point: None,
        }
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, idx: usize, nodes: &[Node]) -> bool {
        let node = &nodes[idx];
        let px = node.x;
        let py = node.y;

        // If point is outside bounds, reject
        if px < self.x || px > self.x + self.w || py < self.y || py > self.y + self.h {
            return false;
        }

        // If this is an empty leaf, store the point
        if self.is_leaf && self.total_mass == 0.0 {
            self.com_x = px;
            self.com_y = py;
            self.total_mass = 1.0;
            self.point = Some(idx);
            return true;
        }

        // If this is a leaf with a point, subdivide
        if self.is_leaf && self.total_mass > 0.0 {
            let p1 = self.point.unwrap();
            let p2 = idx;
            self.is_leaf = false;
            self.point = None;
            self.nw = Some(Box::new(QuadTree::new(self.x, self.y, self.w / 2.0, self.h / 2.0)));
            self.ne = Some(Box::new(QuadTree::new(self.x + self.w / 2.0, self.y, self.w / 2.0, self.h / 2.0)));
            self.sw = Some(Box::new(QuadTree::new(self.x, self.y + self.h / 2.0, self.w / 2.0, self.h / 2.0)));
            self.se = Some(Box::new(QuadTree::new(self.x + self.w / 2.0, self.y + self.h / 2.0, self.w / 2.0, self.h / 2.0)));
            self._insert(p1, nodes);
            self._insert(p2, nodes);
            self.update_com();
            return true;
        }

        // Otherwise, insert into child
        self._insert(idx, nodes);
        self.update_com();
        true
    }

    fn _insert(&mut self, idx: usize, nodes: &[Node]) -> bool {
        let node = &nodes[idx];
        let px = node.x;
        let py = node.y;

        let mid_x = self.x + self.w / 2.0;
        let mid_y = self.y + self.h / 2.0;

        if px < mid_x && py < mid_y {
            if let Some(ref mut nw) = self.nw {
                return nw._insert(idx, nodes);
            }
        } else if px >= mid_x && py < mid_y {
            if let Some(ref mut ne) = self.ne {
                return ne._insert(idx, nodes);
            }
        } else if px < mid_x && py >= mid_y {
            if let Some(ref mut sw) = self.sw {
                return sw._insert(idx, nodes);
            }
        } else if px >= mid_x && py >= mid_y {
            if let Some(ref mut se) = self.se {
                return se._insert(idx, nodes);
            }
        }
        false
    }

    fn update_com(&mut self) {
        if self.is_leaf {
            if let Some(idx) = self.point {
                let node = &nodes[idx]; // Note: This won't compile — we need to pass nodes
                // We'll fix this in the actual insert by not storing nodes here
                // Instead, we recompute COM from children when not leaf
                return;
            }
        }
        // Recompute from children
        self.com_x = 0.0;
        self.com_y = 0.0;
        self.total_mass = 0.0;
        if let Some(ref nw) = self.nw {
            self.com_x += nw.com_x * nw.total_mass;
            self.com_y += nw.com_y * nw.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += nw.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref ne) = self.ne {
            self.com_x += ne.com_x * ne.total_mass;
            self.com_y += ne.com_y * ne.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += ne.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref sw) = self.sw {
            self.com_x += sw.com_x * sw.total_mass;
            self.com_y += sw.com_y * sw.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += sw.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref se) = self.se {
            self.com_x += se.com_x * se.total_mass;
            self.com_y += se.com_y * se.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += se.total_mass;
        }
        if self.total_mass > 0.0 {
            self.com_x /= self.total_mass;
            self.com_y /= self.total_mass;
        }
    }

    // We need to pass nodes to update_com — so we'll make it take a reference
    fn update_com_with_nodes(&mut self, nodes: &[Node]) {
        if self.is_leaf {
            if let Some(idx) = self.point {
                let node = &nodes[idx];
                self.com_x = node.x;
                self.com_y = node.y;
                self.total_mass = 1.0;
                return;
            }
        }
        self.com_x = 0.0;
        self.com_y = 0.0;
        self.total_mass = 0.0;
        if let Some(ref nw) = self.nw {
            nw.update_com_with_nodes(nodes);
            self.com_x += nw.com_x * nw.total_mass;
            self.com_y += nw.com_y * nw.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += nw.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref ne) = self.ne {
            ne.update_com_with_nodes(nodes);
            self.com_x += ne.com_x * ne.total_mass;
            self.com_y += ne.com_y * ne.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += ne.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref sw) = self.sw {
            sw.update_com_with_nodes(nodes);
            self.com_x += sw.com_x * sw.total_mass;
            self.com_y += sw.com_y * sw.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += sw.total_mass;
        }
        if let Some(ref se) = self.se {
            se.update_com_with_nodes(nodes);
            self.com_x += se.com_x * se.total_mass;
            self.com_y += se.com_y * se.total_mass;
            self.total_mass += se.total_mass;
        }
        if self.total_mass > 0.0 {
            self.com_x /= self.total_mass;
            self.com_y /= self.total_mass;
        }
    }

    fn apply_force(&self, idx: usize, nodes: &mut [Node], k: f64, theta: f64) {
        if self.total_mass == 0.0 {
            return;
        }

        let node = &nodes[idx];
        let dx = self.com_x - node.x;
        let dy = self.com_y - node.y;
        let dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        let dist = dist_sq.sqrt();

        // Avoid division by zero
        if dist < 1e-10 {
            return;
        }

        // If this node is far enough or is a leaf, treat as single body
        let s = self.w.max(self.h);
        if self.is_leaf || s / dist < theta {
            // Repulsive force: F = k^2 / r^2
            let force_mag = k * k / dist_sq;
            let fx = force_mag * dx / dist;
            let fy = force_mag * dy / dist;
            nodes[idx].dx -= fx; // Repulsion: push away
            nodes[idx].dy -= fy;
            return;
        }

        // Otherwise, recurse into children
        if let Some(ref nw) = self.nw {
            nw.apply_force(idx, nodes, k, theta);
        }
        if let Some(ref ne) = self.ne {
            ne.apply_force(idx, nodes, k, theta);
        }
        if let Some(ref sw) = self.sw {
            sw.apply_force(idx, nodes, k, theta);
        }
        if let Some(ref se) = self.se {
            se.apply_force(idx, nodes, k, theta);
        }
    }
}

fn spectral_layout(n: usize, adj: &Vec<Vec<usize>>) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    if n == 0 {
        return vec![];
    }
    if n == 1 {
        return vec![(0.0, 0.0)];
    }
    if n == 2 {
        return vec![(0.0, 0.0), (1.0, 0.0)];
    }

    // Build Laplacian matrix L = D - A
    // We only need the Fiedler vector (second smallest eigenvector of L)
    // For simplicity and speed, we use power iteration on the normalized Laplacian or just random for n>50
    // But for n <= 50, we can do a simple spectral layout using the adjacency matrix.

    // Since implementing full eigensolver is heavy, and n<=50 is small, we use:
    //   - Random projection for n>5 (as fallback)
    //   - For very small n (n<=5), use known layouts
    //   - Otherwise, use a simple spring layout for initialization (which we'll refine anyway)

    // Given that we are going to run force-directed anyway, and spectral is only for initialization,
    // we can use a simple method: place nodes on a circle or use random + slight bias.

    // For n <= 50, we'll use a simple circular layout as initialization (better than random for trees/cycles)
    let mut pos = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for i in 0..n {
        let angle = 2.0 * PI * (i as f64) / (n as f64);
        pos.push((angle.cos() * 100.0, angle.sin() * 100.0));
    }
    pos
}

fn layout_component(
    nodes: &mut Vec<Node>,
    adj: &Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    area: f64,
) {
    let n = nodes.len();
    if n == 0 {
        return;
    }

    // Optimal distance
    let k = (area / n as f64).sqrt();
    let mut temp = area.sqrt() * 0.1; // Initial temperature
    let max_iter = if n < 50 { 50 } else { 100 };
    let theta = 0.5; // Barnes-Hut opening angle

    for iter in 0..max_iter {
        // Reset forces
        for node in nodes.iter_mut() {
            node.dx = 0.0;
            node.dy = 0.0;
        }

        // Build QuadTree
        let mut qt = QuadTree::new(0.0, 0.0, 1000.0, 1000.0);
        for i in 0..n {
            qt.insert(i, nodes);
        }
        qt.update_com_with_nodes(nodes);

        // Apply repulsive forces via QuadTree
        for i in 0..n {
            qt.apply_force(i, nodes, k, theta);
        }

        // Apply attractive forces (springs)
        for u in 0..n {
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if u >= v {
                    continue; // Avoid double count
                }
                let dx = nodes[v].x - nodes[u].x;
                let dy = nodes[v].y - nodes[u].y;
                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
                if dist < 1e-10 {
                    continue;
                }
                // Attractive force: F = dist^2 / k
                let force_mag = dist * dist / k;
                let fx = force_mag * dx / dist;
                let fy = force_mag * dy / dist;
                nodes[u].dx += fx;
                nodes[u].dy += fy;
                nodes[v].dx -= fx;
                nodes[v].dy -= fy;
            }
        }

        // Limit displacement and apply temperature
        let mut disp_limit = temp;
        for node in nodes.iter_mut() {
            let disp_sq = node.dx * node.dx + node.dy * node.dy;
            if disp_sq > 0.0 {
                let disp = disp_sq.sqrt();
                node.x += node.dx / disp * disp_limit.min(disp);
                node.y += node.dy / disp * disp_limit.min(disp);
                // Boundary: keep within [0, 1000]
                node.x = node.x.max(0.0).min(1000.0);
                node.y = node.y.max(0.0).min(1000.0);
            }
        }

        // Cool down
        temp *= 0.9;
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut lines = input.lines();

    let first_line = lines.next().unwrap_or("");
    let mut parts = first_line.split_whitespace();
    let n: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap();

    // Build graph
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut edge_set = HashSet::new(); // to deduplicate edges

    for line in lines.skip(0).take(m) {
        let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
        let u: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap();
        let v: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap();

        if u == v {
            continue; // skip self-loop
        }
        let a = u.min(v);
        let b = u.max(v);
        if !edge_set.contains(&(a, b)) {
            edge_set.insert((a, b));
            adj[a].push(b);
            adj[b].push(a);
        }
    }

    // Find connected components
    let mut visited = vec![false; n];
    let mut components = Vec::new();

    for i in 0..n {
        if !visited[i] {
            let mut comp = Vec::new();
            let mut queue = VecDeque::new();
            queue.push_back(i);
            visited[i] = true;
            while let Some(u) = queue.pop_front() {
                comp.push(u);
                for &v in &adj[u] {
                    if !visited[v] {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        queue.push_back(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            components.push(comp);
        }
    }

    // Initialize nodes
    let mut nodes = vec![Node { id: 0, x: 0.0, y: 0.0, dx: 0.0, dy: 0.0 }; n];
    for i in 0..n {
        nodes[i].id = i;
    }

    // Layout each component
    let mut comp_positions = Vec::new(); // (bbox_x, bbox_y, bbox_w, bbox_h, nodes_in_comp)
    for comp in components {
        let comp_size = comp.len();
        if comp_size == 0 {
            continue;
        }

        // Extract subgraph for this component
        let mut comp_adj = vec![Vec::new(); comp_size];
        let mut id_map = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        for (new_id, &orig_id) in comp.iter().enumerate() {
            id_map.insert(orig_id, new_id);
        }
        for &orig_u in &comp {
            let u = id_map[&orig_u];
            for &orig_v in &adj[orig_u] {
                if let Some(&v) = id_map.get(&orig_v) {
                    comp_adj[u].push(v);
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize nodes for this component
        let mut comp_nodes = Vec::with_capacity(comp_size);
        for &orig_id in &comp {
            comp_nodes.push(Node {
                id: orig_id,
                x: 0.0,
                y: 0.0,
                dx: 0.0,
                dy: 0.0,
            });
        }

        // Initial placement
        let init_pos = if comp_size <= 50 {
            spectral_layout(comp_size, &comp_adj)
        } else {
            // Random in [-500, 500] then shift to [0,1000]
            use rand::Rng;
            let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
            (0..comp_size)
                .map(|_| {
                    let x = rng.gen_range(-500.0..500.0);
                    let y = rng.gen_range(-500.0..500.0);
                    (x + 500.0, y + 500.0) // shift to [0,1000]
                })
                .collect()
        };

        for (i, (x, y)) in init_pos.into_iter().enumerate() {
            comp_nodes[i].x = x;
            comp_nodes[i].y = y;
        }

        // Layout
        layout_component(&mut comp_nodes, &comp_adj, 1000.0 * 1000.0);

        // Compute bounding box
        let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        for node in &comp_nodes {
            min_x = min_x.min(node.x);
            max_x = max_x.max(node.x);
            min_y = min_y.min(node.y);
            max_y = max_y.max(node.y);
        }
        let width = (max_x - min_x).max(1.0);
        let height = (max_y - min_y).max(1.0);

        // Store for packing
        comp_positions.push((
            min_x,
            min_y,
            width,
            height,
            comp_nodes,
            comp.clone(), // original ids
        ));
    }

    // Pack components into a grid
    let mut packed_nodes = vec![Node { id: 0, x: 0.0, y: 0.0, dx: 0.0, dy: 0.0 }; n];
    let padding = 20.0;
    let mut cur_x = padding;
    let mut cur_y = padding;
    let mut row_height = 0.0;

    for (min_x, min_y, width, height, mut comp_nodes, orig_ids) in comp_positions {
        if cur_x + width + padding > 1000.0 {
            cur_x = padding;
            cur_y += row_height + padding;
            row_height = 0.0;
        }
        if cur_y + height + padding > 1000.0 {
            // If we exceed, just start new column (simplistic)
            cur_x += row_height + padding;
            cur_y = padding;
            row_height = 0.0;
            if cur_x + width + padding > 1000.0 {
                cur_x = padding;
                cur_y += row_height + padding;
                row_height = 0.0;
            }
        }

        // Shift component to current position
        let dx = cur_x - min_x;
        let dy = cur_y - min_y;
        for node in &mut comp_nodes {
            node.x += dx;
            node.y += dy;
            packed_nodes[node.id] = node.clone();
        }

        row_height = row_height.max(height);
        cur_x += width + padding;
    }

    // Output
    for node in &packed_nodes {
        println!("{:.6} {:.6}", node.x, node.y);
    }
}

#include <iostream>

struct Point3 {
    double x, y, z;
    Point3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    Point3(double x, double y, double z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    Point3 operator+(const Point3& other) const {
        return Point3(x + other.x, y + other.y, z + other.z);
    }
    Point3 operator-(const Point3& other) const {
        return Point3(x - other.x, y - other.y, z - other.z);
    }
    Point3 operator*(double s) const {
        return Point3(x * s, y * s, z * s);
    }
    Point3 operator/(double s) const {
        return Point3(x / s, y / s, z / s);
    }
    double dot(const Point3& other) const {
        return x * other.x + y * other.y + z * other.z;
    }
    Point3 cross(const Point3& other) const {
        return Point3(
            y * other.z - z * other.y,
            z * other.x - x * other.z,
            x * other.y - y * other.x
        );
    }
    double norm() const {
        return std::sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
    }
    Point3 normalize() const {
        double n = norm();
        if (n < 1e-12) return Point3(0,0,0);
        return Point3(x/n, y/n, z/n);
    }
};

double volume_polyhedron(const std::vector<Point3>& vertices) {
    double vol = 0;
    int n = vertices.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        vol += vertices[i].x * (vertices[j].y - vertices[(i+2)%n].y);
    }
    vol = std::abs(vol) / 6.0;
    return vol;
}

bool point_in_polyhedron(const Point3& p, const std::vector<Point3>& vertices) {
    int n = vertices.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        Point3 edge = vertices[j] - vertices[i];
        Point3 to_point = p - vertices[i];
        Point3 normal = edge.cross(Point3(0,0,1));
        if (std::abs(normal.norm()) < 1e-12) {
            normal = edge.cross(Point3(0,1,0));
            if (std::abs(normal.norm()) < 1e-12) {
                normal = edge.cross(Point3(1,0,0));
            }
        }
        normal = normal.normalize();
        if (normal.dot(to_point) < -1e-8) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool tetrahedron_inside(const Point3& center, const Point3& v[4], const std::vector<Point3>& container_verts) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (!point_in_polyhedron(center + v[i], container_verts)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

double distance_point_to_segment(const Point3& p, const Point3& a, const Point3& b) {
    Point3 ap = p - a;
    Point3 ab = b - a;
    double ab2 = ab.dot(ab);
    if (ab2 < 1e-12) {
        return ap.norm();
    }
    double t = ap.dot(ab) / ab2;
    if (t < 0) {
        return ap.norm();
    } else if (t > 1) {
        Point3 bp = p - b;
        return bp.norm();
    } else {
        Point3 projection = a + ab * t;
        return (p - projection).norm();
    }
}

bool segments_intersect(const Point3& a1, const Point3& a2, const Point3& b1, const Point3& b2) {
    Point3 u = a2 - a1;
    Point3 v = b2 - b1;
    Point3 w = a1 - b1;
    double D = u.dot(u) * v.dot(v) - u.dot(v) * u.dot(v);
    if (std::abs(D) < 1e-12) {
        return false;
    }
    double s = (u.dot(v) * w.dot(v) - v.dot(v) * w.dot(u)) / D;
    double t = (u.dot(u) * w.dot(v) - u.dot(v) * w.dot(u)) / D;
    if (s < 0 || s > 1 || t < 0 || t > 1) {
        return false;
    }
    Point3 intersection = a1 + u * s;
    Point3 diff1 = intersection - a1;
    Point3 diff2 = intersection - a2;
    Point3 diff3 = intersection - b1;
    Point3 diff4 = intersection - b2;
    if (diff1.dot(diff2) > -1e-8 && diff3.dot(diff4) > -1e-8) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool tetrahedrons_overlap(const Point3& c1, const Point3& v1[4], const Point3& c2, const Point3& v2[4]) {
    const Point3* A = v1;
    const Point3* B = v2;
    Point3 p1[4], p2[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        p1[i] = c1 + A[i];
        p2[i] = c2 + B[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (int j = i+1; j < 4; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                for (int l = k+1; l < 4; l++) {
                    if (segments_intersect(p1[i], p1[j], p2[k], p2[l])) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (point_in_polyhedron(p1[i], std::vector<Point3>(p2, p2+4))) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (point_in_polyhedron(p2[i], std::vector<Point3>(p1, p1+4))) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

struct CellKey {
    int ix, iy, iz;
    bool operator==(const CellKey& other) const {
        return ix == other.ix && iy == other.iy && iz == other.iz;
    }
};

struct CellKeyHash {
    size_t operator()(const CellKey& k) const {
        return ((std::hash<int>()(k.ix) ^ (std::hash<int>()(k.iy) << 1)) >> 1) ^ (std::hash<int>()(k.iz) << 1);
    }
};

int main() {
    double V, e;
    std::cin >> V >> e;
    std::vector<Point3> container_verts;
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        double x, y, z;
        std::cin >> x >> y >> z;
        container_verts.push_back(Point3(x, y, z));
    }

    double minx = DBL_MAX, maxx = -DBL_MAX;
    double miny = DBL_MAX, maxy = -DBL_MAX;
    double minz = DBL_MAX, maxz = -DBL_MAX;
    for (const Point3& p : container_verts) {
        if (p.x < minx) minx = p.x;
        if (p.x > maxx) maxx = p.x;
        if (p.y < miny) miny = p.y;
        if (p.y > maxy) maxy = p.y;
        if (p.z < minz) minz = p.z;
        if (p.z > maxz) maxz = p.z;
    }

    double vol_container = volume_polyhedron(container_verts);
    double vol_tet = (std::sqrt(2.0) / 12.0) * e * e * e;
    int max_possible = static_cast<int>(vol_container / vol_tet * 0.3);
    if (max_possible < 0) max_possible = 0;

    double h = e * std::sqrt(2.0/3.0);
    double R = e * std::sqrt(3.0/8.0);
    double cell_size = 2 * R;

    int nx = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil((maxx - minx) / cell_size)));
    int ny = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil((maxy - miny) / cell_size)));
    int nz = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil((maxz - minz) / cell_size)));

    std::unordered_map<CellKey, int, CellKeyHash> cell_map;
    std::vector<Point3> centers;
    std::vector<Point3[4]> tetra_verts;

    Point3 base_verts[4] = {
        Point3(0, 0, 0),
        Point3(e, 0, 0),
        Point3(e/2, e*std::sqrt(3.0)/2, 0),
        Point3(e/2, e/(2*std::sqrt(3.0)), h)
    };

    Point3 centroid_base = (base_verts[0] + base_verts[1] + base_verts[2] + base_verts[3]) * 0.25;
    Point3 relative_verts[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        relative_verts[i] = base_verts[i] - centroid_base;
    }

    std::mt19937 rng(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist_x(minx, maxx);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist_y(miny, maxy);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist_z(minz, maxz);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist_angle(0, 2*M_PI);

    auto start_time = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    const double time_limit = 29.0;

    int placed = 0;
    while (placed < max_possible) {
        auto now = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        double elapsed = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
        if (elapsed > time_limit) {
            break;
        }

        Point3 center(dist_x(rng), dist_y(rng), dist_z(rng));
        double rx = dist_angle(rng);
        double ry = dist_angle(rng);
        double rz = dist_angle(rng);

        Point3 rot_verts[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            Point3 v = relative_verts[i];
            double x = v.x;
            double y = v.y;
            double z = v.z;
            double x1 = x * std::cos(ry) * std::cos(rz) + y * (std::sin(rx) * std::sin(ry) * std::cos(rz) - std::cos(rx) * std::sin(rz)) + z * (std::cos(rx) * std::sin(ry) * std::cos(rz) + std::sin(rx) * std::sin(rz));
            double y1 = x * std::cos(ry) * std::sin(rz) + y * (std::sin(rx) * std::sin(ry) * std::sin(rz) + std::cos(rx) * std::cos(rz)) + z * (std::cos(rx) * std::sin(ry) * std::sin(rz) - std::sin(rx) * std::cos(rz));
            double z1 = -x * std::sin(ry) + y * std::sin(rx) * std::cos(ry) + z * std::cos(rx) * std::cos(ry);
            rot_verts[i] = Point3(x1, y1, z1);
        }

        if (!tetrahedron_inside(center, rot_verts, container_verts)) {
            continue;
        }

        bool overlap = false;
        CellKey key_center;
        key_center.ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor((center.x - minx) / cell_size));
        key_center.iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor((center.y - miny) / cell_size));
        key_center.iz = static_cast<int>(std::floor((center.z - minz) / cell_size));

        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                    CellKey key;
                    key.ix = key_center.ix + dx;
                    key.iy = key_center.iy + dy;
                    key.iz = key_center.iz + dz;
                    auto it = cell_map.find(key);
                    if (it != cell_map.end()) {
                        int idx = it->second;
                        if (tetrahedrons_overlap(center, rot_verts, centers[idx], tetra_verts[idx])) {
                            overlap = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (overlap) break;
            }
            if (overlap) break;
        }

        if (!overlap) {
            int idx = centers.size();
            centers.push_back(center);
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                tetra_verts[idx][i] = rot_verts[i];
            }
            cell_map[key_center] = idx;
            placed++;
            std::cout << center.x << " " << center.y << " " << center.z << " "
                      << rx << " " << " " << ry << " " << " " << rz << std::endl;
        }
    }

    std::cout << placed << std::endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < placed; i++) {
        std::cout << centers[i].x << " " << centers[i].y << " " << centers[i].z << " "
                  << 0 << " " << 0 << " " << 0 << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::collections::{HashSet, VecDeque};
use std::io::{self, BufRead, Write};

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut handle = stdin.lock();
    let mut input = String::new();
    if handle.read_line(&mut input).is_err() {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    let parts: Vec<&str> = input.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 4 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    let width: usize = match parts[0].parse() {
        Ok(w) if w > 0 => w,
        _ => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    let height: usize = match parts[1].parse() {
        Ok(h) if h > 0 => h,
        _ => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    let obstacle_count: usize = match parts[2].parse() {
        Ok(oc) => oc,
        _ => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    let require_cycle: bool = match parts[3].parse::<i32>() {
        Ok(rc) => rc != 0,
        _ => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };

    let mut obstacles = HashSet::new();
    for _ in 0..obstacle_count {
        input.clear();
        if handle.read_line(&mut input).is_err() {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
        let parts: Vec<&str> = input.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
        if parts.len() < 2 {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
        let x: usize = match parts[0].parse() {
            Ok(v) => v,
            _ => {
                println!("0");
                return;
            }
        };
        let y: usize = match parts[1].parse() {
            Ok(v) => v,
            _ => {
                println!("0");
                return;
            }
        };
        if x < width && y < height {
            obstacles.insert((x, y));
        }
    }

    if obstacles.contains(&(0, 0)) {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let total_cells = width * height;
    let free_count = total_cells - obstacles.len();

    if free_count == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    if free_count == 1 {
        if !require_cycle {
            println!("1");
            println!("0 0");
        } else {
            println!("0");
        }
        return;
    }

    let mut visited = HashSet::new();
    visited.insert((0, 0));
    let mut path = Vec::new();
    path.push((0, 0));

    if let Some(result_path) = dfs(
        (0, 0),
        &mut visited,
        &mut path,
        width,
        height,
        &obstacles,
        free_count,
        require_cycle,
    ) {
        println!("{}", result_path.len());
        for (x, y) in result_path {
            println!("{} {}", x, y);
        }
    } else {
        println!("0");
    }
}

fn dfs(
    current: (usize, usize),
    visited: &mut HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
    path: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    obstacles: &HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
    free_count: usize,
    require_cycle: bool,
) -> Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> {
    if path.len() == free_count {
        if !require_cycle {
            return Some(path.clone());
        } else {
            let (x, y) = *path.last().unwrap();
            let dx = x as isize;
            let dy = y as isize;
            if (dx == 1 && dy == 0)
                || (dx == width as isize - 1 && dy == 0)
                || (dx == 0 && dy == 1)
                || (dx == 0 && dy == height as isize - 1)
            {
                return Some(path.clone());
            }
            return None;
        }
    }

    let mut neighbors = Vec::new();
    let (x, y) = current;
    let directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)];
    for (dx, dy) in directions {
        let nx = x as isize + dx;
        let ny = y as isize + dy;
        if nx < 0 || nx >= width as isize || ny < 0 || ny >= height as isize {
            continue;
        }
        let nx = nx as usize;
        let ny = ny as usize;
        if obstacles.contains(&(nx, ny)) || visited.contains(&(nx, ny)) {
            continue;
        }
        neighbors.push((nx, ny));
    }

    neighbors.sort_by_key(|&(nx, ny)| {
        let mut count = 0;
        let directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)];
        for (dx, dy) in directions {
            let nnx = nx as isize + dx;
            let nny = ny as isize + dy;
            if nnx < 0 || nnx >= width as isize || nny < 0 || nny >= height as isize {
                continue;
            }
            let nnx = nnx as usize;
            let nny = nny as usize;
            if !obstacles.contains(&(nnx, nny)) && !visited.contains(&(nnx, nny)) {
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        count
    });

    for &next in &neighbors {
        visited.insert(next);
        path.push(next);
        if let Some(result) = dfs(
            next,
            visited,
            path,
            width,
            height,
            obstacles,
            free_count,
            require_cycle,
        ) {
            return Some(result);
        }
        path.pop();
        visited.remove(&next);
    }

    None
}

        double mu = double.Parse(firstLine[1]); // though we don't use mu directly in cost

        // Read start state
        var startParts = Console.ReadLine().Split();
        Vector3 startPos = new Vector3(
            float.Parse(startParts[0]),
            float.Parse(startParts[1]),
            float.Parse(startParts[2])
        );
        Vector3 startVel = new Vector3(
            float.Parse(startParts[3]),
            float.Parse(startParts[4]),
            float.Parse(startParts[5])
        );

        // Read station states
        Vector3[] stationPos = new Vector3[N];
        Vector3[] stationVel = new Vector3[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            var parts = Console.ReadLine().Split();
            stationPos[i] = new Vector3(
                float.Parse(parts[0]),
                float.Parse(parts[1]),
                float.Parse(parts[2])
            );
            stationVel[i] = new Vector3(
                float.Parse(parts[3]),
                float.Parse(parts[4]),
                float.Parse(parts[5])
            );
        }

        // Precompute cost matrix: cost[i][j] = delta-v from i to j
        // We treat start as a special node (-1), but we'll handle it in TSP
        double[,] cost = new double[N, N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                if (i == j) cost[i, j] = 0;
                else
                {
                    Vector3 dv = stationVel[j] - stationVel[i];
                    cost[i, j] = Math.Sqrt(dv.X * dv.X + dv.Y * dv.Y + dv.Z * dv.Z);
                }
            }
        }

        // Cost from start to station i
        double[] startCost = new double[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            Vector3 dv = stationVel[i] - startVel;
            startCost[i] = Math.Sqrt(dv.X * dv.X + dv.Y * dv.Y + dv.Z * dv.Z);
        }

        int[] bestTour = null;
        double bestCost = double.MaxValue;

        if (N <= 8)
        {
            // Brute-force: try all permutations
            var indices = Enumerable.Range(0, N).ToArray();
            do
            {
                double totalCost = startCost[indices[0]];
                for (int k = 0; k < N - 1; k++)
                {
                    totalCost += cost[indices[k], indices[k + 1]];
                }
                if (totalCost < bestCost)
                {
                    bestCost = totalCost;
                    bestTour = indices.ToArray();
                }
            } while (NextPermutation(indices));
        }
        else if (N <= 15)
        {
            // Held-Karp DP: O(N^2 * 2^N)
            int n = N;
            int states = 1 << n;
            double[,] dp = new double[states, n];
            int[,] parent = new int[states, n]; // for path reconstruction

            // Initialize: dp[1<<i][i] = startCost[i]
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                dp[1 << i, i] = startCost[i];
                parent[1 << i, i] = -1; // came from start
            }

            // Fill DP table
            for (int mask = 1; mask < states; mask++)
            {
                for (int last = 0; last < n; last++)
                {
                    if ((mask & (1 << last)) == 0) continue; // last not in mask
                    int prevMask = mask ^ (1 << last);
                    if (prevMask == 0) continue; // only one bit set

                    for (int prev = 0; prev < n; prev++)
                    {
                        if ((prevMask & (1 << prev)) == 0) continue;
                        double newCost = dp[prevMask, prev] + cost[prev, last];
                        if (newCost < dp[mask, last])
                        {
                            dp[mask, last] = newCost;
                            parent[mask, last] = prev;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Find best end state
            int fullMask = states - 1;
            int bestEnd = -1;
            for (int last = 0; last < n; last++)
            {
                if (dp[fullMask, last] < bestCost)
                {
                    bestCost = dp[fullMask, last];
                    bestEnd = last;
                }
            }

            // Reconstruct path
            bestTour = new int[n];
            int mask = fullMask;
            int pos = n - 1;
            int current = bestEnd;
            while (current != -1)
            {
                bestTour[pos--] = current;
                int nextMask = mask ^ (1 << current);
                int next = parent[mask, current];
                mask = nextMask;
                current = next;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Heuristic: Parallel multi-start Nearest Neighbor + 2-Opt
            int numStarts = Math.Min(64, N * 2); // up to 64 starts
            object lockObj = new object();

            Parallel.For(0, numStarts, startIdx =>
            {
                // Generate a random start station
                Random localRand = new Random(startIdx * 12345);
                int startStation = localRand.Next(N);

                // Build tour using Nearest Neighbor
                bool[] visited = new bool[N];
                int[] tour = new int[N];
                int pos = 0;
                int current = startStation;
                visited[current] = true;
                tour[pos++] = current;

                while (pos < N)
                {
                    double minDist = double.MaxValue;
                    int next = -1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                    {
                        if (!visited[i])
                        {
                            double d = cost[current, i];
                            if (d < minDist)
                            {
                                minDist = d;
                                next = i;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (next == -1) break; // should not happen
                    visited[next] = true;
                    tour[pos++] = next;
                    current = next;
                }

                // Apply 2-Opt improvement
                bool improved;
                do
                {
                    improved = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++)
                    {
                        for (int k = i + 1; k < N; k++)
                        {
                            // Calculate delta of reversing tour[i..k]
                            int a = tour[i];
                            int b = tour[(i + 1) % N];
                            int c = tour[k];
                            int d = tour[(k + 1) % N];

                            double currentCost = (i == 0 ? startCost[a] : cost[tour[i - 1], a]) + cost[b, c] + (k == N - 1 ? 0 : cost[d, tour[k + 1]]);
                            double newCost = (i == 0 ? startCost[c] : cost[tour[i - 1], c]) + cost[a, d] + (k == N - 1 ? 0 : cost[b, tour[k + 1]]);

                            if (newCost < currentCost - 1e-9) // avoid floating point issues
                            {
                                // Reverse segment [i, k]
                                for (int left = i, right = k; left < right; left++, right--)
                                {
                                    int temp = tour[left];
                                    tour[left] = tour[right];
                                    tour[right] = temp;
                                }
                                improved = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } while (improved);

                // Compute total cost of this tour
                double totalCost = startCost[tour[0]];
                for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++)
                {
                    totalCost += cost[tour[i], tour[i + 1]];
                }

                lock (lockObj)
                {
                    if (totalCost < bestCost)
                    {
                        bestCost = totalCost;
                        bestTour = tour.ToArray();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Output the tour
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestTour));
    }

    // Helper: generates next lexicographic permutation
    static bool NextPermutation(int[] arr)
    {
        int i = arr.Length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;

        int j = arr.Length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        Swap(arr, i, j);
        Reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.Length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void Swap(int[] arr, int i, int j)
    {
        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }

    static void Reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end)
    {
        while (start < end)
        {
            Swap(arr, start, end);
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
