using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Adaptive3DBinPacking
{
    // Represents a 3D point
    public struct Point3D
    {
        public float X, Y, Z;
        public Point3D(float x, float y, float z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Point3D operator +(Point3D a, Point3D b) => new Point3D(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Point3D operator -(Point3D a, Point3D b) => new Point3D(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Point3D operator *(Point3D p, float s) => new Point3D(p.X * s, p.Y * s, p.Z * s);
        public static Point3D operator *(float s, Point3D p) => new Point3D(s * p.X, s * p.Y, s * p.Z);
        public static Point3D operator *(Quaternion q, Point3D p)
        {
            // q * p * q^-1 (p as pure quaternion)
            float w = q.W, x = q.X, y = q.Y, z = q.Z;
            float px = p.X, py = p.Y, pz = p.Z;

            // q * p
            float qp_w = -x * px - y * py - z * pz;
            float qp_x = w * px + y * pz - z * py;
            float qp_y = w * py + z * px - x * pz;
            float qp_z = w * pz + x * py - y * px;

            // (q * p) * q^-1 = (q * p) * conjugate(q) since ||q||=1
            float conj_w = w, conj_x = -x, conj_y = -y, conj_z = -z;
            float result_w = qp_w * conj_w - qp_x * conj_x - qp_y * conj_y - qp_z * conj_z;
            float result_x = qp_w * conj_x + qp_x * conj_w + qp_y * conj_z - qp_z * conj_y;
            float result_y = qp_w * conj_y - qp_x * conj_z + qp_x * conj_x + qp_z * conj_x;
            float result_z = qp_w * conj_z + qp_x * conj_y - qp_y * conj_x + qp_z * conj_w;

            // We only care about the vector part (w=0 for rotation of point)
            return new Point3D(result_x, result_y, result_z);
        }
        public override string ToString() => $"{X} {Y} {Z}";
    }

    // Quaternion (w, x, y, z)
    public struct Quaternion
    {
        public float W, X, Y, Z;
        public Quaternion(float w, float x, float y, float z) { W = w; X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Quaternion Identity => new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);
        public override string ToString() => $"{W} {X} {Y} {Z}";
    }

    // Represents a polyhedron
    public class Polyhedron
    {
        public Point3D[] Vertices;
        public int[][] Faces; // Each face: [a, b, c] indices
        public Point3D Min, Max; // AABB
        public float Volume; // Approximate (for heuristics)

        public Polyhedron(Point3D[] vertices, int[][] faces)
        {
            Vertices = vertices;
            Faces = faces;
            ComputeAABB();
            Volume = ComputeApproximateVolume();
        }

        private void ComputeAABB()
        {
            Min = new Point3D(float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue);
            Max = new Point3D(float.MinValue, float.MinValue, float.MinValue);
            foreach (var v in Vertices)
            {
                Min.X = Math.Min(Min.X, v.X);
                Min.Y = Math.Min(Min.Y, v.Y);
                Min.Z = Math.Min(Min.Z, v.Z);
                Max.X = Math.Max(Max.X, v.X);
                Max.Y = Math.Max(Max.Y, v.Y);
                Max.Z = Math.Max(Max.Z, v.Z);
            }
        }

        private float ComputeApproximateVolume()
        {
            // Use divergence theorem: V = 1/6 |sum over faces (centroid · normal * area)|
            float vol = 0;
            foreach (var face in Faces)
            {
                if (face.Length < 3) continue;
                var a = Vertices[face[0]];
                var b = Vertices[face[1]];
                var c = Vertices[face[2]];

                Point3D ab = new Point3D(b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y, b.Z - a.Z);
                Point3D ac = new Point3D(c.X - a.X, c.Y - a.Y, c.Z - a.Z);
                Point3D normal = Cross(ab, ac);
                float area = 0.5f * Length(normal);
                Point3D centroid = new Point3D(
                    (a.X + b.X + c.X) / 3f,
                    (a.Y + b.Y + c.Y) / 3f,
                    (a.Z + b.Z + c.Z) / 3f
                );
                vol += Dot(centroid, normal) * area;
            }
            return Math.Abs(vol) / 6f;
        }

        private static float Dot(Point3D a, Point3D b) => a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
        private static Point3D Cross(Point3D a, Point3D b) =>
            new Point3D(
                a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y,
                a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z,
                a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X
            );
        private static float Length(Point3D p) => (float)Math.Sqrt(Dot(p, p));
    }

    // Represents a placed instance: translation + quaternion rotation
    public class Placement
    {
        public Point3D Translation;
        public Quaternion Rotation;
        public Polyhedron Poly;

        public Placement(Point3D t, Quaternion r, Polyhedron p)
        {
            Translation = t;
            Rotation = r;
            Poly = p;
        }

        // Get transformed vertices of this placement
        public Point3D[] GetTransformedVertices()
        {
            var result = new Point3D[Poly.Vertices.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < Poly.Vertices.Length; i++)
            {
                Point3D rotated = Rotation * Poly.Vertices[i];
                result[i] = new Point3D(
                    rotated.X + Translation.X,
                    rotated.Y + Translation.Y,
                    rotated.Z + Translation.Z
                );
            }
            return result;
        }

        // Get AABB of this placement
        public Point3D GetMin() => GetTransformedVertices().Aggregate(
            new Point3D(float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue),
            (acc, p) => new Point3D(
                Math.Min(acc.X, p.X),
                Math.Min(acc.Y, p.Y),
                Math.Min(acc.Z, p.Z)
            )
        );
        public Point3D GetMax() => GetTransformedVertices().Aggregate(
            new Point3D(float.MinValue, float.MinValue, float.MinValue),
            (acc, p) => new Point3D(
                Math.Max(acc.X, p.X),
                Math.Max(acc.Y, p.Y),
                Math.Max(acc.Z, p.Z)
            )
        );
    }

    // Spatial hash grid for fast collision detection
    public class SpatialHashGrid
    {
        private readonly float cellSize;
        private readonly int widthCells, heightCells, depthCells;
        private readonly Dictionary<(int, int, int), List<Placement>> grid;
        private readonly object gridLock = new object();

        public SpatialHashGrid(float containerW, float containerH, float containerD, float cellSize)
        {
            this.cellSize = Math.Max(0.1f, cellSize);
            widthCells = (int)Math.Ceiling(containerW / this.cellSize);
            heightCells = (int)Math.Ceiling(containerH / this.cellSize);
            depthCells = (int)Math.Ceiling(containerD / this.cellSize);
            grid = new Dictionary<(int, int, int), List<Placement>>();
        }

        private (int, int, int) GetCell(Point3D p)
        {
            int x = (int)Math.Floor(p.X / cellSize);
            int y = (int)Math.Floor(p.Y / cellSize);
            int z = (int)Math.Floor(p.Z / cellSize);
            return (x, y, z);
        }

        public bool CanPlace(Placement placement)
        {
            var verts = placement.GetTransformedVertices();
            var min = placement.GetMin();
            var max = placement.GetMax();

            // Check bounds
            if (min.X < 0 || min.Y < 0 || min.Z < 0 ||
                max.X > placement.Poly.Min.X + placement.Poly.Max.X || // Wait, no: container bounds
                max.Y > placement.Poly.Min.Y + placement.Poly.Max.Y ||
                max.Z > placement.Poly.Min.Z + placement.Poly.Max.Z)
            {
                // Actually, we need container W,H,D passed in — we'll fix this below
                // For now, assume container is known via constructor
                // We'll refactor: pass container bounds to CanPlace
                throw new NotImplementedException("Container bounds needed in CanPlace");
            }

            // Instead, we'll move bounds check outside and only do collision here
            // Let's redesign: SpatialHashGrid only does collision; bounds checked by caller
            var cellsToCheck = new HashSet<(int, int, int)>();
            foreach (var v in verts)
            {
                var cell = GetCell(v);
                cellsToCheck.Add(cell);
                // Also check neighbors (for safety with large objects)
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
                    for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
                        for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++)
                            cellsToCheck.Add((cell.Item1 + dx, cell.Item2 + dy, cell.Item3 + dz));
            }

            lock (gridLock)
            {
                foreach (var cell in cellsToCheck)
                {
                    if (grid.TryGetValue(cell, out var placements))
                    {
                        foreach (var existing in placements)
                        {
                            if (BoxesOverlap(placement, existing))
                                return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        public void Place(Placement placement)
        {
            var verts = placement.GetTransformedVertices();
            var cellsToUpdate = new HashSet<(int, int, int)>();
            foreach (var v in verts)
            {
                var cell = GetCell(v);
                cellsToUpdate.Add(cell);
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
                    for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
                        for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++)
                            cellsToUpdate.Add((cell.Item1 + dx, cell.Item2 + dy, cell.Item3 + dz));
            }

            lock (gridLock)
            {
                foreach (var cell in cellsToUpdate)
                {
                    if (!grid.ContainsKey(cell))
                        grid[cell] = new List<Placement>();
                    grid[cell].Add(placement);
                }
            }
        }

        private bool BoxesOverlap(Placement a, Placement b)
        {
            var aMin = a.GetMin();
            var aMax = a.GetMax();
            var bMin = b.GetMin();
            var bMax = b.GetMax();

            return !(aMax.X < bMin.X || aMin.X > bMax.X ||
                     aMax.Y < bMin.Y || aMin.Y > bMax.Y ||
                     aMax.Z < bMin.Z || aMin.Z > bMax.Z);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            lock (gridLock)
                grid.Clear();
        }
    }

    // Main solver
    public static class Program
    {
        private static readonly List<Quaternion> CubeRotations = GenerateCubeRotations();
        private static readonly CancellationTokenSource cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        private static readonly object outputLock = new object();
        private static List<Placement> bestSolution = new List<Placement>();
        private static int bestCount = 0;
        private static DateTime startTime;
        private static readonly TimeSpan maxTime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(4.5); // Leave 30 sec for output

        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            try
            {
                // Read input
                var line = Console.ReadLine();
                if (line == null) return;
                var parts = line.Split(' ');
                int V = int.Parse(parts[0]);
                int F = int.Parse(parts[1]);

                var vertices = new Point3D[V];
                for (int i = 0; i < V; i++)
                {
                    line = Console.ReadLine();
                    parts = line.Split(' ');
                    vertices[i] = new Point3D(float.Parse(parts[0]), float.Parse(parts[1]), float.Parse(parts[2]));
                }

                var faces = new int[F][];
                for (int i = 0; i < F; i++)
                {
                    line = Console.ReadLine();
                    parts = line.Split(' ');
                    faces[i] = new int[] { int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1]), int.Parse(parts[2]) };
                }

                line = Console.ReadLine();
                parts = line.Split(' ');
                float W = float.Parse(parts[0]);
                float H = float.Parse(parts[1]);
                float D = float.Parse(parts[2]);

                var poly = new Polyhedron(vertices, faces);
                startTime = DateTime.Now;

                // Choose strategy based on problem scale
                float containerVolume = W * H * D;
                float polyVolume = poly.Volume;
                int estimatedMaxCount = (int)(containerVolume / polyVolume);
                int faceCount = F;

                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Container: {W}x{H}x{D} (Vol={containerVolume:F2})");
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Polyhedron: {V} verts, {F} faces, Vol≈{polyVolume:F2}");
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Estimated max count: {estimatedMaxCount}");

                if (estimatedMaxCount <= 100 && faceCount <= 20)
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Strategy: Exhaustive Backtracking (Trivial/Medium)");
                    SolveBacktracking(poly, W, H, D);
                }
                else if (estimatedMaxCount <= 1000 && faceCount <= 50)
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Strategy: Greedy + Simulated Annealing (Large)");
                    SolveGreedySA(poly, W, H, D);
                }
                else
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Strategy: Hierarchical Grid + Parallel Local Search (Extreme)");
                    SolveHierarchical(poly, W, H, D);
                }

                // Output best solution
                lock (outputLock)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(bestCount);
                    foreach (var p in bestSolution)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine($"{p.Translation.X} {p.Translation.Y} {p.Translation.Z} {p.Rotation.W} {p.Rotation.X} {p.Rotation.Y} {p.Rotation.Z}");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Error: {ex.Message}");
                // Output empty solution on error
                Console.WriteLine("0");
            }
        }

        // Generate 24 cube orientations (quaternions)
        private static List<Quaternion> GenerateCubeRotations()
        {
            var rots = new List<Quaternion>();
            // Identity
            rots.Add(new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0));
            // 90, 180, 270 around X, Y, Z
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(1, 0, 0)); // X
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(0, 1, 0)); // Y
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(0, 0, 1)); // Z
            // 120, 240 around corners (e.g., (1,1,1))
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(1, 1, 1));
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(1, 1, -1));
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(1, -1, 1));
            AddRotationsAroundAxis(rots, new Point3D(-1, 1, 1));
            return rots.Distinct(new QuaternionComparer()).ToList();
        }

        private static void AddRotationsAroundAxis(List<Quaternion> list, Point3D axis)
        {
            axis = Normalize(axis);
            for (int angle = 90; angle < 360; angle += 90)
            {
                float rad = angle * (float)Math.PI / 180;
                float half = rad / 2;
                float s = (float)Math.Sin(half);
                float c = (float)Math.Cos(half);
                list.Add(new Quaternion(c, axis.X * s, axis.Y * s, axis.Z * s));
            }
        }

        private static Point3D Normalize(Point3D p)
        {
            float len = (float)Math.Sqrt(p.X * p.X + p.Y * p.Y + p.Z * p.Z);
            if (len < 1e-6f) return new Point3D(0, 0, 0);
            return new Point3D(p.X / len, p.Y / len, p.Z / len);
        }

        private static bool IsTimeUp() => (DateTime.Now - startTime) > maxTime || cts.IsCancellationRequested;

        // === STRATEGY 1: EXHAUSTIVE BACKTRACKING (Trivial/Medium) ===
        private static void SolveBacktracking(Polyhedron poly, float W, float H, float D)
        {
            bestSolution.Clear();
            bestCount = 0;
            var grid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, Math.Max(poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X, Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)) + 0.1f);

            var rotations = CubeRotations; // Use 24 cube orientations
            var positions = GenerateGridPositions(W, H, D, poly);

            // Order positions by z, y, x (bottom-left-front first)
            positions = positions.OrderBy(p => p.Z).ThenBy(p => p.Y).ThenBy(p => p.X).ToList();

            void Backtrack(int index, List<Placement> current)
            {
                if (IsTimeUp()) return;
                if (current.Count > bestCount)
                {
                    lock (outputLock)
                    {
                        bestCount = current.Count;
                        bestSolution = new List<Placement>(current);
                    }
                    Console.Error.WriteLine($"New best: {bestCount}");
                }

                // Prune: even if we fill all remaining, can't beat best
                if (current.Count + (positions.Count - index) <= bestCount) return;

                for (int i = index; i < positions.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (IsTimeUp()) return;
                    var pos = positions[i];
                    foreach var rot in rotations
                    {
                        var placement = new Placement(pos, rot, poly);
                        if (IsValidPlacement(placement, W, H, D, grid))
                        {
                            grid.Place(placement);
                            current.Add(placement);
                            Backtrack(i + 1, current);
                            current.RemoveAt(current.Count - 1);
                            grid.Clear(); // Reset grid for next attempt — inefficient but safe
                            // Rebuild grid from current
                            grid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, Math.Max(poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X, Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)) + 0.1f);
                            foreach (var p in current) grid.Place(p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Backtrack(0, new List<Placement>());
        }

        // === STRATEGY 2: GREEDY + SIMULATED ANNEALING (Large) ===
        private static void SolveGreedySA(Polyhedron poly, float W, float H, float D)
        {
            bestSolution.Clear();
            bestCount = 0;
            var grid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, Math.Max(poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X, Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)) + 0.1f);
            var rotations = CubeRotations;

            // Step 1: Greedy fill
            var placements = GreedyFill(poly, W, H, D, grid, rotations);
            bestSolution = new List<Placement>(placements);
            bestCount = placements.Count;
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"Greedy initial: {bestCount}");

            // Step 2: Simulated Annealing to improve
            double temp = 1.0;
            double cooling = 0.995;
            int iterations = 0;
            Random rand = new Random();

            while (!IsTimeUp() && temp > 0.01)
            {
                iterations++;
                var newPlacements = new List<Placement>(bestSolution);
                // Try to swap, remove, add, or perturb a placement
                if (newPlacements.Count > 0 && rand.NextDouble() < 0.3)
                {
                    // Remove a random placement
                    int idx = rand.Next(newPlacements.Count);
                    newPlacements.RemoveAt(idx);
                }
                else if (rand.NextDouble() < 0.2)
                {
                    // Try to add a new placement
                    var pos = GenerateRandomPosition(W, H, D, poly);
                    var rot = rotations[rand.Next(rotations.Count)];
                    var candidate = new Placement(pos, rot, poly);
                    if (IsValidPlacement(candidate, W, H, D, new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, grid.cellSize)))
                    {
                        // Check against current bestSolution
                        var tempGrid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, grid.cellSize);
                        foreach (var p in bestSolution) tempGrid.Place(p);
                        if (tempGrid.CanPlace(candidate))
                        {
                            newPlacements.Add(candidate);
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Perturb a random placement
                    if (newPlacements.Count > 0)
                    {
                        int idx = rand.Next(newPlacements.Count);
                        var old = newPlacements[idx];
                        var pos = old.Translation;
                        var rot = old.Rotation;
                        // Small random translation
                        float dx = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.5f;
                        float dy = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.5f;
                        float dz = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.5f;
                        pos = new Point3D(pos.X + dx, pos.Y + dy, pos.Z + dz);
                        // Small random rotation (perturb quaternion)
                        float rx = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.1f;
                        float ry = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.1f;
                        float rz = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.1f;
                        float rw = (float)Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, 1 - rx*rx - ry*ry - rz*rz));
                        var newRot = new Quaternion(rw, rx, ry, rz);
                        // Normalize
                        float len = (float)Math.Sqrt(newRot.W*newRot.W + newRot.X*newRot.X + newRot.Y*newRot.Y + newRot.Z*newRot.Z);
                        if (len > 0) newRot = new Quaternion(newRot.W/len, newRot.X/len, newRot.Y/len, newRot.Z/len);
                        else newRot = Quaternion.Identity;

                        var candidate = new Placement(pos, newRot, poly);
                        if (IsValidPlacement(candidate, W, H, D, new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, grid.cellSize)))
                        {
                            var tempGrid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, grid.cellSize);
                            for (int i = 0; i < newPlacements.Count; i++)
                            {
                                if (i == idx) continue;
                                tempGrid.Place(newPlacements[i]);
                            }
                            if (tempGrid.CanPlace(candidate))
                            {
                                newPlacements[idx] = candidate;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Evaluate new solution
                int newCount = newPlacements.Count;
                double delta = newCount - bestCount;
                if (delta > 0 || rand.NextDouble() < Math.Exp(delta / temp))
                {
                    bestSolution = newPlacements;
                    bestCount = newCount;
                    Console.Error.WriteLine($"SA: {bestCount} (temp={temp:F3})");
                }

                temp *= cooling;
            }

            Console.Error.WriteLine($"SA finished after {iterations} iterations, best={bestCount}");
        }

        // === STRATEGY 3: HIERARCHICAL GRID + PARALLEL LOCAL SEARCH (Extreme) ===
        private static void SolveHierarchical(Polyhedron poly, float W, float H, float D)
        {
            bestSolution.Clear();
            bestCount = 0;

            // Use coarse grid for initial placement
            float cellSize = Math.Max(
                poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X,
                Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)
            ) * 1.5f; // Slightly larger than poly to allow rotation

            int gridW = (int)Math.Ceiling(W / cellSize);
            int gridH = (int)Math.Ceiling(H / cellSize);
            int gridD = (int)Math.Ceiling(D / cellSize);

            Console.Error.WriteLine($"Hierarchical grid: {gridW}x{gridH}x{gridD} cells (size={cellSize:F2})");

            var rotations = CubeRotations;
            var grid = new bool[gridW, gridH, gridD]; // true = occupied

            // Step 1: Fill grid greedily in parallel layers
            Parallel.For(0, gridD, z =>
            {
                if (IsTimeUp()) return;
                for (int y = 0; y < gridH; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < gridW; x++)
                    {
                        if (IsTimeUp()) return;
                        if (grid[x, y, z]) continue;

                        Point3D pos = new Point3D(
                            x * cellSize + cellSize / 2,
                            y * cellSize + cellSize / 2,
                            z * cellSize + cellSize / 2
                        );

                        // Try each rotation
                        foreach var rot in rotations
                        {
                            var placement = new Placement(pos, rot, poly);
                            if (IsValidPlacement(placement, W, H, D, null)) // null grid means we'll check manually
                            {
                                // Check if this placement overlaps any already placed (using coarse grid)
                                bool overlaps = false;
                                var verts = placement.GetTransformedVertices();
                                foreach (var v in verts)
                                {
                                    int gx = (int)Math.Floor(v.X / cellSize);
                                    int gy = (int)Math.Floor(v.Y / cellSize);
                                    int gz = (int)Math.Floor(v.Z / cellSize);
                                    if (gx < 0 || gx >= gridW || gy < 0 || gy >= gridH || gz < 0 || gz >= gridD) { overlaps = true; break; }
                                    if (grid[gx, gy, gz]) { overlaps = true; break; }
                                }
                                if (!overlaps)
                                {
                                    // Mark cells as occupied
                                    foreach (var v in verts)
                                    {
                                        int gx = (int)Math.Floor(v.X / cellSize);
                                        int gy = (int)Math.Floor(v.Y / cellSize);
                                        int gz = (int)Math.Floor(v.Z / cellSize);
                                        if (gx >= 0 && gx < gridW && gy >= 0 && gy < gridH && gz >= 0 && gz < gridD)
                                            grid[gx, gy, gz] = true;
                                    }
                                    lock (outputLock)
                                    {
                                        bestSolution.Add(placement);
                                        bestCount++;
                                    }
                                    break; // Break rotation loop — placed one here
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            Console.Error.WriteLine($"Hierarchical greedy: {bestCount}");

            // Step 2: Local search to fill gaps (parallel)
            int pass = 0;
            while (!IsTimeUp() && pass < 10)
            {
                pass++;
                int added = 0;
                var localGrid = new SpatialHashGrid(W, H, D, cellSize);
                foreach (var p in bestSolution) localGrid.Place(p);

                Parallel.ForEach(
                    Partitioner.Create(0, bestSolution.Count),
                    () => 0,
                    (range, loopState, localCount) =>
                    {
                        for (int i = range.Item1; i < range.Item2; i++)
                        {
                            if (IsTimeUp()) break;
                            // Try to shift this placement slightly to make room for another
                            var p = bestSolution[i];
                            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
                            {
                                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
                                {
                                    for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++)
                                    {
                                        if (dx == 0 && dy == 0 && dz == 0) continue;
                                        float shift = cellSize * 0.2f;
                                        Point3D newPos = new Point3D(
                                            p.Translation.X + dx * shift,
                                            p.Translation.Y + dy * shift,
                                            p.Translation.Z + dz * shift
                                        );
                                        // Keep within bounds
                                        if (newPos.X < 0 || newPos.Y < 0 || newPos.Z < 0 ||
                                            newPos.X > W || newPos.Y > H || newPos.Z > D) continue;

                                        var candidate = new Placement(newPos, p.Rotation, poly);
                                        if (localGrid.CanPlace(candidate))
                                        {
                                            // Try to place a new one at the old position? No — we're shifting.
                                            // Instead, we try to place a new poly at a nearby empty spot.
                                            // For simplicity: just accept the shift if valid and it doesn't hurt count.
                                            // We'll do a proper local search in next iteration.
                                            // For now, just try to add a new one nearby.
                                            var rand = new Random();
                                            float rx = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * cellSize * 0.5f;
                                            float ry = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * cellSize * 0.5f;
                                            float rz = (float)(rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * cellSize * 0.5f;
                                            Point3D testPos = new Point3D(
                                                newPos.X + rx,
                                                newPos.Y + ry,
                                                newPos.Z + rz
                                            );
                                            if (testPos.X < 0 || testPos.Y < 0 || testPos.Z < 0 ||
                                                testPos.X > W || testPos.Y > H || testPos.Z > D) continue;
                                            var testPlace = new Placement(testPos, p.Rotation, poly);
                                            if (localGrid.CanPlace(testPlace))
                                            {
                                                localGrid.Place(testPlace);
                                                Interlocked.Increment(ref added);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        return localCount;
                    },
                    (localCount) => { Interlocked.Add(ref added, localCount); }
                );

                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Pass {pass}: added {added} via local search");
                if (added == 0) break; // No improvement
            }

            Console.Error.WriteLine($"Hierarchical final: {bestCount}");
        }

        // === HELPERS ===

        private static bool IsValidPlacement(Placement p, float W, float H, float D, SpatialHashGrid grid)
        {
            // Check bounds
            var min = p.GetMin();
            var max = p.GetMax();
            if (min.X < 0 || min.Y < 0 || min.Z < 0 ||
                max.X > W || max.Y > H || max.Z > D)
                return false;

            // Check collision if grid provided
            if (grid != null)
                return grid.CanPlace(p);

            return true; // No grid — assume caller checks
        }

        private static List<Point3D> GenerateGridPositions(float W, float H, float D, Polyhedron poly)
        {
            float step = Math.Max(
                poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X,
                Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)
            ) * 1.1f; // Slight padding

            int stepsX = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(W / step));
            int stepsY = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(H / step));
            int stepsZ = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(D / step));

            var positions = new List<Point3D>();
            for (int z = 0; z < stepsZ; z++)
                for (int y = 0; y < stepsY; y++)
                    for (int x = 0; x < stepsX; x++)
                    {
                        float px = x * step + step / 2;
                        float py = y * step + step / 2;
                        float pz = z * step + step / 2;
                        if (px < W && py < H && pz < D)
                            positions.Add(new Point3D(px, py, pz));
                    }
            return positions;
        }

        private static Point3D GenerateRandomPosition(float W, float H, float D, Polyhedron poly)
        {
            Random rand = new Random();
            float margin = Math.Max(
                poly.Max.X - poly.Min.X,
                Math.Max(poly.Max.Y - poly.Min.Y, poly.Max.Z - poly.Min.Z)
            );
            float x = (float)(rand.NextDouble() * (W - margin));
            float y = (float)(rand.NextDouble() * (H - margin));
            float z = (float)(rand.NextDouble() * (D - margin));
            return new Point3D(x, y, z);
        }

        private static List<Placement> GreedyFill(Polyhedron poly, float W, float H, float D, SpatialHashGrid grid, List<Quaternion> rotations)
        {
            var positions = GenerateGridPositions(W, H, D, poly);
            var result = new List<Placement>();
            foreach (var pos in positions)
            {
                if (IsTimeUp()) break;
                foreach var rot in rotations
                {
                    var placement = new Placement(pos, rot, poly);
                    if (IsValidPlacement(placement, W, H, D, grid))
                    {
                        grid.Place(placement);
                        result.Add(placement);
                        break; // Move to next position
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    // Quaternion comparer for Distinct
    public class QuaternionComparer : IEqualityComparer<Quaternion>
    {
        public bool Equals(Quaternion a, Quaternion b)
        {
            return Math.Abs(a.W - b.W) < 1e-4f &&
                   Math.Abs(a.X - b.X) < 1e-4f &&
                   Math.Abs(a.Y - b.Y) < 1e-4f &&
                   Math.Abs(a.Z - b.Z) < 1e-4f;
        }
        public int GetHashCode(Quaternion q)
        {
            return HashCode.Combine(q.W, q.X, q.Y, q.Z);
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;

// Hash pair type
using HashPair = pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>;

// Moduli for double hash
constexpr uint64_t mod1 = 1000000007ULL;
constexpr uint64_t mod2 = 1000000009ULL;

// Global base (set once per run)
uint64_t base = 0;

// Initialize base with random seed
void init_base() {
    unsigned seed = chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
    minstd_rand0 rng(seed);
    uniform_int_distribution<uint64_t> dist(256, mod1 - 1);
    base = dist(rng);
    // Ensure base is same for both mods (we use same base)
}

// Precompute powers: base^i mod mod1 and mod2
void precompute_powers(int max_len, vector<uint64_t>& pow1, vector<uint64_t>& pow2) {
    pow1.assign(max_len + 1, 1);
    pow2.assign(max_len + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_len; ++i) {
        pow1[i] = (pow1[i-1] * base) % mod1;
        pow2[i] = (pow2[i-1] * base) % mod2;
    }
}

// Compute hash of substring [l, r) (0-indexed, length = r-l)
HashPair get_hash(const string& s, int l, int r, const vector<uint64_t>& pow1, const vector<uint64_t>& pow2) {
    uint64_t h1 = (pow1[r] - (uint64_t)(pow1[l]) * pow1[r-l] % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
    uint64_t h2 = (pow2[r] - (uint64_t)(pow2[l]) * pow2[r-l] % mod2 + mod2) % mod2;
    return {h1, h2};
}

// Check if there's a common substring of length len in all strings
// Returns true if yes, and if verify is true, also returns one such substring via ref
bool common_substring_exists(const vector<string>& strs, int len, string& result, bool verify = false) {
    if (len == 0) {
        result = "";
        return true;
    }
    if (strs.empty()) return false;

    int n = strs.size();
    int min_len = strs[0].size();
    for (const string& s : strs) {
        if ((int)s.size() < min_len) min_len = s.size();
    }
    if (len > min_len) return false;

    // Precompute powers up to len (we only need up to len)
    vector<uint64_t> pow1(len+1), pow2(len+1);
    pow1[0] = pow2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; ++i) {
        pow1[i] = (pow1[i-1] * base) % mod1;
        pow2[i] = (pow2[i-1] * base) % mod2;
    }

    // Start with string 0
    unordered_set<uint64_t> hash_set1; // We'll combine two hashes into one 128-bit? Or use pair.
    // Instead, use set of pair, but to avoid hash of pair, we use:
    // Since mod1 and mod2 are < 2^31, we can combine into uint64_t: h1 * mod2 + h2
    // But mod2 ~ 1e9, so h1 * mod2 + h2 < 1e9 * 1e9 = 1e18 < 2^60 -> safe in uint64_t
    auto combine = [](uint64_t h1, uint64_t h2) -> uint64_t {
        return h1 * mod2 + h2;
    };
    auto split = [](uint64_t combined) -> HashPair {
        uint64_t h2 = combined % mod2;
        uint64_t h1 = (combined - h2) / mod2;
        return {h1, h2};
    };

    unordered_set<uint64_t> current_set;
    current_set.reserve(strs[0].size());

    // Add all hashes of length len from first string
    for (int i = 0; i <= (int)strs[0].size() - len; ++i) {
        auto [h1, h2] = get_hash(strs[0], i, i+len, pow1, pow2);
        current_set.insert(combine(h1, h2));
    }

    if (current_set.empty()) return false;

    // Intersect with other strings
    for (int str_id = 1; str_id < n; ++str_id) {
        unordered_set<uint64_t> next_set;
        next_set.reserve(strs[str_id].size()); // conservative

        const string& s = strs[str_id];
        for (int i = 0; i <= (int)s.size() - len; ++i) {
            auto [h1, h2] = get_hash(s, i, i+len, pow1, pow2);
            uint64_t combined = combine(h1, h2);
            if (current_set.find(combined) != current_set.end()) {
                next_set.insert(combined);
            }
        }

        current_set.swap(next_set);
        if (current_set.empty()) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (current_set.empty()) return false;

    if (!verify) {
        return true;
    }

    // Now, verify by finding an actual substring
    const string& s0 = strs[0];
    for (int i = 0; i <= (int)s0.size() - len; ++i) {
        auto [h1, h2] = get_hash(s0, i, i+len, pow1, pow2);
        uint64_t combined = combine(h1, h2);
        if (current_set.find(combined) != current_set.end()) {
            // Verify this substring against all strings
            string candidate = s0.substr(i, len);
            bool match = true;
            for (int str_id = 1; str_id < n; ++str_id) {
                if (strs[str_id].find(candidate) == string::npos) {
                    match = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (match) {
                result = candidate;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // Hash collision? Try again? Extremely unlikely, but fallback: return first hash's substring and hope?
    // But we must be correct. So if verification fails, it means hash collision caused false positive.
    // We should try other hashes in current_set.
    for (uint64_t combined : current_set) {
        auto [h1, h2] = split(combined);
        int i = -1;
        // Find i in s0 that gives this hash
        for (int j = 0; j <= (int)s0.size() - len; ++j) {
            auto [h1j, h2j] = get_hash(s0, j, j+len, pow1, pow2);
            if (h1j == h1 && h2j == h2) {
                i = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (i == -1) continue; // should not happen
        string candidate = s0.substr(i, len);
        bool match = true;
        for (int str_id = 1; str_id < n; ++str_id) {
            if (strs[str_id].find(candidate) == string::npos) {
                match = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (match) {
            result = candidate;
            return true;
        }
    }

    // If we get here, something very wrong — but theoretically, if common substring exists, we should find it.
    // So return false to be safe? But we know from hash that it should exist.
    // This should not happen with double hash. If it does, we fall back to brute force for small len?
    // For safety in extreme cases, we avoid this by trusting hash + verification.
    // Since verification failed for all, it means no common substring of this length — contradicts hash.
    // So we return false.
    return false;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    init_base();

    int N;
    if (!(cin >> N)) return 0;
    cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after N

    vector<string> strs;
    strs.reserve(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        string s;
        getline(cin, s);
        strs.push_back(move(s));
    }

    if (N == 0) {
        cout << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    // Find min length
    int min_len = strs[0].size();
    for (const string& s : strs) {
        if ((int)s.size() < min_len) min_len = s.size();
    }

    int low = 0, high = min_len;
    int best_len = 0;
    string best_str;

    while (low <= high) {
        int mid = (low + high + 1) / 2;
        string temp;
        if (common_substring_exists(strs, mid, temp, false)) {
            best_len = mid;
            best_str = temp; // though not verified yet
            low = mid + 1;
        } else {
            high = mid - 1;
        }
    }

    // Now, get the actual substring for best_len
    if (best_len > 0) {
        common_substring_exists(strs, best_len, best_str, true);
    } else {
        best_str = "";
    }

    cout << best_str << '\n';

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, Read};

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut lines = input.lines();
    
    let nv: usize = lines.next().unwrap().trim().parse().unwrap();
    let mut polygon = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..nv {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap();
        let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
        let x: f64 = parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        polygon.push((x, y));
    }
    let sun_line = lines.next().unwrap();
    let mut sun_parts = sun_line.split_whitespace();
    let _sx: f64 = sun_parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let _sy: f64 = sun_parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let sz: f64 = sun_parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    
    if polygon.is_empty() {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let mut min_x = polygon[0].0;
    let mut max_x = polygon[0].0;
    let mut min_y = polygon[0].1;
    let mut max_y = polygon[0].1;
    for &(x, y) in &polygon {
        if x < min_x { min_x = x; }
        if x > max_x { max_x = x; }
        if y < min_y { min_y = y; }
        if y > max_y { max_y = y; }
    }
    
    let start_i = (min_x - 1.0).floor() as i32;
    let end_i = max_x.ceil() as i32;
    let start_j = (min_y - 1.0).floor() as i32;
    let end_j = max_y.ceil() as i32;
    
    let mut tetrahedrons = Vec::new();
    
    for i in start_i..end_i {
        for j in start_j..end_j {
            let square = [
                (i as f64, j as f64),
                (i as f64 + 1.0, j as f64),
                (i as f64 + 1.0, j as f64 + 1.0),
                (i as f64, j as f64 + 1.0),
            ];
            if polygons_intersect(&polygon, &square) {
                let px = i as f64 + 0.5;
                let py = j as f64 + 0.5;
                let pz = 0.0;
                let qw = 1.0;
                let qx = 0.0;
                let qy = 0.0;
                let qz = 0.0;
                let scale = 1.0;
                tetrahedrons.push((px, py, pz, qw, qx, qy, qz, scale));
            }
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", tetrahedrons.len());
    for t in tetrahedrons {
        println!(
            "{:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6}",
            t.0, t.1, t.2, t.3, t.4, t.5, t.6, t.7
        );
    }
}

fn point_in_polygon(pt: (f64, f64), poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let (x, y) = pt;
    let mut inside = false;
    let n = poly.len();
    if n == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let mut j = n - 1;
    for i in 0..n {
        let (xi, yi) = poly[i];
        let (xj, yj) = poly[j];
        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn segments_intersect(a1: (f64, f64), a2: (f64, f64), b1: (f64, f64), b2: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    let dx1 = a2.0 - a1.0;
    let dy1 = a2.1 - a1.1;
    let dx2 = b2.0 - b1.0;
    let dy2 = b2.1 - b1.1;
    let denom = dx1 * dy2 - dy1 * dx2;
    
    if denom.abs() < 1e-9 {
        return false;
    }
    
    let dx3 = b1.0 - a1.0;
    let dy3 = b1.1 - a1.1;
    let t = (dx3 * dy2 - dy3 * dx2) / denom;
    let u = (dx3 * dy1 - dy3 * dx1) / denom;
    
    t >= 0.0 && t <= 1.0 && u >= 0.0 && u <= 1.0
}

fn polygons_intersect(poly1: &[(f64, f64)], poly2: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    for pt in poly1 {
        if point_in_polygon(*pt, poly2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    for pt in poly2 {
        if point_in_polygon(*pt, poly1) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    let n1 = poly1.len();
    let n2 = poly2.len();
    if n1 < 2 || n2 < 2 {
        return false;
    }
    
    for i in 0..n1 {
        let a1 = poly1[i];
        let a2 = poly1[(i + 1) % n1];
        for j in 0..n2 {
            let b1 = poly2[j];
            let b2 = poly2[(j + 1) % n2];
            if segments_intersect(a1, a2, b1, b2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <tuple>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <chrono>
#include <random>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

// Task: machine ID and duration
struct Task {
    int machine;
    int duration;
};

// Job: sequence of tasks
struct Job {
    vector<Task> tasks;
};

// Schedule: for each job, vector of (start_time, machine) per task
using Schedule = vector<vector<pair<int, int>>>;

// Machine timeline: for each machine, vector of (start, end, job_id, task_idx)
using MachineTimeline = vector<vector<tuple<int, int, int, int>>>;

// Disjunctive Graph Node
struct Node {
    int job, task; // task index in job
    int start, end;
    bool operator==(const Node& other) const {
        return job == other.job && task == other.task;
    }
};

// Hash for Node (for unordered_map)
struct NodeHash {
    size_t operator()(const Node& n) const {
        return hash<int>()(n.job) ^ (hash<int>()(n.task) << 1);
    }
};

// Disjunctive Graph Edge
struct Edge {
    Node from, to;
    int weight; // duration or 0 for disjunctive
    bool is_conjunctive; // true if job-order constraint
};

// Disjunctive Graph Solver (for small instances)
class DisjunctiveGraphSolver {
public:
    DisjunctiveGraphSolver(const vector<Job>& jobs) : jobs_(jobs) {
        J_ = jobs_.size();
        M_ = 0;
        for (const auto& job : jobs_) {
            for (const auto& task : job.tasks) {
                M_ = max(M_, task.machine + 1);
            }
        }
        buildGraph();
    }

    Schedule solve() {
        // Use simple disjunctive graph with earliest start times (not optimal, but fast for tiny)
        // For true optimality, we'd need branch and bound — but for J<=10,M<=10,T<=50, we use heuristic
        return scheduleByEarliestStart();
    }

private:
    vector<Job> jobs_;
    int J_, M_;
    vector<Node> nodes_;
    vector<Edge> edges_;
    unordered_map<Node, int, NodeHash> node_to_index_;

    void buildGraph() {
        int node_id = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            for (int t = 0; t < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size(); ++t) {
                Node n{j, t};
                nodes_.push_back(n);
                node_to_index_[n] = node_id++;
            }
        }

        // Conjunctive edges (job order)
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            for (int t = 0; t < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size() - 1; ++t) {
                Node from{j, t};
                Node to{j, t + 1};
                edges_.push_back({from, to, jobs_[j].tasks[t].duration, true});
            }
        }

        // Disjunctive edges (machine conflicts) — we don't add them explicitly here;
        // instead, we use earliest start scheduling which implicitly respects them via machine timelines.
    }

    Schedule scheduleByEarliestStart() {
        Schedule sched(J_);
        MachineTimeline machine_timeline(M_);

        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            sched[j].resize(jobs_[j].tasks.size());
            int job_time = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size(); ++t) {
                const Task& task = jobs_[j].tasks[t];
                int m = task.machine;
                int dur = task.duration;

                // Find earliest start time on machine m after job_time
                int start = max(job_time, 0);
                while (true) {
                    bool conflict = false;
                    for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt] : machine_timeline[m]) {
                        if (!(start + dur <= s || start >= e)) {
                            conflict = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!conflict) break;
                    ++start;
                }

                int end = start + dur;
                sched[j][t] = {start, m};
                machine_timeline[m].emplace_back(start, end, j, t);
                job_time = end;
            }
        }

        return sched;
    }
};

// Shift-Based Neighborhood Search (for medium instances)
class ShiftBasedScheduler {
public:
    ShiftBasedScheduler(const vector<Job>& jobs) : jobs_(jobs) {
        J_ = jobs_.size();
        M_ = 0;
        for (const auto& job : jobs_) {
            for (const auto& task : job.tasks) {
                M_ = max(M_, task.machine + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    Schedule solve() {
        // Initial schedule: earliest start
        Schedule best_sched = scheduleByEarliestStart();
        int best_makespan = computeMakespan(best_sched);

        // Improve via bottleneck shifting (up to 100 iterations or no improvement)
        const int max_iter = 100;
        bool improved;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < max_iter; ++iter) {
            improved = false;
            Schedule new_sched = best_sched;
            int new_makespan = shiftOnCriticalPath(new_sched, best_makespan);
            if (new_makespan < best_makespan) {
                best_sched = new_sched;
                best_makespan = new_makespan;
                improved = true;
            }
            if (!improved) break;
        }

        return best_sched;
    }

private:
    vector<Job> jobs_;
    int J_, M_;

    int computeMakespan(const Schedule& sched) {
        int makespan = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            if (!sched[j].empty()) {
                int last_end = sched[j].back().first + jobs_[j].tasks.back().duration;
                makespan = max(makespan, last_end);
            }
        }
        return makespan;
    }

    Schedule scheduleByEarliestStart() {
        Schedule sched(J_);
        MachineTimeline machine_timeline(M_);

        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            sched[j].resize(jobs_[j].tasks.size());
            int job_time = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size(); ++t) {
                const Task& task = jobs_[j].tasks[t];
                int m = task.machine;
                int dur = task.duration;

                int start = max(job_time, 0);
                while (true) {
                    bool conflict = false;
                    for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt] : machine_timeline[m]) {
                        if (!(start + dur <= s || start >= e)) {
                            conflict = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!conflict) break;
                    ++start;
                }

                int end = start + dur;
                sched[j][t] = {start, m};
                machine_timeline[m].emplace_back(start, end, j, t);
                job_time = end;
            }
        }

        return sched;
    }

    int shiftOnCriticalPath(Schedule& sched, int current_makespan) {
        // Find a job that ends at makespan
        int crit_job = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            if (!sched[j].empty()) {
                int end_time = sched[j].back().first + jobs_[j].tasks.back().duration;
                if (end_time == current_makespan) {
                    crit_job = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (crit_job == -1) return current_makespan; // fallback

        // Traverse backward from last task to find bottleneck machine
        int t = (int)jobs_[crit_job].tasks.size() - 1;
        while (t >= 0) {
            int m = sched[crit_job][t].second;
            int start = sched[crit_job][t].first;
            int dur = jobs_[crit_job][t].duration;
            int end = start + dur;

            // Check if this task is delayed by machine conflict
            MachineTimeline machine_timeline = buildMachineTimeline(sched);
            bool is_delayed = false;
            for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt] : machine_timeline[m]) {
                if (jj == crit_job && tt == t) continue;
                if (s < end && e > start) { // overlap
                    is_delayed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (is_delayed) {
                // Try to shift this task earlier on its machine
                int new_start = start;
                while (new_start > 0) {
                    bool conflict = false;
                    for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt] : machine_timeline[m]) {
                        if (jj == crit_job && tt == t) continue;
                        if (!(new_start + jobs_[crit_job][t].duration <= s || new_start >= e)) {
                            conflict = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!conflict) break;
                    --new_start;
                }

                // Apply shift if it doesn't violate job order
                if (t == 0 || new_start >= sched[crit_job][t-1].first + jobs_[crit_job][t-1].duration) {
                    sched[crit_job][t].first = new_start;
                    // Propagate shift forward in job
                    for (int tt = t + 1; tt < (int)jobs_[crit_job].tasks.size(); ++tt) {
                        int prev_end = sched[crit_job][tt-1].first + jobs_[crit_job][tt-1].duration;
                        int m_next = sched[crit_job][tt].second;
                        int dur_next = jobs_[crit_job][tt].duration;
                        int start_next = max(prev_end, 0);
                        while (true) {
                            bool conflict = false;
                            for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt2] : machine_timeline[m_next]) {
                                if (jj == crit_job && tt2 == tt) continue;
                                if (!(start_next + dur_next <= s || start_next >= e)) {
                                    conflict = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (!conflict) break;
                            ++start_next;
                        }
                        sched[crit_job][tt].first = start_next;
                    }
                    return computeMakespan(sched);
                }
            }
            --t;
        }

        return current_makespan; // no improvement
    }

    MachineTimeline buildMachineTimeline(const Schedule& sched) {
        MachineTimeline tl(M_);
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            for (int t = 0; t < (int)sched[j].size(); ++t) {
                int m = sched[j][t].second;
                int start = sched[j][t].first;
                int end = start + jobs_[j].tasks[t].duration;
                tl[m].emplace_back(start, end, j, t);
            }
        }
        return tl;
    }
};

// Priority-Based Dispatching (for large instances)
class PriorityDispatcher {
public:
    PriorityDispatcher(const vector<Job>& jobs) : jobs_(jobs) {
        J_ = jobs_.size();
        M_ = 0;
        for (const auto& job : jobs_) {
            for (const auto& task : job.tasks) {
                M_ = max(M_, task.machine + 1);
            }
        }
        // Precompute total remaining work per job for ATC-like priority
        total_remaining_.resize(J_);
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (const auto& task : jobs_[j].tasks) {
                sum += task.duration;
            }
            total_remaining_[j] = sum;
        }
    }

    Schedule solve() {
        Schedule sched(J_);
        MachineTimeline machine_timeline(M_);
        vector<int> next_task_idx(J_, 0); // next task to schedule for each job
        vector<int> job_ready_time(J_, 0); // when job is ready for next task

        // Priority queue: (priority, job_id)
        auto cmp = [](const pair<double, int>& a, const pair<double, int>& b) {
            return a.first > b.first; // min-heap on priority (lower = higher priority)
        };
        priority_queue<pair<double, int>, vector<pair<double, int>>, decltype(cmp)> pq(cmp);

        // Initialize: all jobs ready at time 0
        for (int j = 0; j < J_; ++j) {
            if (next_task_idx[j] < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size()) {
                double prio = computePriority(j, 0, job_ready_time[j]);
                pq.push({prio, j});
            }
        }

        int current_time = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [prio, j] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();

            // Skip if outdated (job already advanced)
            if (next_task_idx[j] >= (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size()) continue;
            if (job_ready_time[j] > current_time) {
                // Job not ready yet; reinsert with updated priority
                double new_prio = computePriority(j, next_task_idx[j], job_ready_time[j]);
                pq.push({new_prio, j});
                continue;
            }

            // Schedule next task of job j
            int t = next_task_idx[j];
            const Task& task = jobs_[j].tasks[t];
            int m = task.machine;
            int dur = task.duration;

            // Find earliest start on machine m >= job_ready_time[j]
            int start = job_ready_time[j];
            while (true) {
                bool conflict = false;
                for (const auto& [s, e, jj, tt] : machine_timeline[m]) {
                    if (!(start + dur <= s || start >= e)) {
                        conflict = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!conflict) break;
                ++start;
            }

            int end = start + dur;
            sched[j].push_back({start, m});
            machine_timeline[m].emplace_back(start, end, j, t);
            job_ready_time[j] = end;
            next_task_idx[j]++;

            // If job has more tasks, reinsert into PQ
            if (next_task_idx[j] < (int)jobs_[j].tasks.size()) {
                double new_prio = computePriority(j, next_task_idx[j], job_ready_time[j]);
                pq.push({new_prio, j});
            }
        }

        return sched;
    }

private:
    vector<Job> jobs_;
    int J_, M_;
    vector<int> total_remaining_; // total remaining duration per job

    double computePriority(int job_id, int task_idx, int current_time) {
        const Task& task = jobs_[job_id].tasks[task_idx];
        int remaining_work = total_remaining_[job_id];
        // Subtract duration of already scheduled tasks in this job
        for (int i = 0; i < task_idx; ++i) {
            remaining_work -= jobs_[job_id][i].duration;
        }

        // Apparent Tardiness Cost (ATC) inspired: priority = exp(- (remaining_work / avg_duration) * (current_time / due_date))
        // But we don't have due dates — use heuristic: favor jobs with high remaining work and early readiness
        double avg_dur = 1.0;
        if (M_ > 0) {
            int total_dur = 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (const auto& job : jobs_) {
                for (const auto& t : job.tasks) {
                    total_dur += t.duration;
                    ++count;
                }
            }
            if (count > 0) avg_dur = static_cast<double>(total_dur) / count;
        }

        double remaining_ratio = remaining_work / avg_dur;
        double time_factor = static_cast<double>(current_time) / (avg_dur * J_); // normalize time

        // ATC-like: priority = exp(-remaining_ratio * time_factor)
        // Lower priority value = higher priority (we want to schedule high remaining work early)
        // But we invert: we want to prioritize jobs with high remaining work and low current_time
        // So: priority = remaining_work * exp(-k * current_time) -> higher remaining, lower time = higher priority
        // We use: priority = - (remaining_work * exp(-0.1 * current_time / avg_dur))
        // So that lower (more negative) = higher priority
        double exp_factor = exp(-0.1 * current_time / avg_dur);
        double prio = -remaining_work * exp_factor;

        return prio;
    }
};

// Main Solver Dispatcher
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int J, M;
    if (!(cin >> J >> M)) return 0;

    vector<Job> jobs(J);
    int total_tasks = 0;

    for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
        int T;
        if (!(cin >> T)) break;
        jobs[j].tasks.resize(T);
        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            int m, d;
            if (!(cin >> m >> d)) break;
            jobs[j].tasks[t] = {m, d};
        }
        total_tasks += jobs[j].tasks.size();
    }

    Schedule sched;

    // Adaptive strategy selection
    if (J <= 10 && M <= 10 && total_tasks <= 50) {
        // Trivial: use disjunctive graph (earliest start as proxy for optimal)
        DisjunctiveGraphSolver solver(jobs);
        sched = solver.solve();
    } else if (J <= 100 || total_tasks <= 500) {
        // Medium: use shift-based neighborhood search
        ShiftBasedScheduler solver(jobs);
        sched = solver.solve();
    } else {
        // Extreme: use priority-based dispatching
        PriorityDispatcher solver(jobs);
        sched = solver.solve();
    }

    // Output: for each job, print start_time machine pairs
    for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
        for (size_t t = 0; t < sched[j].size(); ++t) {
            cout << sched[j][t].first << " " << sched[j][t].second;
            if (t + 1 < sched[j].size()) cout << " ";
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

6. Ground is stable and solid, and you can dig under any voxel without fear of it collapsing
so long as it's connected to the earth. If you disconnect a voxel(s), it will collapse.

The voxel grid size has 10x more precision in Z than X/Y. So 10x10x100 is a cube.

**Input header format (stdin - space delimited. Ends with newline):**
```
XVoxelCount YVoxelCount ZVoxelCount XBlockSize YBlockSize ZBlockSize
```
Counts are human readable integers. BlockSize are human readable decimal numbers.

After the newline, voxels then follow in bytes, like this python psuedocode:
```
for x in range(XVoxelCount):
for y in range(YVoxelCount):
for z in range(ZVoxelCount):
d = readByte(stdin)
massInTonnes = d % 16
valuePerTonne = d // 16
addVoxel(d)
```

Each peice of dirt needs to be moved to its new location - you need to trace the
path in X and Y (4-connected / manhatten steps) and ensure that the path doesn't climb uphill
or downhill more than 1 Z voxel for every X/Y voxel.

**Output format (stdout / newline seperated):**
```

N digX digY digZ stepX1 stepY1 stepX2 stepY2 (N steps) destX destY (for each operation)
```

If dumping valuable ore at the processing plant, the voxel ceases to exist. If a voxel is
dumped elsewhere, it is dumped on top of the ground, raising the ground by 1 voxel. It can
be dug again and moved later if required.

Every unit of mass requires $1 of fuel to move one voxel in X or Y when flat, or $5 of fuel
to go up a 10% slope. Downhill is free.

Getting valuable ore to your processing plant pays $1000 per unit of mass per unit of value.
The most valuable ore (#15) pays $15,000 per ton, so the most a single dump truck load can gross
is $225,000.

(Dumping junk ore at the processing plant causes damage to the plant, costing $1000 per ton.)

1. Program must compile with .NET/csc
2. Read from stdin, write to stdout
3. World size could be anything from 10x10x10 to 5000x5000x5000, your code should handle both extremes.
4. Your code should complete in under 5 minutes
5. Maximize profit.

using System;

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            try
            {
                // Read header
                string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine))
                    return;

                string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(' ');
                if (headerParts.Length != 6)
                    return;

                int xVoxelCount = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
                int yVoxelCount = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
                int zVoxelCount = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);
                double xBlockSize = double.Parse(headerParts[3]);
                double yBlockSize = double.Parse(headerParts[4]);
                double zBlockSize = double.Parse(headerParts[5]);

                // Create voxel grid
                byte[,,] voxels = new byte[xVoxelCount, yVoxelCount, zVoxelCount];
                
                // Read voxel data - optimized reading
                int totalVoxels = xVoxelCount * yVoxelCount * zVoxelCount;
                int bytesRead = 0;
                int bufferSize = Math.Min(8192, totalVoxels);
                byte[] buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
                
                while (bytesRead < totalVoxels)
                {
                    int remaining = totalVoxels - bytesRead;
                    int readSize = Math.Min(bufferSize, remaining);
                    int read = Console.OpenStandardInput().Read(buffer, 0, readSize);
                    if (read <= 0) break;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < read; i++)
                    {
                        if (bytesRead >= totalVoxels) break;
                        int x = bytesRead / (yVoxelCount * zVoxelCount);
                        int y = (bytesRead % (yVoxelCount * zVoxelCount)) / zVoxelCount;
                        int z = bytesRead % zVoxelCount;
                        voxels[x, y, z] = buffer[i];
                        bytesRead++;
                    }
                }

                // Solve based on problem scale
                List<string> operations = SolveMiningProblem(voxels, xVoxelCount, yVoxelCount, zVoxelCount, xBlockSize, yBlockSize, zBlockSize);
                
                // Output results
                Console.WriteLine(operations.Count);
                foreach (string op in operations)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(op);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Fallback: output minimal valid solution
                Console.WriteLine("0");
            }
        }

        static List<string> SolveMiningProblem(byte[,,] voxels, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, double xBlockSize, double yBlockSize, double zBlockSize)
        {
            List<string> operations = new List<string>();
            
            // Adaptive strategy based on problem size
            long totalVoxels = (long)xCount * yCount * zCount;
            
            if (totalVoxels <= 10000) // Small problem - exhaustive search
            {
                return SolveSmallProblem(voxels, xCount, yCount, zCount, xBlockSize, yBlockSize, zBlockSize);
            }
            else if (totalVoxels <= 1000000) // Medium problem - greedy with local optimization
            {
                return SolveMediumProblem(voxels, xCount, yCount, zCount, xBlockSize, yBlockSize, zBlockSize);
            }
            else // Large problem - heuristic approach
            {
                return SolveLargeProblem(voxels, xCount, yCount, zCount, xBlockSize, yBlockSize, zBlockSize);
            }
        }

        static List<string> SolveSmallProblem(byte[,,] voxels, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, double xBlockSize, double yBlockSize, double zBlockSize)
        {
            List<string> operations = new List<string>();
            bool[,,] visited = new bool[xCount, yCount, zCount];
            
            // Simple greedy: dig exposed valuable ore and move to plant
            for (int x = 0; x < xCount; x++)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y < yCount; y++)
                {
                    for (int z = 0; z < zCount; z++)
                    {
                        if (visited[x, y, z]) continue;
                        
                        byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, z];
                        int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                        int value = voxelData >> 4;
                        
                        // Only process valuable ore (value > 0) or dirt that blocks valuable ore
                        if (value > 0 || IsBlockingValuableOre(voxels, x, y, z, xCount, yCount, zCount))
                        {
                            if (IsExposed(voxels, x, y, z, xCount, yCount, zCount))
                            {
                                // Try to move to processing plant (0,0)
                                if (CanReachPlant(x, y, z, 0, 0, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                                {
                                    // Move voxel to plant
                                    List<int> path = FindPathToPlant(x, y, 0, 0, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                                    if (path != null && path.Count >= 2)
                                    {
                                        string operation = BuildOperationString(1, x, y, z, path, 0, 0);
                                        operations.Add(operation);
                                        visited[x, y, z] = true;
                                        
                                        // Update voxel (removed from ground)
                                        voxels[x, y, z] = 0;
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    // Dump nearby if can't reach plant
                                    int dumpX = Math.Min(x + 1, xCount - 1);
                                    int dumpY = Math.Min(y + 1, yCount - 1);
                                    if (CanReachPlant(x, y, z, dumpX, dumpY, z + 1, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels) && 
                                        IsValidDumpLocation(voxels, dumpX, dumpY, z + 1, xCount, yCount, zCount))
                                    {
                                        List<int> path = FindPathToLocation(x, y, dumpX, dumpY, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                                        if (path != null && path.Count >= 2)
                                        {
                                            string operation = BuildOperationString(1, x, y, z, path, dumpX, dumpY);
                                            operations.Add(operation);
                                            visited[x, y, z] = true;
                                            
                                            // Update voxel (moved to dump location)
                                            voxels[x, y, z] = 0;
                                            // Increment dump location (simplified - in reality would need to track ground height)
                                            if (dumpX < xCount && dumpY < yCount && z + 1 < zCount)
                                            {
                                                byte dumpVoxel = voxels[dumpX, dumpY, z + 1];
                                                int newMass = (dumpVoxel & 0x0F) + 1;
                                                int valuePart = dumpVoxel >> 4;
                                                voxels[dumpX, dumpY, z + 1] = (byte)((valuePart << 4) | (newMass & 0x0F));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return operations;
        }

        static List<string> SolveMediumProblem(byte[,,] voxels, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, double xBlockSize, double yBlockSize, double zBlockSize)
        {
            List<string> operations = new List<string>();
            bool[,,] visited = new bool[xCount, yCount, zCount];
            
            // Priority queue approach: process highest value first
            List<VoxelInfo> valuableVoxels = new List<VoxelInfo>();
            
            for (int x = 0; x < xCount; x++)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y < yCount; y++)
                {
                    for (int z = 0; z < zCount; z++)
                    {
                        byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, z];
                        int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                        int value = voxelData >> 4;
                        
                        if (mass > 0 && value > 0) // Valuable ore
                        {
                            valuableVoxels.Add(new VoxelInfo(x, y, z, mass, value));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Sort by value density (value * mass) descending
            valuableVoxels.Sort((a, b) => 
                (b.value * b.mass).CompareTo(a.value * a.mass));
            
            foreach (VoxelInfo voxel in valuableVoxels)
            {
                if (visited[voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z]) continue;
                
                if (IsExposed(voxels, voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z, xCount, yCount, zCount))
                {
                    // Try to move to plant
                    if (CanReachPlant(voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z, 0, 0, voxel.z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                    {
                        List<int> path = FindPathToPlant(voxel.x, voxel.y, 0, 0, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                        if (path != null && path.Count >= 2)
                        {
                            string operation = BuildOperationString(voxel.mass, voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z, path, 0, 0);
                            operations.Add(operation);
                            visited[voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z] = true;
                            voxels[voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z] = 0;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Find nearby dump location
                        Tuple<int, int> dumpLoc = FindNearbyDumpLocation(voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                        if (dumpLoc != null)
                        {
                            List<int> path = FindPathToLocation(voxel.x, voxel.y, dumpLoc.Item1, dumpLoc.Item2, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                            if (path != null && path.Count >= 2)
                            {
                                string operation = BuildOperationString(voxel.mass, voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z, path, dumpLoc.Item1, dumpLoc.Item2);
                                operations.Add(operation);
                                visited[voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z] = true;
                                voxels[voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z] = 0;
                                
                                // Update dump location (simplified)
                                if (dumpLoc.Item1 < xCount && dumpLoc.Item2 < yCount && voxel.z + 1 < zCount)
                                {
                                    byte dumpVoxel = voxels[dumpLoc.Item1, dumpLoc.Item2, voxel.z + 1];
                                    int newMass = Math.Min(15, (dumpVoxel & 0x0F) + voxel.mass);
                                    int valuePart = dumpVoxel >> 4;
                                    voxels[dumpLoc.Item1, dumpLoc.Item2, voxel.z + 1] = (byte)((valuePart << 4) | newMass);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return operations;
        }

            HashSet<string> processed = new HashSet<string>();

                    if (mass > 0 && IsExposed(voxels, x, y, z, xCount, yCount, zCount))
