                        if (value > 0)
                        {
                            // Try direct path to plant
                            if (CanReachPlant(x, y, z, 0, 0, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                            {
                                List<int> path = FindSimplePath(x, y, 0, 0, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);

                                {
                                    string operation = BuildOperationString(mass, x, y, z, path, 0, 0);
                                    operations.Add(operation);
                                    voxels[x, y, z] = 0; // Remove voxel
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // For dirt, try to clear path to valuable ore or dump nearby
                            if (HasValuableOreAbove(x, y, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                            {
                                // Try to dump to create path
                                int dumpX = Math.Min(x + 1, xCount - 1);
                                int dumpY = Math.Min(y + 1, yCount - 1);
                                int dumpZ = Math.Min(z + 1, zCount - 1);
                                
                                if (IsValidDumpLocation(voxels, dumpX, dumpY, dumpZ, xCount, yCount, zCount))
                                {
                                    List<int> path = FindSimplePath(x, y, dumpX, dumpY, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
                                    if (path != null)
                                    {
                                        string operation = BuildOperationString(mass, x, y, z, path, dumpX, dumpY);
                                        operations.Add(operation);
                                        voxels[x, y, z] = 0;
                                        
                                        // Update dump location
                                        if (dumpX < xCount && dumpY < yCount && dumpZ < zCount)
                                        {
                                            byte dumpVoxel = voxels[dumpX, dumpY, dumpZ];
                                            int newMass = Math.Min(15, (dumpVoxel & 0x0F) + mass);
                                            int valuePart = dumpVoxel >> 4;
                                            voxels[dumpX, dumpY, dumpZ] = (byte)((valuePart << 4) | newMass);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                    }

            return operations;

        static bool IsExposed(byte[,,] voxels, int x, int y, int z, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount)
        {
            // Check if exposed from above (z-1 is air or out of bounds)
            if (z == 0 || z >= zCount) return true;
            
            byte above = voxels[x, y, z - 1];
            int aboveMass = above & 0x0F;
            
            // Exposed if nothing above or only air (mass == 0)
            return aboveMass == 0;
        }

        static bool IsBlockingValuableOre(byte[,,] voxels, int x, int y, int z, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount)
        {
            // Check if this dirt blocks valuable ore above it
            for (int checkZ = z + 1; checkZ < zCount; checkZ++)
            {
                byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, checkZ];
                int value = voxelData >> 4;
                if (value > 0) return true; // Found valuable ore above
                
                int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                if (mass == 0) break; // Hit air, stop checking
            }
            return false;
        }

        static bool CanReachPlant(int startX, int startY, int startZ, int targetX, int targetY, int targetZ, 
                                 int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Simple Manhattan path check with slope constraint
            int dx = Math.Abs(targetX - startX);
            int dy = Math.Abs(targetY - startY);
            int dz = Math.Abs(targetZ - startZ);
            
            // Check if slope constraint is violated
            int maxHorizontal = Math.Max(dx, dy);
            if (maxHorizontal > 0 && dz > maxHorizontal) // More than 1 Z per X/Y
                return false;
            
            // Additional check: path must not go through solid voxels
            return IsPathClear(startX, startY, startZ, targetX, targetY, targetZ, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
        }

        static bool IsPathClear(int x1, int y1, int z1, int x2, int y2, int z2, 
                               int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Simple line-of-sight check (simplified for performance)
            int dx = x2 - x1;
            int dy = y2 - y1;
            int dz = z2 - z1;
            int steps = Math.Max(Math.Abs(dx), Math.Max(Math.Abs(dy), Math.Abs(dz)));
            
            if (steps == 0) return true;
            
            double xInc = dx / (double)steps;
            double yInc = dy / (double)steps;
            double zInc = dz / (double)steps;
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= steps; i++)
            {
                int x = (int)Math.Round(x1 + i * xInc);
                int y = (int)Math.Round(y1 + i * yInc);
                int z = (int)Math.Round(z1 + i * zInc);
                
                if (x < 0 || x >= xCount || y < 0 || y >= yCount || z < 0 || z >= zCount)
                    continue;
                
                // Check if voxel is solid (mass > 0) and not the start/end
                if ((i > 0 && i < steps) || (z1 != z2)) // Allow start and end to be solid if same Z
                {
                    byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, z];
                    int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                    if (mass > 0 && !(x == x1 && y == y1 && z == z1) && !(x == x2 && y == y2 && z == z2))
                    {
                        return false; // Blocked by solid voxel
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        static List<int> FindPathToPlant(int startX, int startY, int targetX, int targetY, 
                                        int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Simple greedy pathfinding: move toward target
            List<int> path = new List<int>();
            int x = startX;
            int y = startY;
            int z = startZ; // Keep same Z for simplicity
            
            path.Add(x);
            path.Add(y);
            
            // Move in X direction first, then Y
            while (x != targetX || y != targetY)
            {
                int nextX = x;
                int nextY = y;
                
                if (x < targetX) nextX = Math.Min(x + 1, xCount - 1);
                else if (x > targetX) nextX = Math.Max(x - 1, 0);
                
                if (y < targetY) nextY = Math.Min(y + 1, yCount - 1);
                else if (y > targetY) nextY = Math.Max(y - 1, 0);
                
                // Check if next position is valid (slope constraint)
                if (IsValidStep(x, y, z, nextX, nextY, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                {
                    x = nextX;
                    y = nextY;
                    path.Add(x);
                    path.Add(y);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Try alternative: move only in one direction
                    if (x != targetX)
                    {
                        int testX = x < targetX ? Math.Min(x + 1, xCount - 1) : Math.Max(x - 1, 0);
                        if (IsValidStep(x, y, z, testX, y, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                        {
                            x = testX;
                            path.Add(x);
                            path.Add(y);
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (y != targetY)
                    {
                        int testY = y < targetY ? Math.Min(y + 1, yCount - 1) : Math.Max(y - 1, 0);
                        if (IsValidStep(x, y, z, x, testY, z, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                        {
                            y = testY;
                            path.Add(x);
                            path.Add(y);
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // If we can't move, break
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            // Ensure we end at target
            if (x == targetX && y == targetY)
            {
                path.Add(x);
                path.Add(y);
                return path;
            }
            
            return null;
        }

        static List<int> FindPathToLocation(int startX, int startY, int targetX, int targetY, 
                                           int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            return FindPathToPlant(startX, startY, targetX, targetY, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels);
        }

        static List<int> FindSimplePath(int startX, int startY, int targetX, int targetY, 
                                       int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Even simpler path - just try to go straight
            List<int> path = new List<int>();
            path.Add(startX);
            path.Add(startY);
            
            int x = startX;
            int y = startY;
            
            // Try X then Y
            while (x != targetX)
            {
                int step = x < targetX ? 1 : -1;
                int nextX = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(xCount - 1, x + step));
                if (IsValidStep(x, y, 0, nextX, y, 0, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels)) // Assume Z=0 for simplicity
                {
                    x = nextX;
                    path.Add(x);
                    path.Add(y);
                }
                else
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            while (y != targetY)
            {
                int step = y < targetY ? 1 : -1;
                int nextY = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(yCount - 1, y + step));
                if (IsValidStep(x, y, 0, x, nextY, 0, xCount, yCount, zCount, voxels))
                {
                    y = nextY;
                    path.Add(x);
                    path.Add(y);
                }
                else
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (x == targetX && y == targetY)
            {
                path.Add(x);
                path.Add(y);
                return path;
            }
            
            return null;
        }

        static bool IsValidStep(int x1, int y1, int z1, int x2, int y2, int z2, 
                               int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Check bounds
            if (x2 < 0 || x2 >= xCount || y2 < 0 || y2 >= yCount || z2 < 0 || z2 >= zCount)
                return false;
            
            // Check slope constraint: |dz| <= max(|dx|, |dy|)
            int dx = Math.Abs(x2 - x1);
            int dy = Math.Abs(y2 - y1);
            int dz = Math.Abs(z2 - z1);
            int maxHorizontal = Math.Max(dx, dy);
            
            if (dz > maxHorizontal) // More than 1 Z per X/Y voxel
                return false;
            
            // Check if destination is not solid (unless it's the target we're moving to)
            byte voxelData = voxels[x2, y2, z2];
            int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
            
            // Allow moving to air (mass == 0) or same position
            return mass == 0 || (x1 == x2 && y1 == y2 && z1 == z2);
        }

        static Tuple<int, int> FindNearbyDumpLocation(int x, int y, int z, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Look for nearby empty spot to dump
            int searchRadius = Math.Min(5, Math.Min(xCount, yCount) / 2);
            
            for (int dx = -searchRadius; dx <= searchRadius; dx++)
            {
                for (int dy = -searchRadius; dy <= searchRadius; dy++)
                {
                    int nx = x + dx;
                    int ny = y + dy;
                    
                    if (nx < 0 || nx >= xCount || ny < 0 || ny >= yCount) continue;
                    
                    // Look for first empty Z from current Z upward
                    for (int nz = z; nz < zCount; nz++)
                    {
                        byte voxelData = voxels[nx, ny, nz];
                        int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                        if (mass == 0) // Found empty spot
                        {
                            return new Tuple<int, int>(nx, ny);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return null;
        }

        static bool HasValuableOreAbove(int x, int y, int z, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount, byte[,,] voxels)
        {
            // Check if there's valuable ore above this position
            for (int checkZ = z + 1; checkZ < zCount; checkZ++)
            {
                byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, checkZ];
                int value = voxelData >> 4;
                int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
                
                if (value > 0 && mass > 0) return true;
                if (mass == 0) break; // Hit air
            }
            return false;
        }

        static bool IsValidDumpLocation(byte[,,] voxels, int x, int y, int z, int xCount, int yCount, int zCount)
        {
            if (x < 0 || x >= xCount || y < 0 || y >= yCount || z < 0 || z >= zCount)
                return false;
            
            byte voxelData = voxels[x, y, z];
            int mass = voxelData & 0x0F;
            return mass == 0; // Must be empty to dump on
        }

        static string BuildOperationString(int mass, int startX, int startY, int startZ, 
                                          List<int> path, int destX, int destY)
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.Append(mass.ToString());
            sb.Append(" ");
            sb.Append(startX.ToString());
            sb.Append(" ");
            sb.Append(startY.ToString());
            sb.Append(" ");
            sb.Append(startZ.ToString());
            
            // Add path steps (X,Y pairs)
            for (int i = 0; i < path.Count; i += 2)
            {
                if (i + 1 < path.Count)
                {
                    sb.Append(" ");
                    sb.Append(path[i].ToString());
                    sb.Append(" ");
                    sb.Append(path[i + 1].ToString());
                }
            }
            
            sb.Append(" ");
            sb.Append(destX.ToString());
            sb.Append(" ");
            sb.Append(destY.ToString());
            
            return sb.ToString();
        }
    }

    class VoxelInfo
    {
        public int x, y, z;
        public int mass;
        public int value;
        
        public VoxelInfo(int x, int y, int z, int mass, int value)
        {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.z = z;
            this.mass = mass;
            this.value = value;
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <set>
#include <tuple>
#include <cctype>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <stack>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <functional>
#include <numeric>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

typedef vector<int> Point;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int D, max_turns;
    if (!(cin >> D >> max_turns)) {
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> bounds(D);
    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
        cin >> bounds[i];
    }

    int snake_length;
    cin >> snake_length;
    Point start_pos(D);
    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
        cin >> start_pos[i];
    }

    int F;
    cin >> F;
    vector<Point> foods;
    for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) {
        Point p(D);
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            cin >> p[j];
        }
        foods.push_back(p);
    }

    int O;
    cin >> O;
    set<vector<int>> obstacles;
    for (int i = 0; i < O; i++) {
        Point p(D);
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            cin >> p[j];
        }
        obstacles.insert(p);
    }

    set<vector<int>> snake_set;
    vector<Point> snake_body;
    Point head = start_pos;
    snake_body.push_back(head);
    snake_set.insert(head);
    for (int i = 1; i < snake_length; i++) {
        Point p = head;
        if (i < D) {
            p[i] = head[i] - 1;
        } else {
            p[0] = head[0] - i;
        }
        snake_body.push_back(p);
        snake_set.insert(p);
    }

    bool use_bfs = true;
    long long total_cells = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
        if (total_cells > LLONG_MAX / bounds[i]) {
            use_bfs = false;
            break;
        }
        total_cells *= bounds[i];
    }
    if (total_cells > 10000000) {
        use_bfs = false;
    }

    vector<int> dist;
    vector<int> prev_dir;
    vector<int> prev_dim;
    vector<long long> strides;
    long long total_size_bfs = 1;
    if (use_bfs) {
        strides.resize(D);
        strides[D-1] = 1;
        for (int i = D-2; i >= 0; i--) {
            strides[i] = strides[i+1] * bounds[i+1];
        }
        total_size_bfs = strides[0] * bounds[0];
        dist.assign(total_size_bfs, -1);
        prev_dir.assign(total_size_bfs, 0);
        prev_dim.assign(total_size_bfs, -1);

        queue<long long> q;
        for (const Point& food : foods) {
            long long idx = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                idx += (long long)food[i] * strides[i];
            }
            if (dist[idx] == -1) {
                dist[idx] = 0;
                prev_dir[idx] = 0;
                prev_dim[idx] = -1;
                q.push(idx);
            }
        }

        while (!q.empty()) {
            long long idx = q.front();
            q.pop();
            Point p(D);
            long long temp = idx;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                p[i] = temp / strides[i];
                temp = temp % strides[i];
            }
            for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point np = p;
                    np[dim] += d;
                    if (np[dim] < 0 || np[dim] >= bounds[dim]) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long long nidx = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                        nidx += (long long)np[i] * strides[i];
                    }
                    if (dist[nidx] == -1) {
                        dist[nidx] = dist[idx] + 1;
                        prev_dir[nidx] = d;
                        prev_dim[nidx] = dim;
                        q.push(nidx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int turns = 0;
    while (turns < max_turns && !foods.empty()) {
        int axis = -1;
        int direction = 0;
        if (use_bfs) {
            long long idx = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                idx += (long long)head[i] * strides[i];
            }
            if (dist[idx] == -1) {
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                if (head[0] + direction >= bounds[0]) {
                    direction = -1;
                }
            } else {
                axis = prev_dim[idx];
                direction = prev_dir[idx];
                if (axis == -1) {
                    axis = 0;
                    direction = 1;
                    if (head[0] + direction >= bounds[0]) {
                        direction = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            long long min_dist = LLONG_MAX;
            Point target_food;
            for (const Point& food : foods) {
                long long d = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    d += abs((long long)head[i] - food[i]);
                }
                if (d < min_dist) {
                    min_dist = d;
                    target_food = food;
                }
            }
            int best_dim = -1;
            long long best_diff = -1;
            for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                long long diff = abs((long long)head[dim] - target_food[dim]);
                if (diff > best_diff) {
                    best_diff = diff;
                    best_dim = dim;
                }
            }
            axis = best_dim;
            if (head[axis] < target_food[axis]) {
                direction = 1;
            } else if (head[axis] > target_food[axis]) {
                direction = -1;
            } else {
                for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                    if (head[dim] != target_food[dim]) {
                        axis = dim;
                        if (head[dim] < target_food[dim]) {
                            direction = 1;
                        } else {
                            direction = -1;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (axis == -1) {
                    axis = 0;
                    direction = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        Point new_head = head;
        new_head[axis] += direction;
        bool valid = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
            if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!valid) {
            for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                Point test_head = head;
                test_head[axis] += d;
                bool test_valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        test_valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (test_valid) {
                    direction = d;
                    new_head = test_head;
                    valid = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!valid) {
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                new_head = head;
                new_head[axis] += direction;
                if (new_head[0] < 0 || new_head[0] >= bounds[0]) {
                    direction = -1;
                    new_head[0] = head[0] + direction;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        new_head[i] = 0;
                    }
                }
                valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!valid) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                        new_head[i] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        bool self_collision = snake_set.find(new_head) != snake_set.end();
        bool obstacle_collision = obstacles.find(new_head) != obstacles.end();
        if (self_collision || obstacle_collision) {
            for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                Point test_head = head;
                test_head[axis] += d;
                bool test_valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        test_valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!test_valid) continue;
                bool test_self = snake_set.find(test_head) != snake_set.end();
                bool test_obs = obstacles.find(test_head) != obstacles.end();
                if (!test_self && !test_obs) {
                    axis = axis;
                    direction = d;
                    new_head = test_head;
                    self_collision = false;
                    obstacle_collision = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (self_collision || obstacle_collision) {
                for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                    if (dim == axis) continue;
                    for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                        Point test_head = head;
                        test_head[dim] += d;
                        bool test_valid = true;
                        for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                            if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                                test_valid = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!test_valid) continue;
                        bool test_self = snake_set.find(test_head) != snake_set.end();
                        bool test_obs = obstacles.find(test_head) != obstacles.end();
                        if (!test_self && !test_obs) {
                            axis = dim;
                            direction = d;
                            new_head = test_head;
                            self_collision = false;
                            obstacle_collision = false;
                            goto found_safe;
                        }
                    }
                }
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                new_head = head;
                new_head[0] += direction;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0) new_head[i] = 0;
                    if (new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) new_head[i] = bounds[i]-1;
                }
                found_safe:;
            }
        }

        cout << axis << " " << direction << endl;

        bool ate = false;
        auto it_food = find(foods.begin(), foods.end(), new_head);
        if (it_food != foods.end()) {
            foods.erase(it_food);
            ate = true;
        }

        snake_body.insert(snake_body.begin(), new_head);
        snake_set.insert(new_head);
        if (!ate) {
            Point tail = snake_body.back();
            snake_body.pop_back();
            snake_set.erase(tail);
        }
        head = new_head;

        turns++;
    }

    return 0;
}

        }
        obstacles.insert(p);
    }

    set<vector<int>> snake_set;
    vector<Point> snake_body;
    Point head = start_pos;
    snake_body.push_back(head);
    snake_set.insert(head);
    for (int i = 1; i < snake_length; i++) {
        Point p = head;
        if (i < D) {
            p[i] = head[i] - 1;
        } else {
            p[0] = head[0] - i;
        }
        snake_body.push_back(p);
        snake_set.insert(p);
    }

    bool use_bfs = true;
    long long total_cells = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
        if (total_cells > LLONG_MAX / bounds[i]) {
            use_bfs = false;
            break;
        }
        total_cells *= bounds[i];
    }
    if (total_cells > 10000000) {
        use_bfs = false;
    }

    vector<int> dist;
    vector<int> prev_dir;
    vector<int> prev_dim;
    vector<long long> strides;
    long long total_size_bfs = 1;
    if (use_bfs) {
        strides.resize(D);
        strides[D-1] = 1;
        for (int i = D-2; i >= 0; i--) {
            strides[i] = strides[i+1] * bounds[i+1];
        }
        total_size_bfs = strides[0] * bounds[0];
        dist.assign(total_size_bfs, -1);
        prev_dir.assign(total_size_bfs, 0);
        prev_dim.assign(total_size_bfs, -1);

        queue<long long> q;
        for (const Point& food : foods) {
            long long idx = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                idx += (long long)food[i] * strides[i];
            }
            if (dist[idx] == -1) {
                dist[idx] = 0;
                prev_dir[idx] = 0;
                prev_dim[idx] = -1;
                q.push(idx);
            }
        }

        while (!q.empty()) {
            long long idx = q.front();
            q.pop();
            Point p(D);
            long long temp = idx;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                p[i] = temp / strides[i];
                temp = temp % strides[i];
            }
            for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                    Point np = p;
                    np[dim] += d;
                    if (np[dim] < 0 || np[dim] >= bounds[dim]) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long long nidx = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                        nidx += (long long)np[i] * strides[i];
                    }
                    if (dist[nidx] == -1) {
                        dist[nidx] = dist[idx] + 1;
                        prev_dir[nidx] = d;
                        prev_dim[nidx] = dim;
                        q.push(nidx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int turns = 0;
    while (turns < max_turns && !foods.empty()) {
        int axis = -1;
        int direction = 0;
        if (use_bfs) {
            long long idx = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                idx += (long long)head[i] * strides[i];
            }
            if (dist[idx] == -1) {
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                if (head[0] + direction >= bounds[0]) {
                    direction = -1;
                }
            } else {
                axis = prev_dim[idx];
                direction = prev_dir[idx];
                if (axis == -1) {
                    axis = 0;
                    direction = 1;
                    if (head[0] + direction >= bounds[0]) {
                        direction = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            long long min_dist = LLONG_MAX;
            Point target_food;
            for (const Point& food : foods) {
                long long d = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    d += abs((long long)head[i] - food[i]);
                }
                if (d < min_dist) {
                    min_dist = d;
                    target_food = food;
                }
            }
            int best_dim = -1;
            long long best_diff = -1;
            for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                long long diff = abs((long long)head[dim] - target_food[dim]);
                if (diff > best_diff) {
                    best_diff = diff;
                    best_dim = dim;
                }
            }
            axis = best_dim;
            if (head[axis] < target_food[axis]) {
                direction = 1;
            } else if (head[axis] > target_food[axis]) {
                direction = -1;
            } else {
                for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                    if (head[dim] != target_food[dim]) {
                        axis = dim;
                        if (head[dim] < target_food[dim]) {
                            direction = 1;
                        } else {
                            direction = -1;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (axis == -1) {
                    axis = 0;
                    direction = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        Point new_head = head;
        new_head[axis] += direction;
        bool valid = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
            if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!valid) {
            for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                Point test_head = head;
                test_head[axis] += d;
                bool test_valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        test_valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (test_valid) {
                    direction = d;
                    new_head = test_head;
                    valid = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!valid) {
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                new_head = head;
                new_head[axis] += direction;
                if (new_head[0] < 0 || new_head[0] >= bounds[0]) {
                    direction = -1;
                    new_head[0] = head[0] + direction;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        new_head[i] = 0;
                    }
                }
                valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0 || new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!valid) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                        new_head[i] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        bool self_collision = snake_set.find(new_head) != snake_set.end();
        bool obstacle_collision = obstacles.find(new_head) != obstacles.end();
        if (self_collision || obstacle_collision) {
            for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                Point test_head = head;
                test_head[axis] += d;
                bool test_valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                        test_valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!test_valid) continue;
                bool test_self = snake_set.find(test_head) != snake_set.end();
                bool test_obs = obstacles.find(test_head) != obstacles.end();
                if (!test_self && !test_obs) {
                    axis = axis;
                    direction = d;
                    new_head = test_head;
                    self_collision = false;
                    obstacle_collision = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (self_collision || obstacle_collision) {
                for (int dim = 0; dim < D; dim++) {
                    if (dim == axis) continue;
                    for (int d : {-1, 1}) {
                        Point test_head = head;
                        test_head[dim] += d;
                        bool test_valid = true;
                        for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                            if (test_head[i] < 0 || test_head[i] >= bounds[i]) {
                                test_valid = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!test_valid) continue;
                        bool test_self = snake_set.find(test_head) != snake_set.end();
                        bool test_obs = obstacles.find(test_head) != obstacles.end();
                        if (!test_self && !test_obs) {
                            axis = dim;
                            direction = d;
                            new_head = test_head;
                            self_collision = false;
                            obstacle_collision = false;
                            goto found_safe;
                        }
                    }
                }
                axis = 0;
                direction = 1;
                new_head = head;
                new_head[0] += direction;
                for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                    if (new_head[i] < 0) new_head[i] = 0;
                    if (new_head[i] >= bounds[i]) new_head[i] = bounds[i]-1;
                }
                found_safe:;
            }
        }

        cout << axis << " " << direction << endl;

        bool ate = false;
        auto it_food = find(foods.begin(), foods.end(), new_head);
        if (it_food != foods.end()) {
            foods.erase(it_food);
            ate = true;
        }

        snake_body.insert(snake_body.begin(), new_head);
        snake_set.insert(new_head);
        if (!ate) {
            Point tail = snake_body.back();
            snake_body.pop_back();
            snake_set.erase(tail);
        }
        head = new_head;

        turns++;
    }

    return 0;
}

using System;

                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (3,0) },   // 2: same as 0
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (0,2), (0,3) }    // 3: same as 1
            },
            ['O'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>
            {
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) },
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) },
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) },
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) }
            },
            ['T'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>
            {
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (1,1) },   // 0: T up
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (1,0), (1,1), (1,2), (0,1) },   // 1: T left
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,1), (1,1), (2,1), (1,0) },   // 2: T down
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (0,2), (1,1) }    // 3: T right
            },
            ['S'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>
            {
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (1,0), (2,0), (0,1), (1,1) },   // 0: horizontal S
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1,2) },   // 1: vertical S
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (1,0), (2,0), (0,1), (1,1) },   // 2: same as 0
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1,2) }    // 3: same as 1
            },
            ['Z'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>
            {
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (2,1) },   // 0: horizontal Z
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,1), (1,0), (1,1), (2,0) },   // 1: vertical Z
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (2,1) },   // 2: same as 0
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,1), (1,0), (1,1), (2,0) }    // 3: same as 1
            },
            ['J'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>
            {
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (0,2), (1,2) },   // 0: J pointing right
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (0,1) },   // 1: J pointing up
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (1,2) },   // 2: J pointing left
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (2,0), (0,1), (1,1), (2,1) }    // 3: J pointing down

            ['L'] = new List<List<(int dx, int dy)>>

                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (2,1) },   // 1: L pointing up
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,2), (1,0), (1,1), (1,2) },   // 2: L pointing right
                new List<(int dx, int dy)> { (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (2,0) }    // 3: L pointing down
            }

                Console.Flush();

                continue;
            }

            var rotations = shapes[pieceType];
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            int bestScore = int.MinValue;

            // Try all rotations and columns
            for (int rot = 0; rot < rotations.Count; rot++)
            {
                var shape = rotations[rot];
                int minX = shape.Min(p => p.dx);
                int maxX = shape.Max(p => p.dx);
                int minY = shape.Min(p => p.dy);
                int maxY = shape.Max(p => p.dy);

                int shapeWidth = maxX - minX + 1;
                int shapeHeight = maxY - minY + 1;

                // Adjust shape so that (0,0) is top-left of bounding box for easier placement
                var adjustedShape = shape.Select(p => (p.dx - minX, p.dy - minY)).ToList();

                    if (landingRow < 0) continue; // Would go above board

                    // Create temporary board to evaluate
                    bool[,] tempBoard = (bool[,])board.Clone();
                    foreach (var (dx, dy) in adjustedShape)
                    {
                        int x = col + dx;
                        int y = landingRow + dy;
                        if (y >= 0 && y < height && x >= 0 && x < width)
                        {
                            tempBoard[y, x] = true;
                        }
                    }

                    // Clear lines and compute score
                    int cleared = ClearLines(ref tempBoard);
                    int score = EvaluateBoard(tempBoard, cleared, width, height);

                    if (score > bestScore)
                    {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Output decision
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Flush();

            // Apply the piece to the real board
            var chosenShape = rotations[bestRotation];
            int minX = chosenShape.Min(p => p.dx);
            int maxX = chosenShape.Max(p => p.dx);
            int minY = chosenShape.Min(p => p.dy);
            int maxY = chosenShape.Max(p => p.dy);
            var adjustedChosenShape = chosenShape.Select(p => (p.dx - minX, p.dy - minY)).ToList();
            int shapeWidthChosen = maxX - minX + 1;
            int shapeHeightChosen = maxY - minY + 1;

            int dropHeightChosen = GetDropHeight(board, adjustedChosenShape, bestColumn, height, width);
            int landingRowChosen = dropHeightChosen - shapeHeightChosen;

            if (landingRowChosen < 0)
            {
                // Piece doesn't fit - game over
                // But we already placed it? We'll let the judge handle gameover
                // Just place as high as possible
                landingRowChosen = 0;
            }

            foreach (var (dx, dy) in adjustedChosenShape)
            {
                int x = bestColumn + dx;
                int y = landingRowChosen + dy;
                if (y >= 0 && y < height && x >= 0 && x < width)
                {
                    board[y, x] = true;
                }
            }

            // Clear lines on real board
            ClearLines(ref board);

            // Read result from judge
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            // We could use result to adapt, but for simplicity we ignore
            // In a real adaptive system, we might change strategy based on cleared_N or gameover
        }
    }

    // Returns the height (y) where the bottom of the piece will land when dropped at column `col`
    // The shape is given in coordinates where (0,0) is top-left of its bounding box
    // Returns the y-coordinate of the bottom edge of the shape's bounding box when landed
    // If the piece cannot be placed (e.g., collision at y=0), returns -1
    static int GetDropHeight(bool[,] board, List<(int dx, int dy)> shape, int col, int height, int width)
    {
        int shapeWidth = shape.Max(p => p.dx) - shape.Min(p => p.dx) + 1;
        int shapeHeight = shape.Max(p => p.dy) - shape.Min(p => p.dy) + 1;

        // We'll drop from top and find first collision
        for (int dropY = 0; dropY <= height; dropY++)
        {
            bool collision = false;
            foreach (var (dx, dy) in shape)
            {
                int x = col + dx;
                int y = dropY + dy;
                if (x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= height)
                {
                    collision = true;
                    break;
                }
                if (board[y, x])
                {
                    collision = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (collision)
            {
                // Land one above collision
                int landY = dropY - 1;
                // Check if the piece is entirely above board (landY + shapeHeight < 0) -> invalid
                if (landY + shapeHeight < 0)
                {
                    return -1; // Doesn't fit
                }
                return landY + shapeHeight; // Return bottom of bounding box
            }
        }
        // If we dropped all the way to bottom without collision
        return height; // Lands at bottom
    }

    // Clears full lines and returns number of lines cleared
    static int ClearLines(ref bool[,] board)
    {
        int height = board.GetLength(0);
        int width = board.GetLength(1);
        int cleared = 0;
        int writeRow = height - 1;

        for (int readRow = height - 1; readRow >= 0; readRow--)
        {
            bool full = true;
            for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
            {
                if (!board[readRow, x])
                {
                    full = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!full)
            {
                if (writeRow != readRow)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                    {
                        board[writeRow, x] = board[readRow, x];
                    }
                }
                writeRow--;
            }
            else
            {
                cleared++;
            }
        }

        // Clear rows above writeRow
        for (int row = writeRow; row >= 0; row--)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
            {
                board[row, x] = false;
            }
        }

        return cleared;
    }

    // Evaluates the board state: higher is better
    // We use a weighted sum of: lines cleared (already counted), hole count, bumpiness, height
    static int EvaluateBoard(bool[,] board, int linesCleared, int width, int height)
    {
        int score = linesCleared * 1000; // Prioritize line clears

        int holes = 0;
        int bumpiness = 0;
        int[] colHeights = new int[width];
        int totalHeight = 0;

        // Compute column heights (from bottom up: first filled cell from top)
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
        {
            int heightInCol = 0;
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                if (board[y, x])
                {
                    heightInCol = height - y; // Height from bottom
                    break;
                }
            }
            colHeights[x] = heightInCol;
            totalHeight += heightInCol;
        }

        // Count holes: empty cell with at least one filled cell above it in the same column
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
        {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                if (board[y, x])
                {
                    foundBlock = true;
                }
                else if (foundBlock)
                {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }

        // Bumpiness: sum of absolute differences between adjacent columns
        for (int x = 0; x < width - 1; x++)
        {
            bumpiness += Math.Abs(colHeights[x] - colHeights[x + 1]);
        }

        // Penalize holes, bumpiness, and average height
        score -= holes * 50;
        score -= bumpiness * 10;
        score -= (totalHeight / width) * 2; // Average height penalty

        return score;
    }
}

    static int GetDropHeight(bool[,] board, List<(int dx, int dy)> shape, int col, int height, int width)
    {

            }

            }

        for (int row = writeRow; row >= 0; row--)
        {

            }

You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader, Write};
use std::collections::{VecDeque, HashSet};
use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

const UPDATE_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);
const MIN_OUTPUT_HZ: f64 = 20.0;
const MIN_OUTPUT_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / MIN_OUTPUT_HZ);
const LANDER_SIZE: f64 = 1.0;
const SAFE_VELOCITY: f64 = 2.0;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
struct Vec2 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl Vec2 {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self { Self { x, y } }
    fn magnitude(self) -> f64 { self.x.hypot(self.y) }
    fn dot(self, other: Self) -> f64 { self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y }
    fn normalize(self) -> Self {
        let m = self.magnitude();
        if m < 1e-6 { Self::new(0.0, 0.0) } else { Self::new(self.x / m, self.y / m) }
    }
    fn rotate(self, angle: f64) -> Self {
        let cos = angle.cos();
        let sin = angle.sin();
        Self::new(
            self.x * cos - self.y * sin,
            self.x * sin + self.y * cos,
        )
    }
}

struct Map {
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    gravity: f64,
    max_thrust: f64,
    fuel: f64,
    start: Vec2,
    target: Vec2,
    obstacles: HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
    landing_zone: HashSet<(usize, usize)>,
}

impl Map {
    fn is_obstacle(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> bool {
        let ix = x.floor() as isize;
        let iy = y.floor() as isize;
        if ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= self.width as isize || iy >= self.height as isize {
            return true;
        }
        self.obstacles.contains(&(ix as usize, iy as usize))
    }

    fn is_in_landing_zone(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> bool {
        let ix = x.floor() as isize;
        let iy = y.floor() as isize;
        if ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= self.width as isize || iy >= self.height as isize {
            return false;
        }
        self.landing_zone.contains(&(ix as usize, iy as usize))
    }
}

struct State {
    pos: Vec2,
    vel: Vec2,
    angle: f64,
    angular_vel: f64,
    fuel: f64,
}

struct Controller {
    map: Map,
    state: Option<State>,
    last_output: std::time::Instant,
    command_tx: mpsc::Sender<(f64, f64)>,
    shutdown_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<()>>,
    worker_handle: Option<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Controller {
    fn new(map: Map) -> Self {
        let (command_tx, command_rx) = mpsc::channel();
        let (shutdown_tx, shutdown_rx) = mpsc::channel();

        let worker_handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut last_command = (0.0, 0.0);
            loop {
                // Non-blocking receive with timeout to check for shutdown
                match command_rx.recv_timeout(UPDATE_INTERVAL) {
                    Ok((thrust, turn)) => {
                        last_command = (thrust, turn);
                    }
                    Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => {
                        // Use last command
                    }
                    Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => break,
                }

                // Output at minimum 20Hz
                println!("{} {}", last_command.0, last_command.1);
                io::stdout().flush().unwrap();

                // Sleep until next output interval
                thread::sleep(MIN_OUTPUT_INTERVAL);
            }
        });

        Self {
            map,
            state: None,
            last_output: std::time::Instant::now(),
            command_tx,
            shutdown_tx: Some(shutdown_tx),
            worker_handle: Some(worker_handle),
        }
    }

    fn update_state(&mut self, x: f64, y: f64, vx: f64, vy: f64, angle: f64, angular_vel: f64, fuel: f64) {
        self.state = Some(State {
            pos: Vec2::new(x, y),
            vel: Vec2::new(vx, vy),
            angle,
            angular_vel,
            fuel,
        });
    }

    fn compute_control(&self, state: &State) -> (f64, f64) {
        // Simple PD controller for position and velocity
        let target_pos = self.map.target;
        let pos_error = Vec2::new(target_pos.x - state.pos.x, target_pos.y - state.pos.y);
        let vel_error = Vec2::new(0.0 - state.vel.x, 0.0 - state.vel.y); // Target zero velocity

        // Proportional gains
        let kp_pos = 0.5;
        let kd_vel = 0.8;

        // Desired acceleration in world frame
        let desired_acc = Vec2::new(
            kp_pos * pos_error.x + kd_vel * vel_error.x,
            kp_pos * pos_error.y + kd_vel * vel_error.y,
        );

        // Compensate for gravity
        let gravity_acc = Vec2::new(0.0, self.map.gravity);
        let required_acc = Vec2::new(
            desired_acc.x - gravity_acc.x,
            desired_acc.y - gravity_acc.y,
        );

        // Convert required acceleration to thrust direction
        let thrust_dir = Vec2::new(state.angle.cos(), state.angle.sin()); // Facing direction

        let thrust = thrust_mag.max(0.0).min(1.0);

        let to_target = Vec2::new(target_pos.x - state.pos.x, target_pos.y - state.pos.y);

        // But we want to compute error in standard math.
        let standard_state_angle = -state.angle + std::f64::consts::PI / 2.0;

        let mut angle_error = standard_target_angle - standard_state_angle;

        while angle_error < -std::f64::consts::PI { angle_error += 2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI; }

        // Proportional turning
        let kp_turn = 2.0;
        let turn = (kp_turn * angle_error).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);

        (thrust, turn)
    }

        let stdin = io::stdin();

                            '#' => { obstacles.insert((x, y)); }
                            'S' => {} // Start already read
                            'T' => {} // Target already read
                            'L' => { landing_zone.insert((x, y)); }
                            _ => {} // '.' or others
                        }
                    }
                    y += 1;
                }

                self.map = Map {
                    width,
                    height,
                    gravity,
                    max_thrust,
                    fuel,
                    start: Vec2::new(start_x, start_y),
                    target: Vec2::new(target_x, target_y),
                    obstacles,
                    landing_zone,
                };
            }
        }

        // Main loop: read state updates and send to worker
        for line in handle.flatten() {
            let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
            if parts.len() < 7 {
                continue; // Skip invalid lines
            }
            let x = parts[0];
            let y = parts[1];

            let vy = parts[3];

struct Vec2 {
    x: f64,

}

impl Vec2 {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self { Self { x, y } }
    fn magnitude(self) -> f64 { self.x.hypot(self.y) }
    fn dot(self, other: Self) -> f64 { self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y }
    fn normalize(self) -> Self {
        let m = self.magnitude();
        if m < 1e-6 { Self::new(0.0, 0.0) } else { Self::new(self.x / m, self.y / m) }
    }
    fn rotate(self, angle: f64) -> Self {
        let cos = angle.cos();
        let sin = angle.sin();
        Self::new(
            self.x * cos - self.y * sin,
            self.x * sin + self.y * cos,
        )
    }
}

    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    gravity: f64,
    max_thrust: f64,
    fuel: f64,

}

impl Map {

        let ix = x.floor() as isize;
        let iy = y.floor() as isize;
        if ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= self.width as isize || iy >= self.height as isize {
            return true;
        }
        self.obstacles.contains(&(ix as usize, iy as usize))
    }

        let ix = x.floor() as isize;
        let iy = y.floor() as isize;
        if ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= self.width as isize || iy >= self.height as isize {

        }

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play a 3D Lunar Lander game in real-time.

Your C++ controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from tiny (100m) to huge (100km).
The same code must work for all scales.

Control a lunar lander in full 3D space to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a terrain file path and continuous state updates via stdin, and must
output thrust/rotation commands to stdout in real-time.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}
```

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit

**Environment:**
Platform: Windows 11 (build 10.0.26200)
Architecture: AMD64
CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 8 Stepping 2, AuthenticAMD
Core count: 64
Memory: 127.87 GB
SIMD: AVX, AVX2, SSE, SSE2, SSE3, SSE4.1, SSE4.2, SSSE3
SIMD detail: AVX=yes, AVX-512F=no, AVX2=yes, SSE=yes, SSE2=yes, SSE3=yes, SSE4.1=yes, SSE4.2=yes, SSSE3=yes

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>

struct TerrainData {
    int width;
    int depth;
    int height;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::array<uint16_t, 3>>> data;
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::atomic<bool> ready{false};
    std::atomic<bool> error{false};
};

bool loadTerrainAsync(const std::string& filename, TerrainData& terrain) {
    std::ifstream file(filename, std::ios::binary);
    if (!file) {
        terrain.error = true;
        return false;
    }

    file.seekg(0, std::ios::end);
    std::streampos fileSize = file.tellg();
    file.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);

    int64_t expectedSize = static_cast<int64_t>(terrain.width) * terrain.depth * 6;
    if (fileSize != expectedSize) {
        terrain.error = true;
        return false;
    }

    terrain.data.resize(terrain.width, std::vector<std::array<uint16_t, 3>>(terrain.depth));

    for (int x = 0; x < terrain.width; x++) {
        for (int y = 0; y < terrain.depth; y++) {
            uint16_t a, b, c;
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&a), sizeof(a));
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&b), sizeof(b));
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&c), sizeof(c));

            if (!file) {
                terrain.error = true;
                return false;
            }

            terrain.data[x][y] = {a, b, c};
        }
    }

    if (!file) {
        terrain.error = true;
        return false;
    }

    terrain.ready = true;
    return true;
}

bool checkCollision(double x, double y, double z, const TerrainData& terrain) {
    if (x < 0 || x >= terrain.width || y < 0 || y >= terrain.depth || z < 0 || z >= terrain.height) {
        return true;
    }

    int xi = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
    int yi = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
    if (xi < 0 || xi >= terrain.width || yi < 0 || yi >= terrain.depth) {
        return true;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(terrain.mutex);
    const auto& cell = terrain.data[xi][yi];
    uint16_t a = cell[0];
    uint16_t b = cell[1];
    uint16_t c = cell[2];

    int zi = static_cast<int>(std::floor(z));
    if (zi < a) {
        return true;
    }
    if (b <= zi && zi < c) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    std::string line;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        return 1;
    }

    std::istringstream headerStream(line);
    double width_d, depth_d, height_d, gravity, max_thrust, fuel;
    if (!(headerStream >> width_d >> depth_d >> height_d >> gravity >> max_thrust >> fuel)) {
        return 1;
    }
    int width = static_cast<int>(width_d);
    int depth = static_cast<int>(depth_d);
    int height = static_cast<int>(height_d);

    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        return 1;
    }
    std::istringstream startTargetStream(line);
    double start_x, start_y, start_z, target_x, target_y, target_z;
    if (!(startTargetStream >> start_x >> start_y >> start_z >> target_x >> target_y >> target_z)) {
        return 1;
    }

    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        return 1;
    }
    std::string terrain_file_path = line;

    TerrainData terrain;
    terrain.width = width;
    terrain.depth = depth;
    terrain.height = height;

    std::thread loadThread([&]() {
        loadTerrainAsync(terrain_file_path, terrain);
    });

    double last_output_time = -1.0;
    const double output_interval = 0.1;

    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        std::istringstream stateStream(line);
        double x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, pitch, yaw, roll, pitch_rate, yaw_rate, roll_rate, fuel_remaining;
        if (!(stateStream >> x >> y >> z >> vx >> vy >> vz >> pitch >> yaw >> roll >> pitch_rate >> yaw_rate >> roll_rate >> fuel_remaining)) {
            continue;
        }

        double current_time = -1.0;
        auto now = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto duration = now.time_since_epoch();
        current_time = std::chrono::duration<double>(duration).count();

        if (current_time - last_output_time < output_interval) {
            continue;
        }
        last_output_time = current_time;

        double dx = target_x - x;
        double dy = target_y - y;
        double dz = target_z - z;

        const double kp = 0.5;
        const double kd = 1.0;
        double ax_des = kp * dx - kd * vx;
        double ay_des = kp * dy - kd * vy;
        double az_des = kp * dz - kd * vz + 1.62;

        double sin_pitch = std::sin(pitch);
        double cos_pitch = std::cos(pitch);
        double sin_yaw = std::sin(yaw);
        double cos_yaw = std::cos(yaw);

        double ux = cos_pitch * cos_yaw;
        double uy = cos_pitch * sin_yaw;
        double uz = sin_pitch;

        double dot = ax_des * ux + ay_des * uy + az_des * uz;
        double thrust_cmd = std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, dot));

        double cross_x = uy * az_des - uz * ay_des;
        double cross_y = uz * ax_des - ux * az_des;
        double cross_z = ux * ay_des - uy * ax_des;
        double cross_mag = std::sqrt(cross_x * cross_x + cross_y * cross_y + cross_z * cross_z);

        double pitch_cmd = 0.0;
        double yaw_cmd = 0.0;
        if (cross_mag > 1e-5) {
            pitch_cmd = cross_x / cross_mag;
            yaw_cmd = cross_y / cross_mag;
        }
        pitch_cmd = std::max(-1.0, std::min(1.0, pitch_cmd));
        yaw_cmd = std::max(-1.0, std::min(1.0, yaw_cmd));

        double roll_cmd = 0.0;

        std::cout << thrust_cmd << " " << pitch_cmd << " " << yaw_cmd << " " << roll_cmd << std::endl;
        std::cout.flush();
    }

    if (loadThread.joinable()) {
        loadThread.join();
    }

    return 0;
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C# code to calculate an asteroid interception trajectory.

You must write a C# solver that can handle an interception and redirection scenarios, from
short warning times (1-2 years), large impactors, generous delta-v, simple trajectories to
very long warning times (30-50 years), very small impactors, very tight delta-v,
advanced trajectory optimization with multi-flyby maneuvers and gravitational assist sequences required.

**Problem:**
Calculate a spacecraft trajectory to intercept and deflect an asteroid on collision course
with Earth using kinetic impact.

**The solver must output:**
1. Launch window and initial trajectory
2. Mid-course correction burn(s)
3. Final approach for kinetic impact

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal/scientific notation numbers):**
```
num_bodies warning_days impactor_mass delta_v_budget asteroid_mass t0_unix_utc
body_name mass x y z vx vy vz (for each body)
de421.bsp_file_path
```

All values are in SI units unless otherwise specified. Eg mass of earth is 5.972e24 kg.
All positions + velocities are relative to solar system barycenter.
Delta_v budget is in m/s.

The body name for the asteriod is "Asteroid". The body name for where your spacecraft originates
and you must redirect the asteroid to avoid is "Earth".

**Output format (stdout):**
```
num_burns
launch_time burn_dv_x burn_dv_y burn_dv_z
correction_time1 burn_dv_x burn_dv_y burn_dv_z
...
impact_time impact_dv_x impact_dv_y impact_dv_z
```

**Time units:**
- All times are in **days since scenario start (t=0 at the provided initial state)**.
- The **launch window is [0, warning_days]** (inclusive).
- **t0_unix_utc** is the UTC time of the provided initial state (t=0).

The simulation uses the JPL DE421 model of the solar system with Sun, Earth, Moon, and major planets,
and a KDK integrator to calculate trajectories. The path to the DE421 model is provided in the input
so your code can precisely match the simulation at extreme precision.

**Success Criteria:**
- Spacecraft intercepts asteroid before Earth impact (within 1000km)
- Kinetic impact transfers enough momentum to deflect asteroid sufficiently to miss Earth
- Total delta-v usage stays within budget
- Launch occurs within specified window
