using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Numerics;

namespace AsteroidInterceptor
{
    class Program
    {
        // Constants
        private const double AU = 149597870700.0; // meters
        private const double DAY_IN_SECONDS = 86400.0;
        private const double MU_SUN = 1.32712440018e20; // m^3/s^2
        private const double MU_EARTH = 3.986004418e14; // m^3/s^2
        private const double TARGET_MISS_DISTANCE = 1.5e11; // 1 AU - safe miss distance
        private const double IMPACT_TOLERANCE = 1000.0; // meters
        private const double MIN_DT = 60.0; // minimum timestep (seconds)
        private const double MAX_DT = 86400.0; // maximum timestep (1 day)

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            try
            {
                // Read input
                var input = ReadInput();
                
                // Extract parameters
                var numBodies = input.NumBodies;
                var warningDays = input.WarningDays;
                var impactorMass = input.ImpactorMass;
                var deltaVBudget = input.DeltaVBudget;
                var asteroidMass = input.AsteroidMass;
                var t0UnixUtc = input.T0UnixUtc;
                var bodies = input.Bodies;
                var de421Path = input.De421Path;
                
                // Find Earth and Asteroid
                var earth = bodies.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "Earth");
                var asteroid = bodies.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "Asteroid");
                
                if (earth == null || asteroid == null)
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Error: Earth or Asteroid not found in input");
                    return;
                }
                
                // Check if asteroid is on collision course
                if (!IsOnCollisionCourse(asteroid, earth, warningDays))
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Warning: Asteroid not on collision course with Earth");
                }
                
                // Solve the interception problem
                var solution = SolveInterception(
                    asteroid, earth, 
                    impactorMass, deltaVBudget, 
                    warningDays, t0UnixUtc, 
                    bodies, de421Path);
                
                // Output solution
                OutputSolution(solution);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Error: {ex.Message}");
                // Fallback: output minimal valid solution
                Console.WriteLine("0");
            }
        }

        private static InputData ReadInput()
        {
            var lines = new List<string>();
            string line;
            while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                lines.Add(line.Trim());
                if (line == "") break; // Handle potential empty line
            }

            if (lines.Count < 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No input provided");

            // Parse first line
            var firstLine = lines[0].Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            if (firstLine.Length < 6)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid first line format");

            var numBodies = int.Parse(firstLine[0]);
            var warningDays = double.Parse(firstLine[1]);
            var impactorMass = double.Parse(firstLine[2]);
            var deltaVBudget = double.Parse(firstLine[3]);
            var asteroidMass = double.Parse(firstLine[4]);
            var t0UnixUtc = double.Parse(firstLine[5]);

            var bodies = new List<CelestialBody>();
            int bodyIndex = 1;
            
            // Parse body data
            for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; i++)
            {
                if (bodyIndex >= lines.Count)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Not enough body data lines");
                
                var bodyLine = lines[bodyIndex++];
                var parts = bodyLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length < 7)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid body line format: {bodyLine}");

                var name = parts[0];
                var mass = double.Parse(parts[1]);
                var x = double.Parse(parts[2]);
                var y = double.Parse(parts[3]);
                var z = double.Parse(parts[4]);
                var vx = double.Parse(parts[5]);
                var vy = double.Parse(parts[6]);
                var vz = double.Parse(parts[7]);

                bodies.Add(new CelestialBody
                {
                    Name = name,
                    Mass = mass,
                    Position = new Vector3((float)x, (float)y, (float)z),
                    Velocity = new Vector3((float)vx, (float)vy, (float)vz)
                });
            }

            // Get DE421 path
            string de421Path = "";
            if (bodyIndex < lines.Count)
            {
                de421Path = lines[bodyIndex].Trim();
            }

            return new InputData
            {
                NumBodies = numBodies,
                WarningDays = warningDays,
                ImpactorMass = impactorMass,
                DeltaVBudget = deltaVBudget,
                AsteroidMass = asteroidMass,
                T0UnixUtc = t0UnixUtc,
                Bodies = bodies,
                De421Path = de421Path
            };
        }

        private static bool IsOnCollisionCourse(CelestialBody asteroid, CelestialBody earth, double warningDays)
        {
            // Simple check: if asteroid is approaching Earth within warning time
            var relativePos = asteroid.Position - earth.Position;
            var relativeVel = asteroid.Velocity - earth.Velocity;
            
            // Time to closest approach (simplified)
            double tca = -Vector3.Dot(relativePos, relativeVel) / Vector3.Dot(relativeVel, relativeVel);
            double minDistance = Vector3.Length(relativePos + relativeVel * (float)tca);
            
            return tca > 0 && tca <= warningDays * DAY_IN_SECONDS && minDistance < 2 * AU;
        }

        private static InterceptionSolution SolveInterception(
            CelestialBody asteroid, 
            CelestialBody earth,
            double impactorMass,
            double deltaVBudget,
            double warningDays,
            double t0UnixUtc,
            List<CelestialBody> bodies,
            string de421Path)
        {
            var solution = new InterceptionSolution();
            
            // For simplicity in this implementation, we use a direct interception approach
            // In a real scenario, this would use advanced trajectory optimization
            
            // Calculate time of impact with Earth (if no deflection)
            double timeToEarthImpact = EstimateTimeToImpact(asteroid, earth, warningDays);
            
            // We want to intercept before Earth impact
            double maxInterceptTime = Math.Min(timeToEarthImpact * 0.8, warningDays * DAY_IN_SECONDS);
            
            if (maxInterceptTime <= 0)
            {
                // Fallback: launch immediately
                maxInterceptTime = warningDays * DAY_IN_SECONDS * 0.5;
            }
            
            // Determine launch time (spread search over warning window)
            double bestLaunchTime = 0;
            double bestDeltaV = double.MaxValue;
            Vector3 bestLaunchBurn = Vector3.Zero;
            Vector3 bestImpactBurn = Vector3.Zero;
            double bestImpactTime = 0;
            
            // Search for optimal launch window (sample points)
            int samples = Math.Min(20, (int)(warningDays * 2)); // At least 2 samples per day
            for (int i = 0; i <= samples; i++)
            {
                double launchTime = (double)i / samples * warningDays * DAY_IN_SECONDS;
                
                // Try to find interception trajectory
                var attempt = TryInterceptTrajectory(
                    asteroid, earth, impactorMass, 
                    launchTime, maxInterceptTime, 
                    deltaVBudget, bodies, de421Path);
                
                if (attempt.Success && attempt.TotalDeltaV < bestDeltaV)
                {
                    bestDeltaV = attempt.TotalDeltaV;
                    bestLaunchTime = launchTime;
                    bestLaunchBurn = attempt.LaunchBurn;
                    bestImpactBurn = attempt.ImpactBurn;
                    bestImpactTime = attempt.ImpactTime;
                }
            }
            
            // If no solution found, use fallback
            if (bestDeltaV == double.MaxValue)
            {
                return GenerateFallbackSolution(asteroid, earth, impactorMass, 
                                              deltaVBudget, warningDays, t0UnixUtc);
            }
            
            solution.LaunchTimeDays = bestLaunchTime / DAY_IN_SECONDS;
            solution.LaunchBurn = bestLaunchBurn;
            solution.ImpactTimeDays = bestImpactTime / DAY_IN_SECONDS;
            solution.ImpactBurn = bestImpactBurn;
            
            // For this simplified model, we assume direct interception with no mid-course corrections
            solution.Burns = new List<InterceptionBurn>
            {
                new InterceptionBurn { TimeDays = solution.LaunchTimeDays, DeltaV = solution.LaunchBurn },
                new InterceptionBurn { TimeDays = solution.ImpactTimeDays, DeltaV = solution.ImpactBurn }
            };
            
            return solution;
        }

        private static double EstimateTimeToImpact(CelestialBody asteroid, CelestialBody earth, double warningDays)
        {
            var relativePos = asteroid.Position - earth.Position;
            var relativeVel = asteroid.Velocity - earth.Velocity;
            
            double velSq = Vector3.Dot(relativeVel, relativeVel);
            if (velSq < 1e-10) return warningDays * DAY_IN_SECONDS; // Avoid division by zero
            
            double tca = -Vector3.Dot(relativePos, relativeVel) / velSq;
            return Math.Max(0, tca);
        }

        private static TrajectoryAttempt TryInterceptTrajectory(
            CelestialBody asteroid,
            CelestialBody earth,
            double impactorMass,
            double launchTime,
            double maxInterceptTime,
            double deltaVBudget,
            List<CelestialBody> bodies,
            string de421Path)
        {
            var attempt = new TrajectoryAttempt();
            
            // Get states at launch time
            var scStateAtLaunch = PropagateState(earth, launchTime, bodies, de421Path);
            var asteroidStateAtLaunch = PropagateState(asteroid, launchTime, bodies, de421Path);
            
            // Simple Lambert-like solution for interception
            var asteroidStateAtImpact = PropagateState(asteroid, maxInterceptTime, bodies, de421Path);
            
            // Calculate required velocity change for interception
            var r0 = scStateAtLaunch.Position;
            var v0 = scStateAtLaunch.Velocity;
            var rf = asteroidStateAtImpact.Position;
            var tof = maxInterceptTime - launchTime;
            
            if (tof <= MIN_DT) return attempt; // Too short time of flight
            
            // Simplified two-impulse solution
            var vfNeeded = (rf - r0) / (float)tof; // Simplified
            
            // Launch burn: from Earth orbit to transfer trajectory
            var launchBurn = vfNeeded - v0;
            double launchDeltaV = Vector3.Length(launchBurn);
            
            // Impact burn: match asteroid velocity
            var asteroidVelocityAtImpact = PropagateState(asteroid, maxInterceptTime, bodies, de421Path).Velocity;
            var impactBurn = asteroidVelocityAtImpact - vfNeeded;
            double impactDeltaV = Vector3.Length(impactBurn);
            
            attempt.TotalDeltaV = launchDeltaV + impactDeltaV;
            attempt.Success = attempt.TotalDeltaV <= deltaVBudget;
            
            if (attempt.Success)
            {
                attempt.LaunchBurn = launchBurn;
                attempt.ImpactBurn = impactBurn;
                attempt.ImpactTime = maxInterceptTime;
            }
            
            return attempt;
        }

        private static CelestialBodyState PropagateState(
            CelestialBody body, 
            double timeSeconds, 
            List<CelestialBody> bodies,
            string de421Path)
        {
            // In a real implementation, this would use DE421 and numerical integration
            // For this simplified version, we use two-body approximation with sun
            
            // Find the Sun for central body approximation
            var sun = bodies.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "Sun");
            if (sun == null)
            {
                // Fallback to no propagation
                return new CelestialBodyState
                {
                    Position = body.Position,
                    Velocity = body.Velocity
                };
            }
            
            // Simple two-body propagation (Keplerian)
            // This is a simplification - real implementation would use numerical integration
            double mu = MU_SUN; // Use Sun's gravitational parameter
            
            // Relative to Sun
            var rRel = body.Position - sun.Position;
            var vRel = body.Velocity - sun.Velocity;
            
            // For simplicity, we assume short times and use linear approximation
            // In reality, would integrate equations of motion
            float dt = (float)timeSeconds;
            var newPosition = body.Position + body.Velocity * dt;
            var newVelocity = body.Velocity; // Ignore acceleration for simplicity
            
            return new CelestialBodyState
            {
                Position = newPosition,
                Velocity = newVelocity
            };
        }

        private static InterceptionSolution GenerateFallbackSolution(
            CelestialBody asteroid,
            CelestialBody earth,
            double impactorMass,
            double deltaVBudget,
            double warningDays,
            double t0UnixUtc)
        {
            var solution = new InterceptionSolution();
            
            // Launch immediately
            solution.LaunchTimeDays = 0;
            solution.LaunchBurn = new Vector3(0, 0, 0); // No launch burn (already at Earth)
            
            // Impact at midpoint of warning window
            solution.ImpactTimeDays = warningDays / 2;
            
            // Simple radial outward burn to deflect
            var earthToAsteroid = asteroid.Position - earth.Position;
            if (Vector3.Length(earthToAsteroid) > 1e-6)
            {
                var direction = Vector3.Normalize(earthToAsteroid);
                // Use half the budget for impact burn
                double impactSpeed = deltaVBudget * 0.5 / impactorMass; // Simplified
                solution.ImpactBurn = direction * (float)impactSpeed;
            }
            else
            {
                solution.ImpactBurn = new Vector3(1, 0, 0) * (float)(deltaVBudget * 0.5 / impactorMass);
            }
            
            solution.Burns = new List<InterceptionBurn>
            {
                new InterceptionBurn { TimeDays = 0, DeltaV = solution.LaunchBurn },
                new InterceptionBurn { TimeDays = solution.ImpactTimeDays, DeltaV = solution.ImpactBurn }
            };
            
            return solution;
        }

        private static void OutputSolution(InterceptionSolution solution)
        {
            // Output number of burns (launch and impact)
            Console.WriteLine("2");
            
            // Launch burn
            Console.WriteLine($"{solution.LaunchTimeDays:F6} {solution.LaunchBurn.X:F6} {solution.LaunchBurn.Y:F6} {solution.LaunchBurn.Z:F6}");
            
            // Impact burn
            Console.WriteLine($"{solution.ImpactTimeDays:F6} {solution.ImpactBurn.X:F6} {solution.ImpactBurn.Y:F6} {solution.ImpactBurn.Z:F6}");
        }
    }

    // Data structures
    class InputData
    {
        public int NumBodies { get; set; }
        public double WarningDays { get; set; }
        public double ImpactorMass { get; set; }
        public double DeltaVBudget { get; set; }
        public double AsteroidMass { get; set; }
        public double T0UnixUtc { get; set; }
        public List<CelestialBody> Bodies { get; set; }
        public string De421Path { get; set; }
    }

    class CelestialBody
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public double Mass { get; set; }
        public Vector3 Position { get; set; }
        public Vector3 Velocity { get; set; }
    }

    class CelestialBodyState
    {
        public Vector3 Position { get; set; }
        public Vector3 Velocity { get; set; }
    }

    class InterceptionSolution
    {
        public double LaunchTimeDays { get; set; }
        public Vector3 LaunchBurn { get; set; }
        public double ImpactTimeDays { get; set; }
        public Vector3 ImpactBurn { get; set; }
        public List<InterceptionBurn> Burns { get; set; }
    }

    class InterceptionBurn
    {
        public double TimeDays { get; set; }
        public Vector3 DeltaV { get; set; }
    }

    class TrajectoryAttempt
    {
        public bool Success { get; set; }
        public double TotalDeltaV { get; set; }
        public Vector3 LaunchBurn { get; set; }
        public Vector3 ImpactBurn { get; set; }
        public double ImpactTime { get; set; }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Rust code to cluster 3D points into exactly N clusters.

You must write a Rust solver that can handle ANY clustering scenario from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: Small datasets (1M points, 10 clusters), basic k-means, memory-friendly
- **Medium**: Moderate datasets (10M points, 100 clusters), optimized k-means, streaming
- **Large**: Large datasets (100M points, 1000 clusters), mini-batch k-means, memory constraints
- **Extreme**: Massive datasets (1B-10B points, 10000 clusters), streaming algorithms, very tight memory

**The Challenge:**
Your Rust clustering algorithm will be tested with datasets ranging from millions to billions of 3D points. The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL scales while respecting memory constraints.

**Problem:**
Given millions to billions of 3D points, partition them into exactly N clusters minimizing within-cluster variance (k-means objective). Points are provided as binary float32 triples for efficiency.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_points num_clusters
[x y z] (as binary float32 triples, num_points total)
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
[cluster_index] (as binary uint32, one per point)
```

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on point count and cluster count
2. **Performance**: Must complete within 5 minutes even for massive datasets
3. **Memory**: Must handle streaming input for datasets that don't fit in memory
4. **Quality**: Minimize within-cluster variance while producing exactly N clusters

**Algorithm Strategy Recommendations:**
- **Small datasets (≤10M points)**: Can use standard k-means with full data in memory
- **Medium datasets (10M-100M points)**: Mini-batch k-means, streaming updates
- **Large datasets (100M-1B points)**: Streaming k-means with limited memory buffers
- **Very Large datasets (>1B points)**: Very fast streaming, approximate clustering

**Key Techniques:**
- **Streaming algorithms**: Process points in batches without storing all data
- **Mini-batch k-means**: Update centroids incrementally
- **Memory management**: Use fixed-size buffers for large datasets
- **Binary I/O**: Efficient reading/writing of binary data
- **Convergence detection**: Monitor when clustering stabilizes

**Implementation Hints:**
- Detect dataset size and choose appropriate clustering algorithm
- Use efficient binary I/O (std::io::BufReader/BufWriter)
- Implement streaming updates for large datasets
- For very large datasets, use approximation algorithms
- Handle edge cases: empty clusters, convergence issues
- Use fast random access for centroid updates

**Binary Format Details:**
- Input: Points as little-endian f32 triples (12 bytes per point)
- Output: Cluster indices as little-endian u32 (4 bytes per point)
- Total input size: num_points × 12 bytes
- Total output size: num_points × 4 bytes

**Memory Constraints:**
- Small datasets: Can load all points into memory
- Medium datasets: Use streaming with moderate buffers
- Large datasets: Streaming with minimal memory footprint
- Very Large datasets: Extremely memory-efficient streaming

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with rustc (edition 2021)
2. Read binary input from stdin, write binary output to stdout
3. Handle variable point counts and cluster numbers
4. Complete within 5 minutes
5. Must handle varying dataset sizes efficiently
6. Produce exactly N clusters

Write complete, compilable Rust code with a main function.
Include adaptive logic that chooses different strategies based on clustering complexity.

fn initialize_centroids_kmeans_plus_plus(points: &[[f32; 3]], centroids: &mut Vec<[f32; 3]>, k: usize) {
    centroids.clear();
    let mut rng = thread_rng();
    let first_idx = rng.gen_range(0..points.len());
    centroids.push(points[first_idx]);
    let mut dists = vec![f32::INFINITY; points.len()];
    for _ in 1..k {
        let mut total = 0.0;
        for (i, point) in points.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut min_dist = f32::INFINITY;
            for c in centroids.iter() {
                let dx = point[0] - c[0];
                let dy = point[1] - c[1];
                let dz = point[2] - c[2];
                let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if dist < min_dist {
                    min_dist = dist;
                }
            }
            dists[i] = min_dist;
            total += min_dist;
        }
        if total == 0.0 {
            let idx = rng.gen_range(0..points.len());
            centroids.push(points[idx]);
        } else {
            let mut r = rng.gen::<f32>() * total;
            for (i, &d) in dists.iter().enumerate() {
                if r < d {
                    centroids.push(points[i]);
                    break;
                }
                r -= d;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn initialize_centroids_streaming_kmeans_plus_plus<R: Read>(
    reader: &mut BufReader<R>,
    num_points: usize,
    centroids: &mut Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    k: usize,
) {
    centroids.clear();
    let mut rng = thread_rng();
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 12];
    reader.read_exact(&mut buffer).expect("Failed to read first point");
    let x0 = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]]);
    let y0 = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[4], buffer[5], buffer[6], buffer[7]]);
    let z0 = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[8], buffer[9], buffer[10], buffer[11]]);
    centroids.push([x0, y0, z0]);
    let mut dists = Vec::new();
    for i in 1..num_points {
        reader.read_exact(&mut buffer).expect("Failed to read point");
        let x = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]]);
        let y = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[4], buffer[5], buffer[6], buffer[7]]);
        let z = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[8], buffer[9], buffer[10], buffer[11]]);
        let point = [x, y, z];
        let mut min_dist = f32::INFINITY;
        for c in centroids.iter() {
            let dx = point[0] - c[0];
            let dy = point[1] - c[1];
            let dz = point[2] - c[2];
            let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
            if dist < min_dist {
                min_dist = dist;
            }
        }
        dists.push(min_dist);
    }
    if dists.is_empty() {
        for _ in 1..k {
            centroids.push(centroids[0]);
        }
        return;
    }
    let mut total: f32 = dists.iter().sum();
    for _ in 1..k {
        if total == 0.0 {
            let idx = rng.gen_range(0..dists.len());
            centroids.push(centroids[idx]);
        } else {
            let mut r = rng.gen::<f32>() * total;
            for (i, &d) in dists.iter().enumerate() {
                if r < d {
                    centroids.push(centroids[i]);
                    break;
                }
                r -= d;
            }
        }
        total = 0.0;
        for c in centroids.iter() {
            let mut sum = 0.0;
            reader.rewind().expect("Failed to rewind");
            let mut skip = [0u8; 8];
            reader.read_exact(&mut skip).expect("Failed to skip header");
            for j in 0..num_points {
                reader.read_exact(&mut buffer).expect("Failed to read point");
                let x = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]]);
                let y = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[4], buffer[5], buffer[6], buffer[7]]);
                let z = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[8], buffer[9], buffer[10], buffer[11]]);
                let point = [x, y, z];
                let dx = point[0] - c[0];
                let dy = point[1] - c[1];
                let dz = point[2] - c[2];
                let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if dist < sum || j == 0 {
                    sum = dist;
                }
            }
            total += sum;
        }
    }
}

fn mini_batch_kmeans(
    points: &[[f32; 3]],
    centroids: &mut Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    counts: &mut Vec<u64>,
    max_iters: usize,
) {
    let n = points.len();
    let k = centroids.len();
    let mut rng = thread_rng();
    let mut assigns = vec![0usize; n];
    for iter in 0..max_iters {
        let batch_size = min(100, n);
        let mut indices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        indices.shuffle(&mut rng);
        let batch_indices = &indices[..batch_size];
        for &idx in batch_indices {
            let point = points[idx];
            let mut min_dist = f32::INFINITY;
            let mut best = 0;
            for (i, c) in centroids.iter().enumerate() {
                let dx = point[0] - c[0];
                let dy = point[1] - c[1];
                let dz = point[2] - c[2];
                let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if dist < min_dist {
                    min_dist = dist;
                    best = i;
                }
            }
            assigns[idx] = best;
            let old_count = counts[best] as f64;
            let new_count = old_count + 1.0;
            let lr = 1.0 / new_count;
            centroids[best][0] = centroids[best][0] + lr * (point[0] - centroids[best][0]) as f32;
            centroids[best][1] = centroids[best][1] + lr * (point[1] - centroids[best][1]) as f32;
            centroids[best][2] = centroids[best][2] + lr * (point[2] - centroids[best][2]) as f32;
            counts[best] = new_count as u64;
        }
    }
}

fn initialize_centroids_kmeans_plus_plus(points: &[[f32; 3]], centroids: &mut Vec<[f32; 3]>, k: usize) {
    centroids.clear();
    let mut rng = thread_rng();
    let first_idx = rng.gen_range(0..points.len());
    centroids.push(points[first_idx]);
    let mut dists = vec![f32::INFINITY; points.len()];
    for _ in 1..k {
        let mut total = 0.0;
        for (i, point) in points.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut min_dist = f32::INFINITY;
            for c in centroids.iter() {
                let dx = point[0] - c[0];
                let dy = point[1] - c[1];
                let dz = point[2] - c[2];
                let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if dist < min_dist {
                    min_dist = dist;
                }
            }
            dists[i] = min_dist;
            total += min_dist;
        }
        if total == 0.0 {
            let idx = rng.gen_range(0..points.len());
            centroids.push(points[idx]);
        } else {
            let mut r = rng.gen::<f32>() * total;
            for (i, &d) in dists.iter().enumerate() {
                if r < d {
                    centroids.push(points[i]);
                    break;
                }
                r -= d;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn initialize_centroids_streaming_kmeans_plus_plus<R: Read>(
    reader: &mut BufReader<R>,
    num_points: usize,
    centroids: &mut Vec<[f32; 3]>,

    centroids.push([x0, y0, z0]);
    let mut dists = Vec::new();
    for i in 1..num_points {
        reader.read_exact(&mut buffer).expect("Failed to read point");
        let x = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]]);
        let y = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[4], buffer[5], buffer[6], buffer[7]]);

        let point = [x, y, z];

            let dz = point[2] - c[2];
            let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
            if dist < min_dist {
                min_dist = dist;
            }
        }
        dists.push(min_dist);

    if dists.is_empty() {
        for _ in 1..k {
            centroids.push(centroids[0]);
        }
        return;
    }
    let mut total: f32 = dists.iter().sum();
    for _ in 1..k {
        if total == 0.0 {
            let idx = rng.gen_range(0..dists.len());
            centroids.push(centroids[idx]);
        } else {
            let mut r = rng.gen::<f32>() * total;
            for (i, &d) in dists.iter().enumerate() {
                if r < d {
                    centroids.push(centroids[i]);
                    break;
                }
                r -= d;
            }
        }
        total = 0.0;
        for c in centroids.iter() {
            let mut sum = 0.0;
            reader.rewind().expect("Failed to rewind");
            let mut skip = [0u8; 8];
            reader.read_exact(&mut skip).expect("Failed to skip header");
            for j in 0..num_points {
                reader.read_exact(&mut buffer).expect("Failed to read point");
                let x = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[0], buffer[1], buffer[2], buffer[3]]);
                let y = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[4], buffer[5], buffer[6], buffer[7]]);
                let z = f32::from_le_bytes([buffer[8], buffer[9], buffer[10], buffer[11]]);
                let point = [x, y, z];
                let dx = point[0] - c[0];
                let dy = point[1] - c[1];
                let dz = point[2] - c[2];
                let dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if dist < sum || j == 0 {
                    sum = dist;
                }
            }
            total += sum;
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>

using namespace std;

struct Graph {
    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<int> deg;

    Graph(int n) : n(n), adj(n), deg(n, 0) {}

    void add_edge(int u, int v) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
        deg[u]++;
        deg[v]++;
    }
};

// Compute degeneracy ordering using core decomposition (bucket sort)
vector<int> compute_degeneracy_order(const Graph& g) {
    int n = g.n;
    vector<int> deg = g.deg;
    int max_deg = *max_element(deg.begin(), deg.end());

    vector<vector int>> buckets(max_deg + 1);
    vector<int> pos(n, -1); // position in bucket
    vector<bool> removed(n, false);
    vector<int> order;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (deg[i] <= max_deg) {
            buckets[deg[i]].push_back(i);
            pos[i] = buckets[deg[i]].size() - 1;
        }
    }

    int current_deg = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // Find next non-empty bucket
        while (current_deg <= max_deg && buckets[current_deg].empty()) {
            current_deg++;
        }
        if (current_deg > max_deg) break; // should not happen

        int v = buckets[current_deg].back();
        buckets[current_deg].pop_back();
        pos[v] = -1;
        removed[v] = true;
        order.push_back(v);

        for (int u : g.adj[v]) {
            if (removed[u]) continue;
            // Remove u from its current bucket
            int old_deg = deg[u];
            if (pos[u] != -1 && pos[u] < (int)buckets[old_deg].size()) {
                // swap with last and pop
                int last = buckets[old_deg].back();
                buckets[old_deg][pos[u]] = last;
                pos[last] = pos[u];
                buckets[old_deg].pop_back();
                if (pos[last] == -1) pos[last] = buckets[old_deg].size(); // if last was moved, update
            }
            deg[u]--;
            if (deg[u] >= 0 && deg[u] <= max_deg) {
                buckets[deg[u]].push_back(u);
                pos[u] = buckets[deg[u]].size() - 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return order;
}

// Greedy coloring in given order
vector<int> greedy_color(const Graph& g, const vector<int>& order, int k) {
    int n = g.n;
    vector<int> color(n, -1);
    int max_color_used = 0;

    for (int v : order) {
        vector<bool> used(k, false);
        for (int u : g.adj[v]) {
            if (color[u] != -1) {
                if (color[u] < k) used[color[u]] = true;
            }
        }
        int c = 0;
        while (c < k && used[c]) c++;
        if (c >= k) {
            // Failed to color with k colors
            return vector<int>(n, -1); // signal failure
        }
        color[v] = c;
        if (c > max_color_used) max_color_used = c;
    }
    return color;
}

// DSATUR-like heuristic: prioritize by saturation degree, then degree
vector<int> dsatur_color(const Graph& g, int k) {
    int n = g.n;
    vector<int> color(n, -1);
    vector<int> saturation(n, 0); // number of distinct colors in neighborhood
    vector<bool> colored(n, false);

    // Priority queue: (saturation, degree, vertex) - we want max saturation, then max degree
    auto cmp = [&](const tuple<int, int, int>& a, const tuple<int, int, int>& b) {
        int sat_a = get<0>(a), deg_a = get<1>(a);
        int sat_b = get<0>(b), deg_b = get<1>(b);
        if (sat_a != sat_b) return sat_a < sat_b; // higher saturation first
        return deg_a < deg_b; // higher degree first
    };
    priority_queue<tuple<int, int, int>, vector<tuple<int, int, int>>, decltype(cmp)> pq(cmp);

    // Initialize: all uncolored, saturation=0
    for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
        pq.push({0, g.deg[v], v});
    }

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        auto [sat, deg, v] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
        if (colored[v]) continue;

        // Recompute saturation (since it may be stale)
        vector<bool> used(k, false);
        for (int u : g.adj[v]) {
            if (color[u] != -1) {
                if (color[u] < k) used[color[u]] = true;
            }
        }
        int sat_now = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < k; c++) {
            if (used[c]) sat_now++;
        }

        // If stale, reinsert with updated sat
        if (sat_now != sat) {
            pq.push({sat_now, g.deg[v], v});
            continue;
        }

        // Assign smallest available color
        int c = 0;
        while (c < k && used[c]) c++;
        if (c >= k) {
            // Should not happen if k-coloring exists, but fallback
            return vector<int>(n, -1);
        }
        color[v] = c;
        colored[v] = true;

        // Update neighbors' saturation
        for (int u : g.adj[v]) {
            if (colored[u]) continue;
            // Recompute saturation for u? Or just increment if new color is new to its neighborhood
            // Simpler: mark that u now sees color c
            bool already_seen = false;
            for (int w : g.adj[u]) {
                if (color[w] == c) {
                    already_seen = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!already_seen) {
                saturation[u]++;
                pq.push({saturation[u], g.deg[u], u});
            }
        }
    }
    return color;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m >> k)) return 0;

    Graph g(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        g.add_edge(u, v);
    }

    // Step 1: Try degeneracy ordering
    vector<int> order = compute_degeneracy_order(g);
    reverse(order.begin(), order.end()); // color from high core to low
    vector<int> color = greedy_color(g, order, k);

    bool success = true;
    for (int c : color) {
        if (c == -1) { success = false; break; }
    }

    // Step 2: If failed, try random shuffles
    if (!success) {
        mt19937 rng(static_cast<unsigned>(time(0)));
        vector<int> vertices(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) vertices[i] = i;

        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 10 && !success; attempt++) {
            shuffle(vertices.begin(), vertices.end(), rng);
            color = greedy_color(g, vertices, k);
            success = true;
            for (int c : color) {
                if (c == -1) { success = false; break; }
            }
            if (success) break;
        }
    }

    // Step 3: If still failed, try DSATUR
    if (!success) {
        color = dsatur_color(g, k);
        success = true;
        for (int c : color) {
            if (c == -1) { success = false; break; }
        }
    }

    // Step 4: Last resort — output anyway (assumes problem guarantees solvability)
    // If still invalid, we output what we have (may be incomplete/wrong, but better than nothing)
    // In practice, for solvable instances, one of above should work.

    // Output
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i > 0) cout << " ";
        cout << color[i];
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead, BufReader};
use std::str::FromStr;

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdin.lock());

    // Read first line: num_vertices num_edges
    let mut line = String::new();
    if reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap() == 0 {
        return; // No input
    }
    let mut parts = line.trim().split_whitespace();
    let n: usize = parts.next().unwrap().parse().expect("Invalid num_vertices");
    let m: usize = parts.next().unwrap().parse().expect("Invalid num_edges");

    // Initialize adjacency list and edge list
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(m);

    // Read m edges
    for _ in 0..m {
        line.clear();
        reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
        let mut parts = line.trim().split_whitespace();
        let u: usize = parts.next().unwrap().parse().expect("Invalid u");
        let v: usize = parts.next().unwrap().parse().expect("Invalid v");
        edges.push((u, v));
        adj[u].push(v);
        adj[v].push(u);
    }

    // Greedy maximal matching
    let mut matched = vec![false; n];
    let mut matching_edges = Vec::new();

    for &(u, v) in &edges {
        if !matched[u] && !matched[v] {
            matched[u] = true;
            matched[v] = true;
            matching_edges.push((u, v));
        }
    }

    // Vertex cover: all vertices in the matching
    let cover: Vec<usize> = (0..n)
        .filter(|&i| matched[i])
        .collect();

    // Output
    println!("{}", cover.len());
    if !cover.is_empty() {
        for (i, &v) in cover.iter().enumerate() {
            if i > 0 {
                print!(" ");
            }
            print!("{}", v);
        }
        println!();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace MaximumCliqueSolver
{
    class Program
    {
        static int[] bestClique = Array.Empty<int>();
        static int bestCliqueSize = 0;
        static Stopwatch stopwatch;
        static long timeLimitMs = 290_000; // 290 seconds, leave 10s for output

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            // Read input
            string firstLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (firstLine == null) return;
            var parts = firstLine.Split(' ');
            int numVertices = int.Parse(parts[0]);
            int numEdges = int.Parse(parts[1]);

            // Build adjacency list: HashSet for O(1) lookup
            var adj = new HashSet<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++)
                adj[i] = new HashSet<int>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++)
            {
                var edge = Console.ReadLine()?.Split(' ');
                if (edge == null || edge.Length < 2) continue;
                int u = int.Parse(edge[0]);
                int v = int.Parse(edge[1]);
                if (u < 0 || u >= numVertices || v < 0 || v >= numVertices) continue;
                adj[u].Add(v);
                adj[v].Add(u);
            }

            // Check time
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs)
            {
                OutputResult();
                return;
            }

            // Choose strategy based on graph size
            if (numVertices <= 100)
            {
                ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else if (numVertices <= 10000)
            {
                GreedyWithLocalSearchParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else
            {
                LargeGraphHeuristicParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }

            // Final safety: if no clique found, output single vertex
            if (bestCliqueSize == 0 && numVertices > 0)
            {
                bestClique = new int[] { 0 };
                bestCliqueSize = 1;
            }

            OutputResult();
        }

        static void ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var R = new HashSet<int>();
            var P = new HashSet<int>();
            var X = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P.Add(i);

            BronKerboschPivot(R, P, X, adj);
        }

        static void BronKerboschPivot(HashSet<int> R, HashSet<int> P, HashSet<int> X, HashSet<int>[] adj)
        {
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

            if (P.Count == 0 && X.Count == 0)
            {
                if (R.Count > bestCliqueSize)
                {
                    bestClique = R.ToArray();
                    bestCliqueSize = R.Count;
                }
                return;
            }

            // Choose pivot u from P ∪ X to minimize |P ∩ N(u)|
            int u = -1;
            int minCount = int.MaxValue;
            var union = new HashSet<int>(P);
            union.UnionWith(X);
            foreach (int vertex in union)
            {
                var intersection = new HashSet<int>(P);
                intersection.IntersectWith(adj[vertex]);
                if (intersection.Count < minCount)
                {
                    minCount = intersection.Count;
                    u = vertex;
                }
            }

            // If no pivot found (shouldn't happen), fallback
            if (u == -1 && P.Count > 0)
                u = P.First();

            // Candidates: P \ N(u)
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(P);
            if (u != -1)
            {
                candidates.ExceptWith(adj[u]);
            }

            foreach (int v in candidates.ToList()) // ToList to avoid modification during iteration
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

                var Rnew = new HashSet<int>(R) { v };
                var Pnew = new HashSet<int>(P);
                Pnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);
                var Xnew = new HashSet<int>(X);
                Xnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);

                BronKerboschPivot(Rnew, Pnew, Xnew, adj);

                P.Remove(v);
                X.Add(v);
            }
        }

        static void GreedyWithLocalSearchParallel(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var seeds = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
                .OrderByDescending(i => adj[i].Count)
                .Take(Math.Min(50, n))
                .ToArray();

            var tasks = new List<Task>();
            var lockObj = new object();

            foreach (int seed in seeds)
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) break;
                tasks.Add(Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var clique = GreedyGrow(adj, seed);
                    var improved = LocalSearchImprove(adj, clique);
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (improved.Length > bestCliqueSize)
                        {
                            bestClique = improved;
                            bestCliqueSize = improved.Length;
                        }
                    }
                }));
            }

            Task.WaitAll(tasks.ToArray());
        }

        static int[] GreedyGrow(HashSet<int>[] adj, int start)
        {
            var clique = new HashSet<int> { start };
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(adj[start]);

            while (candidates.Count > 0)
            {
                // Pick vertex with most connections to current clique
                int bestV = -1;
                int maxScore = -1;
                foreach (int v in candidates)
                {
                    int score = 0;
                    foreach (int c in clique)
                    {
                        if (adj[v].Contains(c)) score++;
                    }
                    if (score > maxScore)
                    {
                        maxScore = score;
                        bestV = v;
                    }
                }

                if (bestV == -1) break;

                clique.Add(bestV);
                // Update candidates: intersection with neighbors of bestV
                candidates.IntersectWith(adj[bestV]);
            }

            return clique.ToArray();
        }

        static int[] LocalSearchImprove(HashSet<int>[] adj, int[] clique)
        {
            var current = new HashSet<int>(clique);
            bool improved;

            do
            {
                improved = false;
                var nonClique = Enumerable.Range(0, adj.Length)
                    .Where(v => !current.Contains(v))
                    .ToArray();

                foreach (int v in nonClique)
                {
                    // Check if v is connected to all in current clique
                    bool isConnectedToAll = true;
                    foreach (int c in current)
                    {
                        if (!adj[v].Contains(c))
                        {
                            isConnectedToAll = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (isConnectedToAll)
                    {
                        // Try to replace one vertex in clique with v to keep size same or increase
                        // We try to find a vertex u in clique such that (clique - {u}) + {v} is still a clique
                        foreach (int u in current.ToArray())
                        {
                            var test = new HashSet<int>(current);
                            test.Remove(u);
                            test.Add(v);

                            bool valid = true;
                            var list = test.ToArray();
                            for (int i = 0; i < list.Length; i++)
                            {
                                for (int j = i + 1; j < list.Length; j++)
                                {

            // Build adjacency list: HashSet for O(1) lookup
            var adj = new HashSet<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++)
                adj[i] = new HashSet<int>();

            {

                if (edge == null || edge.Length < 2) continue;
                int u = int.Parse(edge[0]);
                int v = int.Parse(edge[1]);
                if (u < 0 || u >= numVertices || v < 0 || v >= numVertices) continue;
                adj[u].Add(v);
                adj[v].Add(u);
            }

            // Check time
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs)
            {
                OutputResult();
                return;
            }

            // Choose strategy based on graph size
            if (numVertices <= 100)

                ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else if (numVertices <= 10000)
            {
                GreedyWithLocalSearchParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else
            {
                LargeGraphHeuristicParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }

            // Final safety: if no clique found, output single vertex
            if (bestCliqueSize == 0 && numVertices > 0)
            {
                bestClique = new int[] { 0 };
                bestCliqueSize = 1;
            }

            OutputResult();
        }

        static void ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var R = new HashSet<int>();
            var P = new HashSet<int>();
            var X = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P.Add(i);

            BronKerboschPivot(R, P, X, adj);
        }

        static void BronKerboschPivot(HashSet<int> R, HashSet<int> P, HashSet<int> X, HashSet<int>[] adj)
        {
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

            if (P.Count == 0 && X.Count == 0)
            {
                if (R.Count > bestCliqueSize)
                {
                    bestClique = R.ToArray();
                    bestCliqueSize = R.Count;
                }
                return;
            }

            // Choose pivot u from P ∪ X to minimize |P ∩ N(u)|
            int u = -1;
            int minCount = int.MaxValue;
            var union = new HashSet<int>(P);
            union.UnionWith(X);
            foreach (int vertex in union)
            {
                var intersection = new HashSet<int>(P);
                intersection.IntersectWith(adj[vertex]);
                if (intersection.Count < minCount)
                {
                    minCount = intersection.Count;
                    u = vertex;
                }
            }

            // If no pivot found (shouldn't happen), fallback
            if (u == -1 && P.Count > 0)
                u = P.First();

            // Candidates: P \ N(u)
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(P);
            if (u != -1)
            {
                candidates.ExceptWith(adj[u]);
            }

            foreach (int v in candidates.ToList()) // ToList to avoid modification during iteration
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

                var Rnew = new HashSet<int>(R) { v };
                var Pnew = new HashSet<int>(P);
                Pnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);
                var Xnew = new HashSet<int>(X);
                Xnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);

                BronKerboschPivot(Rnew, Pnew, Xnew, adj);

                P.Remove(v);
                X.Add(v);
            }
        }

                        foreach (int u in current.ToArray())

                            test.Remove(u);
                            test.Add(v);

                if (edge == null || edge.Length < 2) continue;
                int u = int.Parse(edge[0]);
                int v = int.Parse(edge[1]);
                if (u < 0 || u >= numVertices || v < 0 || v >= numVertices) continue;

                adj[v].Add(u);

            else

                LargeGraphHeuristicParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }

            // Final safety: if no clique found, output single vertex
            if (bestCliqueSize == 0 && numVertices > 0)
            {
                bestClique = new int[] { 0 };
                bestCliqueSize = 1;
            }

            OutputResult();

        {
            var R = new HashSet<int>();
            var P = new HashSet<int>();
            var X = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P.Add(i);

            BronKerboschPivot(R, P, X, adj);
        }

        static void BronKerboschPivot(HashSet<int> R, HashSet<int> P, HashSet<int> X, HashSet<int>[] adj)
        {
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

            if (P.Count == 0 && X.Count == 0)
            {
                if (R.Count > bestCliqueSize)
                {
                    bestClique = R.ToArray();
                    bestCliqueSize = R.Count;
                }
                return;
            }

            // Choose pivot u from P ∪ X to minimize |P ∩ N(u)|
            int u = -1;
            int minCount = int.MaxValue;
            var union = new HashSet<int>(P);
            union.UnionWith(X);
            foreach (int vertex in union)
            {
                var intersection = new HashSet<int>(P);
                intersection.IntersectWith(adj[vertex]);
                if (intersection.Count < minCount)
                {
                    minCount = intersection.Count;
                    u = vertex;
                }
            }

            // If no pivot found (shouldn't happen), fallback
            if (u == -1 && P.Count > 0)
                u = P.First();

            // Candidates: P \ N(u)
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(P);
            if (u != -1)
            {
                candidates.ExceptWith(adj[u]);
            }

            foreach (int v in candidates.ToList()) // ToList to avoid modification during iteration
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

                var Rnew = new HashSet<int>(R) { v };
                var Pnew = new HashSet<int>(P);
                Pnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);
                var Xnew = new HashSet<int>(X);
                Xnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);

                X.Add(v);
            }
        }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace MaximumCliqueSolver
{
    class Program
    {
        static int[] bestClique = Array.Empty<int>();
        static int bestCliqueSize = 0;
        static Stopwatch stopwatch;
        static long timeLimitMs = 290_000; // 290 seconds, leave 10s for output

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            // Read input
            string firstLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (firstLine == null) return;
            var parts = firstLine.Split(' ');
            int numVertices = int.Parse(parts[0]);
            int numEdges = int.Parse(parts[1]);

            // Build adjacency list: HashSet for O(1) lookup
            var adj = new HashSet<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++)
                adj[i] = new HashSet<int>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++)
            {
                var edge = Console.ReadLine()?.Split(' ');
                if (edge == null || edge.Length < 2) continue;
                int u = int.Parse(edge[0]);
                int v = int.Parse(edge[1]);
                if (u < 0 || u >= numVertices || v < 0 || v >= numVertices) continue;
                adj[u].Add(v);
                adj[v].Add(u);
            }

            // Check time
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs)
            {
                OutputResult();
                return;
            }

            // Choose strategy based on graph size
            if (numVertices <= 100)
            {
                ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else if (numVertices <= 10000)
            {
                GreedyWithLocalSearchParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }
            else
            {
                LargeGraphHeuristicParallel(adj, numVertices);
            }

            // Final safety: if no clique found, output single vertex
            if (bestCliqueSize == 0 && numVertices > 0)
            {
                bestClique = new int[] { 0 };
                bestCliqueSize = 1;
            }

            OutputResult();
        }

        static void ExactBronKerboschWithPivot(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var R = new HashSet<int>();
            var P = new HashSet<int>();
            var X = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P.Add(i);

            BronKerboschPivot(R, P, X, adj);
        }

        static void BronKerboschPivot(HashSet<int> R, HashSet<int> P, HashSet<int> X, HashSet<int>[] adj)
        {
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

            if (P.Count == 0 && X.Count == 0)
            {
                if (R.Count > bestCliqueSize)
                {
                    bestClique = R.ToArray();
                    bestCliqueSize = R.Count;
                }
                return;
            }

            // Choose pivot u from P ∪ X to minimize |P ∩ N(u)|
            int u = -1;
            int minCount = int.MaxValue;
            var union = new HashSet<int>(P);
            union.UnionWith(X);
            foreach (int vertex in union)
            {
                var intersection = new HashSet<int>(P);
                intersection.IntersectWith(adj[vertex]);
                if (intersection.Count < minCount)
                {
                    minCount = intersection.Count;
                    u = vertex;
                }
            }

            // If no pivot found (shouldn't happen), fallback
            if (u == -1 && P.Count > 0)
                u = P.First();

            // Candidates: P \ N(u)
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(P);
            if (u != -1)
            {
                candidates.ExceptWith(adj[u]);
            }

            foreach (int v in candidates.ToList()) // ToList to avoid modification during iteration
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) return;

                var Rnew = new HashSet<int>(R) { v };
                var Pnew = new HashSet<int>(P);
                Pnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);
                var Xnew = new HashSet<int>(X);
                Xnew.IntersectWith(adj[v]);

                BronKerboschPivot(Rnew, Pnew, Xnew, adj);

                P.Remove(v);
                X.Add(v);
            }
        }

        static void GreedyWithLocalSearchParallel(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            var seeds = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
                .OrderByDescending(i => adj[i].Count)
                .Take(Math.Min(50, n))
                .ToArray();

            var tasks = new List<Task>();
            var lockObj = new object();

            foreach (int seed in seeds)
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) break;
                tasks.Add(Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var clique = GreedyGrow(adj, seed);
                    var improved = LocalSearchImprove(adj, clique);
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (improved.Length > bestCliqueSize)
                        {
                            bestClique = improved;
                            bestCliqueSize = improved.Length;
                        }
                    }
                }));
            }

            Task.WaitAll(tasks.ToArray());
        }

        static int[] GreedyGrow(HashSet<int>[] adj, int start)
        {
            var clique = new HashSet<int> { start };
            var candidates = new HashSet<int>(adj[start]);

            while (candidates.Count > 0)
            {
                // Pick vertex with most connections to current clique
                int bestV = -1;
                int maxScore = -1;
                foreach (int v in candidates)
                {
                    int score = 0;
                    foreach (int c in clique)
                    {
                        if (adj[v].Contains(c)) score++;
                    }
                    if (score > maxScore)
                    {
                        maxScore = score;
                        bestV = v;
                    }
                }

                if (bestV == -1) break;

                clique.Add(bestV);
                // Update candidates: intersection with neighbors of bestV
                candidates.IntersectWith(adj[bestV]);
            }

            return clique.ToArray();
        }

        static int[] LocalSearchImprove(HashSet<int>[] adj, int[] clique)
        {
            var current = new HashSet<int>(clique);
            bool improved;

            do
            {
                improved = false;
                var nonClique = Enumerable.Range(0, adj.Length)
                    .Where(v => !current.Contains(v))
                    .ToArray();

                foreach (int v in nonClique)
                {
                    // Check if v is connected to all in current clique
                    bool isConnectedToAll = true;
                    foreach (int c in current)
                    {
                        if (!adj[v].Contains(c))
                        {
                            isConnectedToAll = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (isConnectedToAll)
                    {
                        // Try to replace one vertex in clique with v to keep size same or increase
                        // We try to find a vertex u in clique such that (clique - {u}) + {v} is still a clique
                        foreach (int u in current.ToArray())
                        {
                            var test = new HashSet<int>(current);
                            test.Remove(u);
                            test.Add(v);

                            bool valid = true;
                            var list = test.ToArray();
                            for (int i = 0; i < list.Length; i++)
                            {
                                for (int j = i + 1; j < list.Length; j++)
                                {
                                    if (!adj[list[i]].Contains(list[j]))
                                    {
                                        valid = false;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (!valid) break;
                            }

                            if (valid && test.Count > current.Count)
                            {
                                current = test;
                                improved = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (improved) break;
                    }
                }
            } while (improved && stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs);

            return current.ToArray();
        }

        static void LargeGraphHeuristicParallel(HashSet<int>[] adj, int n)
        {
            // Step 1: Find high-degree seeds
            var degreeList = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
                .Select(i => new { Vertex = i, Degree = adj[i].Count })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.Degree)
                .Take(Math.Min(100, n))
                .ToArray();

            var tasks = new List<Task>();
            var lockObj = new object();

            // Parallel seed evaluation
            foreach (var item in degreeList)
            {
                if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) break;
                int seed = item.Vertex;
                tasks.Add(Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var clique = GreedyGrow(adj, seed);
                    var improved = LocalSearchImprove(adj, clique);
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (improved.Length > bestCliqueSize)
                        {
                            bestClique = improved;
                            bestCliqueSize = improved.Length;
                        }
                    }
                }));
            }

            Task.WaitAll(tasks.ToArray());

            // Step 2: Triangle counting heuristic for refinement (optional, lightweight)
            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs * 0.8) // Only if we have time
            {
                var topVertices = degreeList.Take(Math.Min(20, n)).Select(x => x.Vertex).ToArray();
                foreach (int v in topVertices)
                {
                    if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) break;
                    var neighbors = adj[v].ToArray();
                    // Look for triangles: u-w where u,w in neighbors and edge(u,w) exists
                    for (int i = 0; i < neighbors.Length && stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs; i++)
                    {
                        for (int j = i + 1; j < neighbors.Length && stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs; j++)
                        {
                            int u = neighbors[i];
                            int w = neighbors[j];
                            if (adj[u].Contains(w))
                            {
                                // Found triangle v-u-w, try to grow from here
                                var seedClique = new int[] { v, u, w };
                                var grown = GreedyGrowFromSeed(adj, seedClique);

                                        bestCliqueSize = improved.Length;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        {
            var clique = new HashSet<int>(seed);

                    }

                        bestV = v;
                    }
                }

                if (bestV == -1) break;

                clique.Add(bestV);
                candidates.IntersectWith(adj[bestV]);
            }

            return clique.ToArray();
        }

        static void OutputResult()
        {
            Console.WriteLine(bestCliqueSize);
            if (bestCliqueSize > 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestClique.OrderBy(v => v)));
            }

        }
    }
